It is necessary to consider the words of the vicious people as vicious. Whatever is told by the mischievous, rebellious people may be considered as worthless. Whatever told by a man is a part of his character, just as a bit of bread is definitely bread. Hazrat Ali has said: “Whatever told by the ignorant is like the green grass grown upon the heap of refuse. One, who sits upon such grass, certainly sits upon the refuse. It becomes essential for him to wash himself, as without it, his prayer (salat) may go waste.”

The minister’s words were telling the people to be smart, but their impacts were making them lazy. The appearance of silver is whitish and bright; but hands and clothes become black like charcoal upon rubbing with it. Fire appears red with its flames, but its job is to burn things and blacken them. Though lightning is very bright in appearance, it snatches away eyesight. Every person other than the well-informed and intelligent carried his words as an iron-yoke around his neck. By remaining away from the king for six months he had become as though a protector of Christians. They offered their faith and hearts to him and became obedient to do what all he said to do and to avoid doing.

chapters.title: King’s Secret Message
chapters.subtitle: King’s secret message to the treacherous minister

paras: In between this period of six months both the king and the minister were in secret communication and the king remained contented with his secret messages. Their program to rout the Christians remained intact. On one occasion, the king wrote to him: “O my dear designer, time has come to soon relieve my mind of anxieties. My eyes are set upon the results very anxiously. Give me relief from it, if there is a chance”.

The minister replied: ‘I am still engaged in the job of creating rifts among the different followers of Jesus Christ. Christians are divided into twelve factions under different leaders, who out of greed are under me”.

These twelve leaders along with their followers became followers of the minister. Everyone of them had faith in him and obeyed whatever he said. They were completely devoted to him and ready to die for him if he so ordered. When that mean minister had control of them all, he managed to create turmoil among them with his cleverness and treachery.

chapters.title: Mischievous Interpretation of Gospel
chapters.subtitle: The Minister’s Mischief in Misinterpreting the Commands of the Gospel

paras: He wrote lengthy letters to each of them and each was of a different version. Commands in each of them were different, which were all, from beginning to end opposed to each other. In one, he stressed upon hard worship and hunger and made repentance and going toward God as the most fundamental thing. In another, he stressed that worship is of no use and the only path is nothing but giving charity. In another, he wrote: Your fasting and charity amount to participation between yourself and God. Rely in entirety upon God and remain contented with whatever happens, whether sorrows and comforts, is mischief and deceit. In another, he wrote that obedience to God is absolutely necessary, as merely reliance upon Him amounts to disgracing Him.

In another, he wrote that commands of the faith to do certain acts and avoid certain others are not for actually following them but only to explain that they are helpless in every way; so that we may see our helplessness in them and thereby recognise God’s omnipotence. In another, he wrote something opposed to this telling not to look at your helplessness; and be warned, that pleading helplessness is nothing but rejection of God’s grants. Look at your own power. This is given over to you. Consider your power as a gift from Him. In another, he wrote: go away from both of these; as whatever that comes into sight is an idol and holding on to it is idol worship.

In another, he said: All matters of predestination and free will, and whatever thoughts that come into your mind will come to end, of their own; therefore, there is no need to bother about them. All communities are trapped into disgrace because of indulgence in their desires. Even ignoring of the discussions of free will and predestination, many a times, result in misguidance. In another letter he said: do not put out the lamp of wisdom, as it provides the light to discussions and debates in gatherings as they are required for sustenance and progress; and if you put out this lamp, it means ruining the pleasures of love and companionship. In another, he entirely differed: put out the lamp of wisdom. Do not worry about it as, if you put out one, you will get a hundred thousand. The putting out of the lamp of wisdom results in the progress of your soul and if you patiently wait for results, your beloved Laila, instead of remaining as beloved, will become the lover like Majnun. One who left the world because of his dislike and contempt for it, it will come to him manifold.

In another one, he wrote: Whatever God had given to you has been made sweeter for you in the beginning itself. It will be available to you whether you like it or not. Further, do not think whether all these are permissible or not, as they are given by God. Therefore, accept and enjoy them and do not put yourself into doubts and suspicions.

In another, he wrote: Stay away from your property and possessions, as all that is pleasing to you is bad and rejectable. Adopting ways suiting to each one a very easy path. Every religion has become easy for its followers for this reason, and it is for this reason that there are so many confusions and quarrels. If only one path has been easy to follow as per God’s own making, every Jew and Zoroastrian would have been aware of it.

In another, he wrote: Easy to follow is that path which is as per one’s liking by becoming the food of one’s life. Whatever that suits to the taste of a person becomes worthless after its passing away just as hard soil does not grow and produce any crop. It gives him nothing but shame if cultivated; and nothing but loss if purchased. It will not be of any use if adopted and ultimately leads to loss. Therefore, you should try to understand the difference between what is easy and difficult and keep your eyes upon the results and not at ease and difficulty in following.

In another, he wrote: Search for a master. Do not go after your own high descent as your wisdom and farsight cannot come from it. A community which found out its own path without a teacher (leader) ultimately falls into great mistakes. Understanding the ultimate result of things is not possible for everyone. Only great teachers can do it. Had not this been a fact, so many religions world not have come about.

In another, he wrote: You are yourself a master, and there is no need for searching for a master, because it is for you alone to search for a teacher. When you have the ability to search for a teacher, it means that you have yourself the abilities of the teacher. Therefore, be a bold man and march forward, on your own. Do not become subordinate to anyone. Think of your own self and proceed forward and do not worry about others. Form your own opinion and follow it and do not go against it; and if you are steadfast on it, you will meet your Lord.

In another one, he wrote: This entire universe is one; and whoever considers it to be two is a fool and squint-eyed. And in another, he said: How can a hundred be one; and one who thinks as such is mad. Every statement is the opposite of another just as sugar and poison are. In all these letters, the meanings, and forms of each of the opposite things were different from the other one, just as: night and day, thorns and flowers, stones and pearls are all different and opposite of each other. So long as you do not pass through these poisonous and sugary matters, you cannot feel the fragrance of oneness in the garden of flowers.

sections.heading: What Math(s)navi Speaks Of
paras: This Math(s)navi speaks of unity in unity and unity. If you want to know this, you will have to pass from Samaak the fish holding the bull, upon the horns of which is the earth, to Samaak, the two stars found on the highest point of the highest heaven. [The concept of Samaak as the fish holding the bull etc, was the prevailing concept among the masses in those days. Even to this day there are persons holding on to such beliefs. Stephen Hawking, the great scientist of our days in the first chapter of his book – A Brief History of Time, refers to an elderly woman’s disagreement with a great astronomer upon hearing about the orbits of sun, earth, moon etc, insisting that the earth is a plate placed upon the back of a tortoise, which again stands on another tortoise and this goes on infinitely – (A Brief History of Time: The Stephen Hawking 1989, Page 1, Bantom Book): Translator’s note]

chapters.title: Differences in Knowing God
chapters.subtitle: To Explain that Differences are in the Treading of Paths, but not in the Reality

paras: Twelve such long letters of the mentioned type were written by that enemy of the religion of Jesus. He was not aware of the oneness of the colour of Jesus and had not felt its fragrance; and he did not have the quality of the pot of Jesus by putting colourless clothes in which, Jesus used to colour them in the chosen colour and bring them out. Clothes got coloured in hundred dyes in this pot and came out in clean and bright colours. These colours were not such that would disgust one, but they were like the fish in clean water, which never gets disgusted of water.

sections.heading: Though dry land has many colours: red, yellow, black, but the fishes do not like them but always remain in the colourless water. Giving the examples of fish and river is not worthy to bring about a similarity with God. There are hundreds of thousands of existing things, fishes and rivers, which are all in prostrations before that great generous God, Who is an ocean of grants. There have been so many rains of His grants and in so many ways that the ocean shells out pearls like rain pouring drops of water. Many suns of grants rose-up, as a consequence of which oceans and clouds learned the lessons of gracefulness. Many suns of graces shined brightly resulting in the rotation of particles. The lights of His essence fell on clay and water, making the earth capable of accepting the seeds in its lap. The earth became so honest that it gave back to you whatever you sowed in it without any misappropriation, taking the burden of this job without any renumeration from you. This honesty found its way in the earth because of His benevolence as the sun of justice shines upon it.
paras: Until and unless the spring season does not appear under His command, earth does not show any greenery. That great generous Giver has given his messages and trusts and showed His paths to the minerals making them act like living-beings in spite of being lifeless. Extreme winter out of the fear of His wrath, hides itself. These hard minerals, as a result of His benevolence become soft. What was just good became better, as it had to be. His kindness makes every mineral aware of its potentialities which are well made use of. However, if He does not intend kindness, His wrath makes the very well-informed go blind; and they cannot take benefits from them. There are so many grants from Him, that it is impossible for anyone to list them and even a little that I make is out of the interest and fancy of others. I cannot understand as to whom I have to say. Wherever there were ears to hear this, they became so well aware as to see everything. Wherever there were stones, they became bright gems. He is an alchemist who can make baser metals into higher metals like gold and silver. He is the Grantor of miracles, and after all, what is alchemy in comparison with miracles and the sciences that alter the nature of things. My talking of all this in His praise is actually denial of praise as trying to prove what is already proven is a futile exercise.

sections.heading: Man is Blind to God’s Grants
paras: Therefore, it is better that we get annihilated and deny any kind of activity before Him; rather, it is not only our existence but even a thought of our existence is blind and non-existing before Him. However, our existence is already blind, and it cannot see, as otherwise by looking at Him, it would have simply melted away. As otherwise, when the heat of the sun can be felt, His light and heat are not felt by us, because we are blind and senseless to them. Our existence has put upon itself the black dress of mourning of its ignorance. Had it not been so, it would not have gone to the other extremity of coolness like ice.

chapters.title: Tricks do not Last Long
chapters.subtitle: Deficiencies of the Minister’s Mischiefs and Tricks

paras: The minister was so ignorant and incompetent like his king that he tried to fight against the eternal and everlasting God, Who is absolutely needed by all; and Everliving, Omnipotent, Who has been living ever since and shall last for ever, Who is One and Only and all Observing. He wanted to fight against such an Omnipotent, Who existed when nothing existed, Who can create a hundred worlds like our world with His single blow. He can create a hundred worlds as this in one glance. This can be realised by you if you can brighten your eyes in this understanding.

sections.heading: Everything is Nothing before God
paras: This world is so large and expansive in your view, but before God’s sight it is not even a particle. This world is like a prison for your life in which you see nothing; and if you want to see, run towards the free, unbounded, large and expansive field of God. This world has its own limits, and His has no boundary; and shapes and bodies of things are obstacles in the understanding of the other world.

Pharaoh had hundreds of thousands of spears with him, but with a single staff, H. Musa smashed them all. There were hundreds of thousands of physicians like Galen, but they were of no worth before the blow of a breath of H. ‘Is. There were hundreds of thousands of volumes of poetical compositions, but they were of no worth before the words of the unlettered Prophet of Islam. How can any mean fellow remain alive before such a dominant God? He has uprooted many such hearts that were strong like mountains and the wings of the great philosophers were tied by him to remain without flight beyond certain levels, as though they were petty birds. Therefore, sharpening your wisdom and capacities does not lead you toward Him. Only His grace resulting from your humility and submissiveness can lead you to Him.

Many who collected large treasures like the “treasure of the cow” which were hidden under the earth containing a cow made of gold during the days of Jamshid, (which was accidentally found by a farmer), were considered worthless by the wise. What is a cow made of gold, even the collectors were not worth the hair of the cow? What is the worth of fertile land, when your worth is only as of a piece of grass grown in it? Why should you go mad after gold and silver? So also, after a face for which you become mad like Majnun. These palaces and gardens are your prisons. Your kingdoms and your wealth are calamity for your life.

sections.heading: Cases of Transfiguration
paras: That group of people that was changed by God was wiped off like a painting. The woman who indulged in shameless acts was transfigured into planet Venus, (as the Jewish story goes). Venus was a beautiful woman who indulged in love with the angels; Harut and Marut, consequent upon which they were hanged upside down in a well in Babylonia; and the woman with the help of miraculous words learnt from them flew up to the heavens where she was transfigured into the planet Venus. [This version has nothing to do with Islamic beliefs but was known as a story among the masses in the Muslim world. This is taken into the Math(s)navi as an event of transfiguration brought about by God as many others, like other natural phenomena explained in other verses— Translator’s Note]. Making of a woman into Venus is transfiguration. So also, the conversion of mud and water as parts of the human body is also transfiguration.

Soul could have taken you to the abode of God in the highest level of the heavens, but you came down to the lowest place of mud and water. Because of your lowliness, you have transfigured yourself to the low level even though your status, as man, was so great that the ten angels who were appointed at the earliest stage to create and manage the universe (as many philosophers say), would envy at.

sections.heading: Greatness and Lowliness of Man and Things
paras: The other transfigurations were physical but yours was of status. This transfiguration is worse than the others. You have run the horse of your courage toward the heavens (in cosmology) but you failed to understand Adam (as man) who was prostrated by the angels. You have failed to understand that you are a child of Adam and the honour of prostration by angels is inherited by you. But you have made yourself an unworthy child. You have mistaken dishonour as honour and brought bad name to your father. How long do you say that you will conquer the world and capture it for your own self and provide no place for others?

You do not know that if the entire world gets covered up and filled up with ice, one glance from the heat of the sun, will melt it down. The burden of all the mischiefs done by the minister and of many others a hundred thousand times, will be obliterated with one spark from God. And also convert all mischievous ideas into ideas of wisdom, and the poisonous water into tasty syrup. He keeps treasures protected in ruins. He makes the thorns as flowers and the bodies as souls. He converts doubt-creating thoughts into certainties and makes the means of meanly traits into the causes of love and affinity. He takes care of Ibrahim in fire and converts the fear into a soul inspiring satisfaction. I go mad and get confounded upon the series of causes and effects made by Him. Sometimes, I go to the extent of believing in those of the philosophers who say that all occurrences are random; there is no cause behind anything; and everything comes about, on its own, without any cause. I am astonished at his cause-makings and out of this itself, I am also astonished at the shattering’s of causes.

chapters.title: Seclusion for Treachery
chapters.subtitle: The Minister’s sitting in Seclusion and causing Mischief in the Community

paras: The treacherous minister with his misbeliefs made changes in the religion of Jesus Christ in order to create turmoil and fights among its followers. The other treacherous design he made was that he stopped giving sermons and put himself into seclusion. He created a fire of enthusiasm in the hearts of his followers and did not appear before them for forty-fifty days. People went into madness to see him and to hear him, as a result of this long separation. They used to flatter him and plead to him in extreme humility, and he continued to be in penance and bent down as a hunchback due to prolonged austerities. People went on entreating him telling: “There is no light for us without you. Tell us, how can a blind man walk without a stick. As a matter of great kindness and for God’s sake, do not keep us separated from you for longer time. We are all like babies and you are like our wet-nurse. Put the same shadow of benevolence upon us as she does.”
He told them: “My soul is not away from my friends. But it is not proper for me to come out. I have not been permitted to do that”.

sections.heading: People’s Entreating him to Speak
paras: The leaders of the people came over to recommend to him, and the followers showed extreme humility saying: “It is our misfortune. We are deprived of our soul and faith by being away from you. You are pleading some reason or the other, but our hearts are sighing with burns. We have become accustomed to hear your sweet words. We have drunk the milk of your wisdom. For God’s sake, do not show this cruelty to us. Be kind now itself, do not put it for tomorrow. Does your heart permit you to deprive our hearts to be put among the deprived people, by your remaining away from us? We are all writhing like fishes out of water. Flow your water on us and break the dam you have erected on your stream. O the one, no one else is like you in the world. Please for God’s sake, hear and respond to our grievances”.

chapters.title: Chasing away of Disciples
chapters.subtitle: Minister’s Chasing Away the Disciples and Followers

paras: He said: “O those accustomed to words, lectures, preachings, talks of the tongue, and searches of the sounds for ears! Put cotton into your physical ears to avoid sensible sounds and stop hearing. Prevent your eyes from the seeing of external physical objects. The cotton for the internal ears is the physical ear of your head. Unless this external ear does not become deaf, the internal ear will not hear inner sounds. Become senseless to audible sounds and do away with physical ears and be devoid of all thoughts so that you may hear the inner command of “Irji‘iI” : “Return” as stated in the Quran: ya ayyyatuha al nafsu al mutma’innatu. Irji‘ii ilaa rabbiki raadhiyatan mardhiaytan. Fadkhuli fii ibadii. Wad khulii jannatii: O you, soul at peace! Return up to your Lord, content in His pleasure! Enter among My bondmen! Enter you My Garden! (Surah: The Dawn: 89: 27,28,29,30)

“So long as you are awake and engaged in oral talk, you cannot feel even the smell of the messages in the dream. Hearing this command of return is different. You have to stop your worldly engagements and return to the place of hearing of spiritual commands. Our actions and words relate to our external observations of the world. The journey of observations of the inner esoteric world is in the regions well above the heavens. H. Musa was born in dry land and was with dry senses, but he was thrown into the water of Nile, when he was a baby and thereby received certain opposite qualities of wetness. His body got the dry characteristics of the land, but his soul got the wet characteristics of water. There was a transformation from one characteristic to another, its opposite.

“You have spent your entire life on the land: at times on the hills, forests, and open fields. Therefore, you cannot get the water of life. You cannot tear the water of the river and split it. Our senses, thoughts and understandings arise from the waves of dust, which keep us bound to the lowly mud. These are only the products of worldly learning and wisdom. But the waves of the water of the other world wetten you with the spiritual feelings of annihilation of the self: a state of spiritual intoxication and forgetfulness when you will see that there is no difference between the apparent commands and hidden commands.

“So long as you are engaged in rational arguments and their depths, you are away from the spiritual intoxication. You will refuse to drink this water that gives spiritual elation. Too much of talk on worldly matters is like a gust of dust. It creates hardheartedness. The honourable Prophet has said: “Too much of talking causes hardheartedness”. Therefore, cultivate the habit of maintaining silence for some time. That will bring you to your senses”.

chapters.title: Repeated Requests of Disciples
chapters.subtitle: Repeated Requests of the Disciples to Give up Seclusion

paras: All the people said: “O wise and great! Do not tell all these mischievous, cruel things to us as they are creating confusions and rifts. We are all your prisoners, and how long do you keep us like this? Why are you showing your wrath to us? We have already become heartless and lifeless. When you have accepted us in the beginning, be kind to us till the end as you were earlier. You have found out our weakness, helplessness and needs. You also know the medicine for our sickness. Therefore, please put a load upon the beast of burden according to its capacity.

sections.heading: “Give jobs to the weak people as per their capabilities. Every bird has to be given food as per its digestive capacity. Every bird cannot eat figs. If a baby is given bread instead of milk, the baby would be as good as dead. When he gets the teeth, he will on his own, search for bread. If a bird tries to fly before getting feathers, it will become a morsel of the tearing cat. When it gets feathers, it will fly off, on its own. It will not be in need of any good or bad whistlings. You are such a good debater that, even Satan will be silenced before you. Your talks have made our ears highly conscious. Our ears are in utmost attention when you speak out. You are like a river and we are so dry that even the ocean becomes dry with our impacts. Your companionship is better than the earth and sky for us. And you are so bright that from fish downwards in the ocean to Venus high above in the heaven will receive brightness from you. Without you, there is darkness for us even in the sky. You are like the bright moon that keeps the earth bright. How can the night be dark, so long as the moon of your face is shining? Even the day is in darkness without the light of your face. Because of you, all of us, inspite of residing upon the earth have gone higher than the heavens. And without you, even if we settle in the sky, we will be lowly like earth. Heavens are at higher visible levels, but the clean soul has its greater height in the matter of inner meanings. Apparent height is for the bodies, but as against contents, a body is high only in name. For God’s sake, put a glance on us. Do not disappoint us. Our sorrow has become too much to bear with”.

chapters.title: Refusal to come out
chapters.subtitle: Minister’s Reply that he Would not Give up Seclusion

paras: The wazir said: “Do not proceed too much in your arguments. Reduce them. Provide a way for advice to your heart and soul. If you have trust in me, you should know that as one trusted upon, I cannot be wrong, even if I call the sky as earth. If I am considered as perfect by you, why should you refuse to accept my perfectness? And, if I am not, then, why is there such a trouble and pain? I am not going out of my seclusion, as I am engaged in the affairs of the spiritual world”.

chapters.title: Entreatment by Disciples
chapters.subtitle: Repeated Entreating of the Disciples on Seclusion

paras: All of them said: “What we say is not out of the rejection of your status. We are not strangers to you. We have the highest regard for you. We say all this because, your separation has caused a continuing flow of tears from our eyes; and we are in constant sighs. A child does not quarrel with his mother. He does not cry to trouble her. He cries only out of his pain without knowing whether it is good or bad. We are like a musical instrument; and it is you who are playing it. Our cries are not ours but yours.

sections.heading: This is an Address to God
paras: “We are like the flute and the sound in it is because of You. We are like the hill and the echo is of Your own sound. We are like the pieces on the chessboard and the winning or losing of the game is only Yours. What are we before You? You are the life of our lives. You are all in all; and before You, we have no existence. We and our existence are non-existing. You are the absolute existence. Our existence is only a possibility, and You are a proof of this possibility. We come into existence because of You and get lost; and real existence is only Yours.

“We are like lions drawn on a flag. When the flag flutters in the wind, it gives an appearance that the lion is pouncing. This is only an appearance due to the blowing of the wind and wind itself is unseeable and hidden from our sight; but the pouncing of the lion appears due to its blowing. That invisible air is the real existence as its impacts are found and seen by the heart. Our air and our existence are Your grant. The existence of all of us is due to Your creative activity. You have brought us into an existence, which did not exist. You showed the taste of existence to the non-existing and made the non-existent to love You. Do not take back the taste of Your grant and do not take back the wine, cup and the accompanying eatables.

sections.heading: All Acts by God alone
paras: “And if you take them back, who is there to search and trace them? How can the painting drawn on the canvas quarrel with the painter? Do not look at us and upon our material possessions; but look at Your great acts of granting and generosity. We did not exist, nor we made any demand for it, but Your concern for us without telling or hearing from us brought us into existence. It is the painter that brings out the painting with his brush and colour, but the painting itself is totally helpless and weak like the baby in the womb. All creations before nature are like the needle upon the cloth. It is the knitter who uses the needle and the needle of its own, has nothing to do. It is the knitter who makes the design on the fabric and not the needle. Sometimes he makes a figure of man and sometimes of the devil on the fabric, and sometimes the scenes of joy and sometimes of mourning”.

sections.heading: Exegesis of: You Did not Throw, But Allah Threw
paras: There is no hand which can act, on its own. God is the mover and stopper of hands. There is no sound of words which can cause profit or loss. If you want to know this in full, read the exegesis of this ayat of the Quran: you did not throw when you threw, but it is God who threw: wa maa ramaita iz ramaita walakinna Allaha ramaa. (Surah Anfal: 8:17). [This refers to the Prophet’s praying and throwing a handful of dust at the enemy, symbolical of their rushing blindly to their fate, at the beginning of the battle of Badr. This had a great psychological effect. This ayat says that it was not the Prophet who threw dust, but it was God who threw, through the Prophet’s hand. (explanations in short as given by Abdullah Yusuf Ali, in “Holy Quran”)]

If we shoot an arrow from our bow, it should be understood that it is not that we, who shoot but God shoots. We ourselves are like the bow and God is the shooter. But this does not mean predestination (jabr). It only explains the meaning of predestination.

sections.heading: Predestination and Free will are Mixed Up
paras: The reference to predestination is only to show man’s helplessness. [Predestination comes only in the fact that an arrow can be shot only through a bow and not otherwise, or simply by hand. Bow is a must for shooting. But its using is by man, and man’s hand, and not by his feet or neck or leg. But it is God who teaches the use of bow to man and makes him shoot at the appropriate time and target. Thus, predestination and free will are mixed up. The Prophet threw the dust which, though a very ordinary act, was very effective psychologically both upon his men and on the enemies. A handful of dust became much more effective than a huge storm. This effectiveness was God’s making in view of the intended result, but it was done not directly by him, but through the hand of the Prophet. The same by another man’s hand, or at some other time would not have had the desired effect. Thus, there was predestined result coupled with the free will of the Prophet - Translator’s explanation]

sections.heading: Why Man Regrets upon Failures
paras: Our weakness is an evidence of our helplessness on a predestined result; and our feeling ashamed of our weakness is our free will; because, had there been no free will, there would have been no sense of shame. Why does a man regret and feel ashamed and seek satisfaction or mental peace through some means? He does all this because, he feels he has free will. Similarly, there are many such cases. Why do the teachers show anger and resentment and chastise pupils? Why are human instincts engaged in planning and making efforts?

You may say that the teachers, planners, effort-makers are not aware of predestination; that they take everything as in their hands. God’s moon is hidden for them behind His clouds. There are very suitable replies to these questions if you are prepared to hear. By knowing these, you will be protected from infidelity, and incline towards religion.

sections.heading: Impacts of Sickness, Pain, and Troubles
paras: Sense of frustration and helplessness comes about during sickness. This is a product of a greater self-awakening and understanding. Thus, sickness provides greater self-information to the sick person. In this period, you repent for your sins and decide to avoid them as the viciousness of sins becomes clearer to you. You even make a strong decision that you will not do anything other than worship and do only good acts in the remaining part of your life. This clearly shows that sickness gives you greater certainty, consciousness, and awakening. Therefore, be sure to confirm this reality that pain and trouble give more information and knowledge than comforts and joys.

A man conscious of more things of life is more full of pain and concern. More informed person is more fearful and cautious and anxious and treads very carefully in his path. If you feel that all this is predestined for him, and he is under compulsion to be like that, why do you not put the same upon your own self and consider yourself also under compulsion like him. What is generally seen is, people do not think of predestination and compulsion in respect of all things, on their own. For example: how can a man under compulsion show generosity and charity? How can a broken wooden log be useful as a pillar?

sections.heading: Success Attributed to Free will and Failure to Fate
paras: A man under compulsion of circumstances cannot have pleasures of life. A prisoner in the prison cannot enjoy freedom. A man in troubles cannot be happy. If you see that your hands and feet are tied and a policeman is standing upon you to restrain your movements, you feel that you should not stand as a watchman upon others as this is not a habit and nature of the week and helpless people to oppress others. If you see such a person oppressing others, do not believe him to be under troubles. A man in trouble does not trouble others. And if you see him committing oppression, seek evidence of the fact that he is in troubles, as a man in troubles does not trouble others. There is no need to attribute all these to predestination and compulsions from God. These are matters of human nature.

You see your power clearly in acts, which are in accordance with your inclination. And in those of the acts which are otherwise and opposed to desire, you speak of predestination (fate) and of compulsion by God.

Prophets abstain themselves in worldly matters and leave them to fate, but in matters of the next world, they become free-willers and put all efforts to act. They consider the jobs of next life as matters of free will and choice for themselves and the jobs of this world as of free will for the infidels, because every bird goes towards its species. It sends forth its soul in front of itself and follows it from behind. Infidels are connected with “Sijjiin” and they understand the laws and writings of the prison of this world very well.

Sijjiin is a record of the vile who are in the dungeons of this world and consequently of the dungeons of that world too. Prophets are of the species of “Illyiin”, record of the righteous; and therefore, they go toward ‘Illyiin’ with all their heart and soul.
O God, show to our soul that place where statements of facts are made without words and letters. There is no end to these affairs and therefore, we revert the left-over story of the vicious minister.

chapters.title: Disappointed Disciples
chapters.subtitle: Disappointment of Disciples with the Minister’s Seclusion

paras: The minister from within his secluded place said: “O my disciples! Know this from my side that Jesus Christ has given instructions to me to remain away from all friends and relatives. Keep yourself within the four walls in loneliness. Keep yourself away even from yourself. After this, there will be no instructions regarding talks. I shall have no more concern with any talk. Therefore, goodbye, my friends! I am dead now. I have taken all my possessions to the fourth heaven to be with Jesus, who is also in the fourth heaven, so that I may not burn in the sphere of fire like fuel in hardship and pain. Thereafter, I shall sit by the side of Jesus upon the heights of the fourth heaven”.

chapters.title: Appointment of viceregents
chapters.subtitle: The Minister’s Appointment of Separate leaders as Vicegerents

paras: Then he called the leaders, one by one, separately and in privacy and talked to them differently. He told everyone:” You are the representatives of God and my vicegerent for the followers of Christianity. All other leaders are subordinate to you. Jesus has made all of them as your followers. If any of the leaders refuses to obey you, you may arrest him, kill him, or put him in prison. But, do not speak of this, as long as I am alive; and also, do not try to take the leadership till then. You should not reveal these instructions to anyone till my death and make a claim of leadership and dominion. Take this record and the instructions of Jesus and read the instructions therein, one by one, before the community”.

In this manner he said the same to each of the leaders separately that there is none other than him as the vicegerent of God in religious matters. He honoured each one of them. What he said to one, he said to the others. He gave a record to each of them, the contents, and objects of each of these records were different and opposing to the other. The wordings of all these records were as different as the alphabets. The command in one record was different from that in the other one. That difference has been already explained by me. Head to feet they were different from each other. This also I have explained in detail.

chapters.title: Suicide to Cause Unrest
chapters.subtitle: The Minister Killed Himself in Seclusion

paras: Thereafter, the minister kept himself again in seclusion for further forty days and then killed himself and got rid of his own existence. When the people came to know of his death, the place of his burial became a place of turmoil like the one on the doomsday. Uncountable numbers of people assembled at his grave tearing their clothes, pulling their hair, and crying and shrieking. Only God could count their numbers. They included all types— Arabs, Turks, Romans, and Kurds. They throw dust into their heads and considered their weeping as the only solace for his separation. They remained at the grave for a month and shed tears of blood from their eyes. Everyone was in the grief and pain of his separation from him including kings, common and great men.

chapters.title: Choice of Viceregent
chapters.subtitle: Christians Attempt to find out the Minister’s Vicegerent

paras: After a month, the people asked the leaders: “Who is the one among the leaders who should act as a leader in place of the minister, so that we may all accept him as such, so that our jobs are done through him. We shall be obedient to him and hold on to his hand and lapel. When the sun has set and left us in the dark, a lamp becomes necessary in its place. When the face of the friend goes away from us, we are in need of a memorial in his place. When the season of flowers has gone and the garden spoiled, we cannot think of flower’s fragrance other than through their extracts.

sections.heading: Form and Reality of Things
paras: When God cannot come into our observation the prophets should be taken as His representatives. I am sorry. I have said wrongly about the representatives and the appointer of representatives. It would be improper and wrong to take the two as different. They are not two. They are considered as two by those who look at the faces and forms, but for those who have gone beyond the forms, they are one. If you look at the form, you have two eyes; but if you look at their seeing capacity and acts, they are one in action. Both of them see things together as a single eye itself would do. When their light falls on a thing, you will see it as one and not as two. There cannot be any difference in the capacity to look at and functioning, if you look at their light and not at the eyes.

chapters.title: All Prophets Said the Same
chapters.subtitle: To Explain: all prophets are on the Same Truth (God): “We make no Distinction between one and another of His Apostles” (Quran:S:2:285)

sections.heading: Where all are One
paras: If ten lamps burn together in one room, each one of them is different in its form, but no distinction can be made in the light of each of them if you look at the light and not at the lamps. Search for this meaning in the Quran which says: la nufarriqu baina ahadin min rusulihi. We make no distinction between one and another of His apostles.: (Surah Baqara: 2:285).

If you count a hundred apples, they are a hundred in numbers, but if you crush them and extract their juice, they all become one in it. There is no division in meanings. So also, in analysis and understanding, and the reality of anything is in its meaning.

Mingling of a friend with friends gives happiness. Hold on to the meanings and not to the forms and words. Melt the forms of things by hard and constant austerities to reach to the treasure of unity underneath. And, if it does not melt with your austerities, God’s graces will melt it and take you to the object. He exhibits Himself in the hearts and sews the apparels of the darvishes and brings together the broken and separated parts.

sections.heading: Spiritual Unity, Material Variety
paras: We were all only one element in the vast expanse of the space or the world of spirits. We did not have heads and limbs; and He was our leader and lord. We were all one great bright gem like the sun, clean and clear like water, without dullness of any kind. When that bright light assumed the different shapes of matter of the universe, the number increased just as the shadow of a grill. Shatter this grill into pieces with the strokes of a large boulder, so that this difference caused by the grill is destroyed with the destruction of the grill itself. Destroy the destroyer of unity to bring about unity.

chapters.title: Talk to People Appropriately
chapters.subtitle: To Explain the Meaning of What the Prophet said: Talk to the common people according to their Wisdom as they will reject what they cannot understand and cause loss to themselves. And Prophet Muhammad’s saying: Umirna an nuzila alnaasa manaa ziluhum: we have been ordered to Maintain the grades of the People

paras: I am reluctant to speak much on this topic. Otherwise, I would explain on its secrets in great detail. I am afraid that someone may not slip down and misunderstand. Secret points are sharp like the sharp sword. You should not face it if you do not have a shield to defend yourself. Do not stand before this sword without a shield as the sword is never afraid of cutting anything that it faces. For this reason, I have kept my sword of meanings in the scabbard of curtains, so that one in the habit of perverse reading may not read in the opposite way.

Now, we have almost reached the end of the story of the mischievous minister with the sincerity of approach of the groups of his friends, who had risen up to lead the people after the death of the minister, who were prepared to become his vicegerents as appointed by him.

chapters.title: Mutual quarrels
chapters.subtitle: Quarrels of the Leaders with Each Other

paras: One among the leaders came forward before the devoted and honest community and said: “I am the vicegerent of that man and I am the vicegerent of Jesus. This record is the evidence of my claim that the viceregency belongs to me”.

Another leader came forward, and his claim for viceregency was similar. He also presented his record of evidence from out of his armpit where he had held it firmly. Then, both of them got angry with each other and stood firmly to their claim. The other leaders also came forward in ranks and took out their swords. Each one of them had a record and sword in the hand and they all fell upon each other like intoxicated elephants. Every leader had a large army and their soldiers removed their swords from the scabbards. Hundreds of thousands of the Christians got killed and there were heaps of their severed heads. Blood flowed like flood on the right and left side; and there were mountains upon mountains of dust in the air. The seeds of mischiefs that he had sowed became a great calamity upon their heads.

Men, who have clean and good soul within, leave it free after death, just as walnuts with good seeds within produce the seeds after breaking. Killing and getting killed is related to the body and it is like breaking a walnut and pomegranate. What is sweet and tasty becomes valuable, and the rotten ones produce only crackling sound upon breaking. Walnut containing the seed is like the fragrant musk and the rotten one is nothing but dust.

sections.heading: Apparent Faces and Inner Meanings
paras: Whatever has inner meanings becomes good, and the meaningless gets disgraced. Therefore, the one going after the apparent shape should go towards the inner contents and meanings, as meanings are like the feathers for the apparent body with which the body flies above. Therefore, go with those who know the inner meanings and not just words so that you may gain rewards and be brave and bold to face realities. A meaningless soul in this body is like a wooden sword wrapped up in a casing. So long as it is hidden in the wraps, it will be considered as valuable, but when it comes out, it will be taken as worthy of fuel for burning in fire. That is the case with such souls that become worthy of becoming the fuel for hell. Do not take a wooden sword to the battlefield. Before taking it for battle, better check it up. If you find it to be of wood, throw it and take another. And if you have a sharp sword, face the enemy with pleasure.

sections.heading: Company of Wise and Saintly
paras: If you want to take a sharp sword of the soul take it from the armoury of the saints. Mere looking at such a sword or at the saints is an alchemy for your soul with which it will be polished and brightened like gold. All wise men have agreed upon this fact that the wise people are a mercy for both the worlds, as Prophet Muhammad was called as such, by God. However, you should be careful. If you buy a pomegranate you should buy an open one as its opening speaks the worth of its seeds.

That smiling face is a cause of prosperity which exhibits pearl-like clean and shining heart from out of the jewel box of the soul. Adverse smile is like that of the lilac which exhibits a black spot of the heart from its inside. Smiling-open-pomegranate makes the entire garden smile. Company of great men like saints also makes you saintly. A moment’s company of the saints is better than a hundred years of hidden, unostentatious worship. If you are a stone like granite or marble and reach the hands of an efficient creative hand you will become a gem. Keep yourself in the company of the clean and clean-hearted benevolent men and never keep the love of anyone in your heart other than of the joyous clean-hearted ones.

sections.heading: Develop Hope, Not Despair
paras: Do not enter into the street of desperation, as there are plenty of hopes to rely upon. Do not go towards darkness but towards the sun-like saints. Your heart drags you towards the street of such hearty souls, but your body drags you towards the prison of water and mud. That is: the pleasure of the heart is in spiritual attainment, but of the body is in worldly physical pleasures. You should take some food from such people of heart and search for good fortune from such fortunate ones. Hold on to the hand of a man of the richness of the heart and be in his service so as to attain greatness and prosperity. Company of the good people makes you good; and company of the bad unfortunate ones makes you bad.

chapters.title: Praise of H. Muhammad in the Gospel
chapters.subtitle: Praise of the Honour of Muhammad was in the Gospel

paras: The name of Muhammad Mustafa, leader of all the prophets, the ocean of purity was there in the Gospel. There was reference to his personality and posture and about his food habits, fastings and battles. A group of Christians when reaching the stage of his name and narratives in the book used to kiss his prosperous name and keep their faces on the praises about him. In this narrative, the group about which I have stated such people had no fear and risk of any matter. They were not afraid of any reprimand from the minister and leaders being under the protection of Ahmad, the protector. Their tribe increased, which became supporter of the light and guidance of H. Muhammad

There was yet another group of Christians, which dishonoured his name. They were humbled and disgraced because of internal strife, under the misguidance and senseless versions of men like the minister (whose story is mentioned earlier). This group became lowly and dishonoured and got deprived of religion and good manners. Because of false and wrong versions, their faith and laws got disturbed.

When the name of Ahmad gives support in this manner, imagine how much support his light may give. When the name of Ahmad becomes a strong fort against all corruptions, what can be the status of Gabriel, the trustworthy spirit and the go-between God and Jesus Christ?

chapters.title: Another Anti-Christian Jewish King
chapters.subtitle: Story of Another Jewish king who Struggled to Destroy the Religion of Jesus Christ

paras: After that unavoidable bloodshed that was caused by the scheming minister, there came about another Jewish king who was determined to destroy the community of Jesus Christ. Read the Surah: Buruj or the Zodiacal signs in the Quran (Surah 85): wa assaamai’i zaati al buruj: (ayat 4,5 and 6): Woe to the destruction that overtook the owners of the ditch, of the fuel-fed fire. Makers of the pit (of fire). Fire supplied abundantly with fuel. Behold! They sat over against the fire.

[That was Zu-Nuwas a Jewish king of Yemen who persecuted Christians of Najran by burning them at the stake, in the sixth century before the birth of the Prophet in 570 AD. Earlier, Nimrud had tried to burn H. Ibrahim for his faith. In mediaeval Europe, many persons were burnt for non-conforming with established religious Christian beliefs. Fire has been in use to kill enemies. Even in our days, fire and excessive heat are used in the form of bombs and missiles by organised armies. Rebels use petrol bombs and so on. In India there has been the practice of burning brides on the funeral pyre of the husbands. Fire is worshipped as God; and yagnas are performed by sitting around it. Fire has been a favourite means of torture and killing and is witnessed with pleasure by the enemies —Translator]

sections.heading: Originators of Good and Bad Acts Continue through Followers
paras: The practice that one king started was followed by another. Whoever created a wrong method has always met with curses at every moment. God will question to initiators of such cruel acts which also become precedents for others. Good people have passed away leaving their precedents; and the mean fellows left intact the cruelties and consequent curses. Whatever is committed upto the doomsday by their followers, continues to be staring at them. There is sweet water and saltish water flowing in the veins of the people, which will go upto the day when the trumpet of the doomsday is blown.

Good people will inherit sweet water, and whatever is inheritable by them will be given to them as stated in the Quran: then We gave the scripture as inheritance to those whom We chose of our bondsmen: (Surah: Faatir: 35:32). The inheritance here refers to their good conduct and sincere worship.

If you think well, the offerings of the seekers of goodness are like the lights of prophethood. These lights move around the gems, the gems being those seekers who have become saints. These lights go towards the saints. Light from the sun falls on all the sides of the house, as the sun moves from one constellation to another. Similarly, the sun of prophethood has been shining upon different prophets at different times. Thus, their light has come from the same source and therefore, all have been saying the same thing on the matters of religion.

sections.heading: Impacts of Stars on People
paras: Everyone is connected with his star and moves along with it. If Venus happens to rise upon him, he will be in pleasures and comforts and will be very much inclined towards love and closeness. And if he is connected to Mars, he is cruel in nature, and will search for quarrels, enmity and hostility. It is not their direct impacts, but as designed by God. [Of their own they do not have any power on men and cannot alter their impacts at will —Qazi Sajjad Hussain]

sections.heading: Saints are like Stars
paras: There are other stars behind these stars in constellations which do not cause fire and misfortune. Again, there are those moving about in the heaven which are apart from the seven well known heavens. They are the saints who remain strong with the impacts of the warmth of the light of God. They are neither together like the other stars in the constellations nor are they faraway from each other. The one under the influence of these stars is capable of throwing fire upon the impacts of infidelity. His anger is not hot and fiery like the influence of the planet Mars but has both the qualities of the dominant and dominated. He is a dominated light which is protected from eclipses and darkness; and is between two fingers of the light of God. God spreads that light upon the souls of these fortunate. Those accepted by God, receive its benefits. Such a person turns his face away from everything other than God. One who does not have a lapel of love does not have a share in it.

sections.heading: Colour of God, the Best
paras: Parts of things turn towards the whole. Bulbuls turn their face towards the flowers with whom they are in love. Colours of the animals are seen on their outer skins, but man’s colour has to be seen within him, be it red or yellow. Colour of the good people is from a clean vessel of clean water and that of the vicious is dirty and black. The former is called as the colour of God and the latter as the curse of God. God speaks of his colour as: sibghatu allahi! Wa man ahsanu minaallahi sibghatan: colour from Allah! And who is better than Allah is colouring? (Surah Baqara:2;138) [This colouring refers to the practice of the Arab Christians mixing a dye or colour in the baptismal water, signifying that the baptised person got a new colour in life. We do not believe that it is necessary to be baptised to be saved. Our higher baptism is the ‘baptism’ of God, by which we take the colour (symbolically) of God and absorb his goodness in us —Abdullah Yusuf Ali. Page 56: The Holy Quran]

Water from the oceans goes out of it (in the form of vapour) and comes back to it (in the form of rain). Fierce floods start from the peaks of mountains. In similar manner the soul full of love moves about in our bodies.

chapters.title: Compelling People to Idol-Worship
chapters.subtitle: The king’s collecting Fire and Keeping an Idol beside it to be Prostrated by People, to be relieved from Fire

paras: See what that doggish king designed. He kept an idol by the side of a large fire-pit saying that whoever prostrated to the idol would be released; and if not, would be thrown into the pit.

sections.heading: Idols of Vicious Self
paras: The king had not given punishment to the idol of his own vicious self. Therefore, another idol took birth from his vicious self. The mother of all idols is your own vicious self, because that new idol is a serpent, and your vicious self is a python. Your vicious self is like iron and stone, and the idol is like the fire coming from them. This fire can be extinguished with water. But the fire hidden within the iron and stone cannot be extinguished with water; and man cannot remain in peace in the presence of these two. Iron and stone keep fire hidden within them; and water has no capacity to reach up to their fire. Water extinguishes the external fire but does not do so with the hidden fire of the stone and iron. Iron and stone are the fountains of fire and smoke; and infidelity, Zoroastrianism and Judaism are their drops. Idols are like black (polluted) water kept in a pot and the vicious self is the fountain of that black (polluted) water. The carved-out idol is like a flood of black water and the vicious self of the idol maker is like a fountain on the highway. Idol is like polluted water in a pot, and your unfortunate vicious self is its fountain.

sections.heading: Carved Idols: Easy to Break But not Vicious Self
paras: A piece of a stone thrown upon a hundred pots, can break them, but when it is thrown upon the forceful fountain, it instantly repels it back. Water from a tumbler or pot gets exhausted, but of the fountain continues to last. Breaking the idol is so very easy, but not the vicious self. Considering it easy is ignorance in extremity. If you want to see the face of the vicious self, learn about the hell consisting of seven doors. [The seven doors are: Saqar (scorching fire), Sa‘iir (Blazing fire), Lazha (flaming fire), Hutama (Crushing disaster), Jahiim (Fierce), Jahannum (Hell), and Haaviatun (abyss). These doors are in fact, the acts of the vicious self.] Every breath of it has a treachery and every treachery sinks in water along with a hundred Pharaohs and Pharaonic arrogance. Therefore, run toward H. Musa and Musa’s God; and do not disgrace faith with Pharaonic behaviour. Hold on to the hand of Muhammad and establish connections with God and get rid of the Abu Jahl of the body.

chapters.title: Throwing a Baby in Fire
chapters.subtitle: The Jewish King’s Bringing a Faithful Woman with a Baby and throwing the Baby into Fire, and Baby’s talking in the Midst of Fire

paras: The Jewish king brought a woman with a baby near the blazing fire and the idol and asked her to prostrate before the idol or be ready to get burnt in fire. She was a faithful woman following a pure religion and she refused. He snatched the baby from her hands and threw him into fire. The woman got frightened and kept her faith away and prepared to prostrate before the idol. Suddenly the child cried out and said: “I have not died, mother! I am quite alright, though apparently, I am in fire. You too may come over to me here.”

sections.heading: Fire is No Fire for Good Souls

“Fire acts like a curtain to hide certain things and expose others, as in magic; otherwise, it is of great benefit and shows many hidden things. Come inside my mother and see an evidence of the Truth and the comforts of the close friends of God. Come in and see cold water in the form of fire; come out from the world, the water of which is like fire. Come inside and know the secrets of H. Ibrahim who got roses and jasmines.
paras: “At the time, you delivered me. I thought as though I am seeing death and I was in terrible fear of coming out of you. When I actually came out, I found out that I was released from a narrow prison and came out in colourful wide world. Now, I see this world as that narrow world of your womb and find this fire as a place of peace and pleasure. I have seen in this fire, a new world in which every particle is like the life-giving breath of H. Ia.

“Now, I am in a new world which appears to be dead, but in truth is alive and existing. The world I left was actually a temporary world. Come inside, my mother, and perform your maternal duties and see that this fire has no properties of the fire of that world. Come inside, my mother, and be fortunate and do not miss this great wealth. You have seen the power of that dog, now come here to see the might and benevolence of God. I am untying your feet from the chains of the world out of my love for you; as otherwise, I am so happy that I have no care for you. Come inside and call others too, as the Great King has spread his dining table for us.

“O people, do come all of you into this fire which has a hundred springs in it. Come inside all of you, O Muslims (believers of God), there is sweet water here; so sweet and pleasing that all other things are a pain before it. Come inside and see how the blazing fire has gone cold. Come inside, O dejected and despoiled people! You will be protected from all punishments. Come inside this deep ocean so that your soul may be completely cleansed and softened”.

The child’s mother threw herself near him and caught hold of him with all affection. She entered into fire and won the game and got the reward. She also started telling like the child and started stringing together the pearls of God’s graces and love. She was calling upon the people around the fire pit, and their souls were getting filled with greatness. She called out at the people: “Come and see a garden in this fire”.

chapters.title: People’s falling into fire
chapters.subtitle: People Enthusiastically Throwing Themselves into Fire

paras: Then the people lost control of themselves and started throwing themselves into fire. They did this without anybody’s calling and persuasion because of their love for their friend who was none other than God, as the conversion of every bitter thing into sweet is by Him alone. This went on to such an extent that the soldiers who were appointed to throw people into fire, started preventing them from doing so. The black faced Jewish king felt ashamed, with a heavy heart and worry. More and more people fell with the love of falling into fire to destroy their bodies and to purify their souls. It was a thankful situation that the treachery of the devil fell upon himself and he blackened his face himself and looked at it. The black colour that he wanted to put on the faces of others collected on his own face. The one who wanted to tear the clothes of others got his own clothes torne, and on the contrary the clothes of others got darned.

chapters.title: Mocking at Prophet Muhammad
chapters.subtitle: Distortion of the Face of the Person who Mocked at the Prophet

paras: One who distorted his own face when he took the name of H. Muhammad to mock at him got his own face really distorted. Then, he came to the Prophet and sought his pardon telling: “O the generous, you have great generosity and knowledge from God himself (‘ilmi ladunnii), please pardon me. I made fun of you out of my ignorance, though in fact, it was me that should be laughed at”.

sections.heading: Repentants Get Absolved
paras: When God wishes that someone should be put to disgrace, he makes him inclined towards making taunts upon the noble people. If he wishes that someone’s defects should be unknown to others, he does not speak of the defects of others. If God desires to help us, he makes us to incline towards humility.

Those eyes are very prosperous which cry for the sake of God; and that heart is very prosperous that gets burnt in His love. The end of every cry is a laughter. The one who thinks of the end of everything, is prosperous. Wherever water flows, greenery comes about and wherever tears flow for God from His bondsmen, prosperity appears. Be always in cries and with wet eyes like the waterwheel, so that greenery may grow in the surroundings of your soul.

The noble Prophet felt pity for that man and pardoned him, when he became bold and repented for his mistake. If you want to be pitied by others, you may show mercy for a man in tears and so also upon the weak fellows.

chapters.title: King’s anger with fire
chapters.subtitle: The Jewish King’s anger upon the Fire as to why it does not cause Burns

paras: The King turned towards the fire and said: “O ill tempered! What happened to your nature of setting things on fire? Why do you not burn? What happened to your nature? Or is it that, due to our misfortune, your intentions have changed? You are such that you do not spare even your worshippers. But how is it that your non-worshipper is spared? O fire, you are never patient and slow. Why don’t you burn? What has happened that you have lost your power. Oh! What is it? Is it some magic that has shut up the eyes, or something that has inactivated the senses, that such a high blaze is not causing burns? Has someone cast a magic spell on you or, something has hidden your capacities from our sight; or is it our misfortune that has made you go against your nature?”

The fire replied: “I am that very fire that you have seen all along. Come into me and see my heat. My nature has not changed, and I continue to be the same element. But I am a sword of God, and I slay only upon His command. Dogs of the Turkomans stay at the openings of their tents and welcome and please the guests; but when a stranger comes, they pounce upon him like wild lions. I am no lesser than a dog in my loyalty and slavishness, and God, the Great is no lesser than the Turk in His might.”

sections.heading: Fire of Good and Bad Soul
paras: If the fire of your conduct puts you in sorrow, it is due to the burns caused by your fire with the command of the Master and rewarder of punishment. If the fire of your conduct keeps you in pleasure, the rewarder of the good acts puts pleasure in it. You should repent when you feel sorrow within yourself, as sorrow performs its acts upon the command of God. If He wishes, even absolute sorrow becomes pleasure and the chains of the feet become freedom. Air, earth, fire, and water are His obedient slaves. They appear as dead-lifeless-matter in our-view, but from God’s view they are very much alive like other living beings. Fire always stands in obedience before God like a lover standing for the beloved as a lifeless, obedient fellow, day and night.

sections.heading: Quality of Fire Caused by Causer
paras: If you strike a rock with iron, fire comes out. It also comes out with the command of God. Therefore, do not strike iron and stone of cruelties together, as both of them breed children like men and women in togetherness. Rock and iron are causes in themselves if you just look at them. But look above and beyond them, you will see that the cause is caused by another cause or Causer. A cause does not come about of its own, without another cause. This cause is converted into another cause by the other Causer, who at times, takes away the causes and suspends them.

sections.heading: Causes, Effects and Causer
paras: Those causes are guides to the prophets, which are much above the normal causes. Our wisdom knows these causes and those causes are known only to the prophets. These causes are plain and clear before us; and those causes are plain and clear only to the prophets. What is this cause? Take an example of the rope, which has come to the well with a means or cause, and goes in and comes out with the movement of the wheel.

Philosophers say that the rotation of the heaven is the cause of all effects. Tell them that the causes are like the rope which does not come in and go out of the well, on its own, but brought in and out by the wheel. The rotation of the heaven is not the cause but an effect like the rope which is an effect of the cause. The rotation of the heaven is an effect, which is caused by the Causer. It is wrong to avoid looking at the Causer Who has caused the rotation of the heaven. There are a large number of such ropes of causes in the world. Do not ever consider them to be caused by the rotating heaven, so that you may not remain devoid of proper understanding and be mentally rotating like the rotating heaven; and do not burn like oil. Air and fire come into existence with God’s command and both of them are intoxicated with the wine provided to them by Him.

If you look towards God, the water of your grace and the fire of your wrath will also appear to you to be from God. If the soul of the wind were not to be aware of God, how could it have differentiated between the people of ‘Aad and others. The wind had completely destroyed the people of ‘Aad during the days of the prophet Huud.

chapters.title: Miracles of Prophets
chapters.subtitle: Destruction of the Community of H. Huud by Wind

paras: H. Huud drew a line around his followers. The fierce wind upon reaching this line used to become soft and slow. Whoever was outside this line was torn to pieces by the wind. In similar manner saint Shaiban, the shepherd, used to draw a line around his flock of sheep, while going for the Jumma prayer, so that any wolf may not cause trouble to his sheep. No wolf used to get inside this circle and also no sheep would come out. The winds of the greed of the wolf and the greed of the sheep were tied up within the circle drawn by this godly man.

sections.heading: Fire and Wind, Obedient to God’s Commands
paras: Similarly, the wind of death of the saints is soft and pleasant for them like the morning breeze of the garden. The fire for H. Ibrahim did not touch to trouble him. Those selected by God cannot be put to trouble by anyone. The fire of passions does not burn the religious men; but pushes the rebels down below the depths of earth. As the waves had risen with the command of God, they found out and separated the followers of H. Musa, and Copts. When earth was given a command, it dragged Qaroon, his wealth and his throne into its depths. When H. ‘Isa made a model of the bird with mud and water and breathed upon it, it became a bird and flapped its wings and flew off. When the praises of God come out of the mouth, the Lord of the morning (Rabbul Falaq) converts them into the birds of paradise. Your reciting the praises of God with your mouth is like water and mud, and the breaths of H. ‘Isa, with the sincerity of heart, make it a bird of paradise. The Mount of Toor with the light of H. Musa started dancing and became a perfect saint and got rid of all impurities. There is no wonder in it, if the mount became a saint: after all, the body of H. Musa was also made of mud.

chapters.title: Refusal of Advice
chapters.subtitle: Taunts and Rejection of the Advice by the King

paras: When the Jewish king saw those wonders; he did nothing but taunting and rejection. His advisors told him: “Do not go beyond limits. Do not run your fighting horse so fast. Stop killing and give up these vicious acts, and do not put your own life into fire”. The king tied their hands and put them in prison and thus stitched patches upon patches of cruelty. When this went to this extent a voice called: “Stop all this, O dog! The time of calamity for you has arrived”.

sections.heading: Objects Go back to Origin
paras: Thereafter, a forty-yard-high flame sprang up, surrounded, and burnt down all the Jews. Fire was the element of which they were made from the beginning itself, like Iblis, and ultimately reached their source. They were all born out of fire only and therefore the parts returned to the whole. Those mean fellows were born out of fire and talked of fire and smoke. They were only fire and burners of the faithful. And fire itself killed them like a scrap of wood.

sections.heading: Things go to Their Origin
paras: One who is at the base of the bottomless hellfire will have his place in its corner. Mother of a child searches for her child, and roots of the trees are after the branches. Though water is entrenched in the pond, air absorbs it as both are elemental. Air absorbs water from the pond and takes it to its place of origin, that is, the hydrosphere, in a slow, stealthy, invisible manner, so that nobody may observe this stealing. Similarly, our breaths also take our life little by little so as to release us from the prison of this world.

So much so, our good words rise above towards God and reach the place which He knows. With our piety, our breaths also go above like gifts to the everlasting world. Then we get double of the rewards of benevolence for our words from the Lord of Majesty. Then, He puts us in the company of those like us, so that we may get from them that we have given to them. In this manner, our words rise above towards Him, and His grants come down to us.

sections.heading: Species Belong to Genus
paras: I have said of these things in Arabic (para above), but now I say in Persian as it has an attraction coming from the place of our liking. Every (nation) looks towards the side from where it has had some pleasure, some day. Certainly, species have a liking and enjoyment with their genus. You may see a part having its attraction for the whole. But there is affinity between those of other genus also, when they are of such kind which can be mixed up and become part of the other genus. Such as, water and bread are not of our genus, but when consumed, they become one like us, and add to our increase. Bread and water do not belong to our genus in the beginning but in the end, they become one with us. Therefore, they may also be called as of our genus.

sections.heading: Temporary and permanent Connections
paras: Many a times a different genus may have a taste like ours, but this connection is temporary, and therefore, it does not last long. A bird has a taste for the sound of another one of its genus. When it hears that sound as created by the catcher, it moves towards it, but on not finding a bird, it flies off. A thirsty man mistakes a mirage as a source of water and goes towards it, but on finding no water there, he returns and goes in search of water elsewhere. Some ignorant poor people get pleased with a counterfeit coin, but upon going to the mint they find the truth and they lose interest in it.

Be careful! Let not a cheat put you away from the path. Be careful! A wrong impression may not drop you in a well. Search for the appropriate story in the discussions of Kaleela and Damna and seek your share in it. You might have read something in it, but that is only a rind of the story and not its pulp.

[Kaleela and Damna is the name of a book containing a dialogue between two jackals, in which many statements of wisdom come about. The original book is supposed to be in Sanskrit and a Persian version of it was presented to Calif Haroon Rashid who got it translated into Arabic. Its Persian and Sanskrit versions are extinct. From its Arabic version, it was translated into many languages including Persian – Qazi Sajjad Hussain]

chapters.title: Story of Forest Animals
chapters.subtitle: Story of the Forest Animals and Explanation of Trust in God and Avoidance of Struggles

paras: A group of animals in a fertile valley used to have continuous conflict with a lion, as the lion used to randomly kill animals frequently and the valley became very unsuitable for them. They all went to the lion and placed a proposal; saying: “We are prepared to provide sufficient food for you. You should not go for any killing except for your food, so that the grass here may not become bitter for us”.

chapters.title: Not to be Bitten Twice
chapters.subtitle: Lion’s Reply to the Animals and Explanation of the Meaning of Struggle

paras: The lion said:” I agree, provided that I should see honesty and not tricks. I have seen many tricks being played by many kinds of people. I have been under great loss due to the acts and words of the people. I have been bitten by scorpions and snakes. My soul from my inside is always in precaution. Treachery and meanness are the worst things to be seen among men. My ears have heard the statement of the noble Prophet, which I have accepted with all my heart and soul. It is: laa yaldughu al muninu min juhru Wahidin marratain: a faithful man does not get bitten twice from the same hole.

chapters.title: Trust in God
chapters.subtitle: Further Pleading of the Animals upon preferring Trust in God to Struggle

paras: All of them said: “O well informed master, forget precaution. It does not protect you from fate. Efforts to seek protection rouse turmoil and mischief. Repose confidence in God. It is better. No doubt, you are very fast and strong; but do not try to quarrel with God’s decision, so that God’s decision may not stand against you. We should be like dead bodies so that the separating Lord (Rabbul Falaq) may not separate your possessions of pride, honour and power from you”.

chapters.title: Work, preferable to trust
chapters.subtitle: Further Arguments of the Lion to Prefer work to Trust

paras: The Lion replied: “If trust is to be the factor to lead us in life, holding on to efforts also in the practice of the Prophet. He has said in loud voice: ‘Hold on to trust, but before that tie the legs of the camel’. He has also said: alkaasib habiiballah: God loves the professionals. Therefore, by holding on to trust, you may not become lazy. As against trust, work and struggle are preferable, so that you may become the beloved of God. Therefore, first put efforts and then trust; and go on toward struggle. Make efforts to earn and be always so. Work and engage yourself in struggles, so that you may get relief; and if you avoid all this; you are a fool.

chapters.title: Trust, better than Work
chapters.subtitle: Further Arguments of the Animals in favour of Trust

paras: The animals said: “Putting efforts is due to the weakness of men. You can also call it as cheating and treachery in proportion to their greed to eat. Therefore, know that the efforts are resorted to due to the weakness of confidence. Reliance upon others is wrong when there is trust in God. Therefore, the best effort is in developing trust in God as nothing else is better than this. What thing can be better than consonance with God and accepting whatever He gives and remaining satisfied with that?”

sections.heading: What has to happen will happen
paras: Many people run from one trouble to fall into another trouble. They run from the serpent and jump towards the python. Man puts efforts and these become a trap for him. Whatever he thought to be useful to his life, proved to be a taker of life. Just as it happened in the case of Pharaoh. He shut the door to prevent the enemy from entering into his house. But the enemy was in his house itself. That mean fellow killed thousands of children, and the one he was afraid of was in his house itself. That is, H. Musa. He was put into the river to protect him from being caught by policemen. And from the river he was picked up and brought to Pharaoh’s palace. We have got many defects in our eyesight. What we see as good proves to be bad. Therefore, it is better that we merge our sight with the sight of God. His sight is the best exchange with our sight as all objectives are there in His sight.

sections.heading: Efforts cause Troubles
paras: So long as a child was not able to hold anything with his hand and to walk with his feet, he did not have anything to ride upon except the neck of his father. But he resorted to do unwanted things by stretching his hands and feet. He got entangled into hardship, troubles, and darkness. Earlier, spirits of men, because of their perfectness were flying freely in the world of spirits. But upon receiving hands and feet, as men, they got imprisoned into anger, greed, and pleasures, and therefore commanded by God to get down: “ihbitu” (Surah Baqara:2:58). We all belong to the family of God and we are capable of drinking only milk like babies. It is said that all the creatures are the family of God. The one who grants rain from the sky, can possibly send bread also out of his generosity.

chapters.title: Further Stress on Efforts
