chapters.subtitle: The Lion’s Once Again Telling on the Preference of Efforts

paras: The lion said: “But you should know that the Lord of the creatures has kept a ladder in front of our feet. We have to climb up to the roof step by step. Considering fate (predestination) in such a situation is immaturity of mind. You have got the legs to walk. Why do you behave like a cripple? You have got the hands. Why do you hide your grip? When a master gives a pickaxe to the servant, his intentions can be known without his telling. God’s grant of the hands to us is like the pickaxe, indicating the purpose. If you understand these indications, you will be ready to sacrifice your life for the purpose. Then, His further indications will show you the secrets of progress. They will reduce your difficulties, and set you on work. If you are a carrier of weight on your back, He will make you a rider. If you are obedient to His commands, He will make you approvable everywhere. Become one obedient to His commands and make yourself worthy of His court. Try to go close to Him and then become closer to Him by work.

sections.heading: Not Working is Thanklessness
paras: Putting efforts and working are acts of thanksgiving to nature; and your reliance upon trust believing in predestination (fate) is a rejection of His grants. Giving thanks to grants causes increase of grants; and thanklessness and rejection of grants make the grants go out of your possession. Do not consider yourself to be helpless and fate-bound, and do not sleep on the way. So long as you do not reach the destination, you should not sleep; but sleep only thereafter. O the dependent upon the unreliable predestination, do not ever sleep excepting under the tree of the rewards of God, so that every blow of wind may shake its branches and fell fruits and food for you.

Considering yourself as helpless is like sleeping when the dacoits are all around. The rooster which crows out of time cannot save itself from the knife. Why do you pull your nose upon His directions? In spite of considering yourself as a man, you show yourself as a woman. Think over and find out. Whatever wisdom you have will fly off; and the head from which wisdom flies off becomes worthless like the tail. As thanklessness is unfortunate and adverse, it takes a thankless person into the depth of the pit. If you have to have trust, it should be upon your job. Make a living, eat well and then trust in God, the Master of predestination. Therefore, have trust in God and get deliverance, as otherwise you will be put into difficulties and misguidance”.

chapters.title: Further Stress on Trust
chapters.subtitle: Further Arguments of the Animals in Favour of Trust

paras: All the animals got wild on him and shouted: “It is only the greedy fellows who have sown the seeds of efforts. They are in hundreds and thousands, men, and women, yet, why they are all deprived? Right from the beginning of this world, hundreds of thousands of centuries have passed. All men were  opening their mouths wide like those of the pythons. Wise men have played tricks and designs, and their designs caused the mountains to be uprooted from their foundations. Those dirty fellows resorted to so many efforts and games and yet failed. If you have no confidence in what we say, look at what God of Majesty and Grandeur has said about them: they did such acts which shifted the peaks of mountains. Mighty indeed were their plots which they made, but their plots were within the sight of God, even though they were such as to shake the hills: wa qad makaruu makrahum wa indallaahi makruhum wa in-kaana makruhum litazuula minhul jibaal: (Surah Ibrahim: 14:66).

Excepting for what has already been decided even before the beginning the world, their thoughts, wisdom, and actions produced nothing. All of them got disgusted of their efforts and jobs, and only the acts of God and His commands remained. Therefore, O wise one, consider efforts as just for the sake of name. Consider efforts as nothing more than just speculations, if you are wise.

chapters.title: Izra’iil’s Curious Looks
chapters.subtitle: Izra‘il’s staring at a Man and his running Toward the House of H. Sulaiman; and a Lecture on the Preference of Trust to Struggles and Efforts On the next day at the time of public audience in the royal court, king Sulaiman spoke to Izra’iil’: “Why did you look at that Muslim with remorse. Please tell me, O messenger of God! It is strange that you looked at him to make him leave his house and roam about here and there”. Izra’iil’ said: “O king of the world that has no decline — the spiritual world, as you are a prophet of God! That man misunderstood and this gave him a wrong idea. God had given order to me to take his life on that day in India. I looked at him here and was surprised and got sunk into great worries and said to myself: even if he has a hundred feathers, there is no possibility to his going to India and being there (for me to do my job). But as per God’s command, when I went to India, I found him there, and took out his life”.

sections.heading: Running Towards or From Death?
paras: A simpleton came to the court of H. Sulaiman in the forenoon of a day. He was terribly frightened with a pale face and both lips, having turned blue. H. Sulaiman asked him as to what happened. He said: “Izra’iil, the angel of death cast an eye upon me, which was full of remorse and curiosity”.

H. Sulaiman asked: ‘What do you want from me, now”. He said: “O protector of the world! Give an order to the wind to take me away from here towards India. Possibly, I may be saved from him, if I go far away from him”. Then H. Sulaiman ordered the wind to do so and to take him towards Somnath, in India. The wind instantly obeyed; and took him towards India.

Now, you may see that people run away from their places, out of poverty (in search of food) but they become morsels of greed and desires. Fear of poverty can be seen in this example as fright, and greed and search, as of India (where peace was expected).

sections.heading: Time and Place of Death Unavoidable
paras: Therefore, you may consider all jobs of the world in this manner. Think over, open your eyes, and look properly. From where are we to run away? From our own selves? This is impossible. From whom should we turn our face away? From God? No! this is calamitous!

chapters.title: Benefits of Efforts
chapters.subtitle: The Lions’ once Again stressing upon Efforts and Explanation of their Benefits

paras: The Lion said: “Alright. But you may look at the efforts of the messengers and prophets of God, of the pious people and the struggles (jihads) of the faithful, right from the beginning to this day. They put efforts and God puts their efforts on the right side to deal with all the cruelties and the good and the bad affairs of the world. All their efforts become clean and successful as it is said: “All the things coming from the good people are good”. Their nets caught the heavenly birds and their deficiencies got converted into prosperities. O wise man, put efforts, as far as possible on the ways of the prophets and saints.

“Putting efforts is not against the decisions of God, as this also is put on us by the decisions of God. I may be considered as an infidel, if you see anyone having undergone loss in the path of faith and obedience by working even for a little time. Do not bandage your head under the impression that your head is injured. Give up such suspicions and put efforts for a day or two and then take rest”.

One who struggles for worldly gains puts his efforts for false gains and the one who does so for the other spiritual world, does so for good. Putting efforts in worldly matters is useless but putting efforts for the giving up of the world has been very much talked about by great men. The effort herein is like construction a tunnel in the prison to escape, and closing the tunnel on the contrary is to continue to remain in the prison. This is for the reason that the world is a prison; and we are all prisoners. Therefore, construct a tunnel in the prison and free yourself. What is the meaning of the world? It is forgetfulness of God and indulgence in the gains of worldly materials — gold, silver, wife, and children. And the materials that are carried by you for the sake of faith are considered by the Prophet as the best materials.

sections.heading: Efforts provide special knowledge From God
paras: Filling the boat with water results in its destruction; and water under the boat is helpful for its sailing. H. Sulaiman, inspite of being a king had removed concern for wealth and rulership from his heart. He called himself as nothing but a poor man. A pot with its mouth closed when put into water does not sink but floats, as its belly is full of air. When the air of voluntary poverty has filled the heart, it remains in full peace upon the water of the world. Water cannot sink it within itself, as it is filled with the pleasure of the blow of God’s air. Even if the entire world comes within its hold, its ownership remains of no worth for the eyes of the heart. Therefore, shut the mouth of the heart and seal it, so that doors of the knowledge directly from God (Min ladunn) may come to you. Efforts are truth, medicine is truth and pain is truth. One who refuses to accept this, tries to deny this, and fails. Put efforts, make earnings, and struggle hard so as to know the secrets of the knowledge directly from God (Min ladunn). Though the entire world is getting filled up with efforts and struggles, but the ignorant fellow simply talks of it without tasting its sweetness.

chapters.title: Agreement between animals
chapters.subtitle: Establishment of the truth of Efforts as against Trust

paras: Thus, the lion pleaded many arguments, consequent upon which the pleaders of predestination were humbled and silenced. Foxes, rabbits, deers and jackals gave up the concept of predestination and stopped further arguments. They entered into an agreement with the fierce lion that would not cause any loss to him. Everyday his quota of food would be sent to him without interruption and there will be no need to make other demands. After the agreement they went towards the meadow with all satisfaction from the lion’s ferocity.

All the animals thereafter assembled with great excitement. Everyone was presenting his argument and opinions as to how to proceed further, and everyone was after the life of another. At last, they all agreed to put a lot among them, and whosesoever’s name came about must become the food of the lion. All of them agreed and they found the lot to be the best method. Whosoever’s name came in the lot used to run fast like the jaguar toward the lion.

chapters.title: Rabbit’s reluctance to honour agreement
chapters.subtitle: The Animal’s unhappiness with the Rabbit in its Delay in the Departure towards the Lion

paras: When the cup of wine in circulation went to the rabbit, he shouted: “How long are we to tolerate this cruelty”. All others said: “All these days we have sacrificed our lives to maintain the agreement. Do not be quarrelsome. Do not bring disgrace to us, so that the lion may not get angry. Go fast”.

sections.heading: Rabbit’s Reply and Seeking of Time
paras: He said: “Please give me some time, my friends, so that I may play a trick and relieve you from this devil. So that, your life may be saved with my trick, and this forest be continued to be the inheritance of your children. All prophets in the world have always been calling their followers toward relief because they had seen the path of escape from the sky. But they were hidden from others like the pupil of the eye. People had considered them as small like the pupil of the eye without knowing its greatness that, inspite of being so tiny it has enough powers to absorb oceans and continents within itself”.

chapters.title: Condemnation of the rabbit
chapters.subtitle: Objections of the Animals on the Rabbits’ Words

paras: The community of animals told him: “O donkey! Hear us. Keep yourself according to the worth of the rabbit. What is this nonsense that many much larger than you have not thought of? You are haughty and arrogant, or our death is running after us, as otherwise how can such a claim be made by one like you”.

The rabbit replied: “My friends, God has given me an inspiration and a weakling like me has got a strong opinion. God has given such inspiration to the bee that is not available to large animals like lions and donkeys. The bee makes hives full of sweet honey. God has given this knowledge to it. What is taught by God to a small silkworm, is not known to the large elephant.

sections.heading: Knowledge, the Greatest Gift
paras: Man made of mud was taught a knowledge by God, which has brightened seven heavens. This caused defeat to the honour and pride of the angels, which Satan, the fellow with blind eyes could not see and suspected on the affairs of God. He became like a calf with its mouth tied with the muzzle to prevent it from suckling the cow’s milk. The devil’s mouth was tied, so that he might not drink the milk of knowledge and come near the strong fort of knowledge.

Those men of wisdom, who put on muzzle of sensory knowledge of the mind upon their mouths cannot drink the milk of the esoteric high learning of the heart. Man’s heart was given a gem, which was not given to oceans and heavens. [This refers to the ayat of the Quran: lo! We offered the trust unto the heavens and the earth and the hills, but they shrank from bearing it and were afraid of it. And man assumed it. Lo! He has proved as a tyrant and fool: innaa aradhnal amaanata alas samaawaati wal ‘ardhi wal jibaali faabaina an yahmilnaahaa wa ashfaqnaa minhaa wa hamalahal insaan: innahu kaana zhaluuman jahuula: (Saba:33:72).

sections.heading: Inner Esoteric Knowledge
paras: Therefore, O worshipper of the material face, how long do you want to worship the face? Your soul being ignorant of the meaning is not free from the prison of the face. Prophet Muhammad and Abu Jahal, both went into the house of idols. But there was a great difference between the Prophet’s going and Abu Jahal’s going. When H. Muhammad went inside, idols prostrated to him (as had happened after the victory of Makkah) but when Abu Jahal went, he fell in prostration before the idols. A painting of man drawn on a wall appears like man: think over as to what is lacking in it. This helpless object has no life in it. Go and search for life. You will not find it.

The heads all the lions of the world bent down when fate and effort jointly granted domination to the dog of the companions of the cave (As-hab-e-kahaf). What loss can anyone have if the visible face is spoiled when his soul has dived into the ocean of the light of God. Pens do not have the practice of painting of the faces through letters; but they write about scholarship and justice of the people mentioned in them. Scholarship and justice are the meanings and qualities, and not of the body (space) and time. These qualities come from the world beyond space and time (Laa makaan). the holy abode: [Meaning, which is free from what all we can think of and attribute. And what comes from this place is also undefinable in words and pictures, but its impacts can be observed, by one who perceives and observes spiritually. Similarly, man’s body is visible but not his faculties; but the products of his faculties like his command on science, and various inventions— machines, buildings etc, can be seen. Again, they are material. The spiritual attainment is, all the more difficult to observe; but their standards can be observed by other spiritualists; and what they say also can be understood by those of their standard. The world of holiness is the world beyond the heavens. Wisdom and mind can go upto the heavens, but the soul can go beyond them to the world of holiness – Translator’s note]

The sun of the soul cannot be contained in the heavens. Be it known that the explanation of all this has no end and therefore let us go to the story of the rabbit. Therefore, get rid of the ears of the donkey, which are capable of hearing some sounds, but not understanding the meanings.

chapters.title: Rabbit’s wisdom superior to trust and efforts
chapters.subtitle: Narration of the Wisdom of the Rabbit and of the Excellence and Profits of Wisdom

paras: Move forward and look at the intelligence of the rabbit, its treacherous designs, and its destroying of the lion. Knowledge is the finger ring of H. Sulaiman, rather the ring of his kingdom itself. The entire world is a body, and its soul is knowledge. It is because of this art that all creatures – mountains, oceans and the creatures thereon and therein are obedient to man. Jaguars and lions fear before man like rats and have hidden themselves in the forests and hills. Fairies and giants have held on to the seacoast out of his fear and made hidden places as their abodes.

sections.heading: Man’s Hidden Enemies
paras: But there are many hidden enemies for man; and against them, man therefore, has to be cautious; and caution is wisdom. Good creatures like the angels and bad creatures like the devils are hidden within him, who will be always knocking at his heart. If you enter into a stream to bathe, hidden thorns prick and cause injury to you. The thorn is hidden under water and is invisible, but you can know if its existence only when it pricks. Thus, it is only through their impacts that they can be known. So many words being used by us speak of so many feelings not seen by the eyes. Within man, there are a large number of baseless insinuations and also sensible assessments. These are only felt and not seen. They come about from thousands of devils and angels, not one. Wait, be slow and meditate, so that your feelings may change from bad to good; so that they may be consciously visible to you; and your difficulties may vanish, so that you may know: who are all the persons whose advice you have rejected and who are those whom you are following.

chapters.title: Designs Not to be Revealed
chapters.subtitle: Efforts of the Animals to Know the Rabbit’s Design and Secret

paras: After this they said: “O clever rabbit! keep before us what design you have made, as you have decided to deal with the lion. Tell us, as to what you have planned. Consultation with others provides cleverness and wisdom. Wisdoms become friends, and supporters of wisdom. The noble Prophet has said: “Consult others on matters as one who gives proper instructions is trustworthy”. The Prophet’s advice must be taken with all heart and soul. Tell us fast as to what is your plan?”

chapters.title: Secrets to be Secrets, from Friend’s too
chapters.subtitle: Rabbit’s keeping of His Plan Secret from Animals

paras: He replied: “Every secret is not worthy of being revealed. Sometimes in games, odd number becomes a cause of victory and sometimes even number. The mirror is clean and bright; but if you blow air with your mouth, it becomes dull and gets deprived of image. In three matters, you should shake your lips very little and avoid talking, – your programme to march forward, your wealth and your objective, as these three things have a large number of enemies and opponents who will spoil you, if they come to know-of.

sections.heading: Consultation Without Revealing Mind
paras: If you tell this even to one man, say goodbye to your secret, because secret that comes out of the two lips gets wide publicity. If you tie the feet of two-three birds together, because of pain, they will not move and remain attached to the ground. If at all you have to consult, do not do so by revealing your secret. But by giving a simile or metaphor. The Prophet used to consult in a hidden manner and the consultants, without knowing the exact fact or purpose used to give their opinions. He used to give his opinion in the form of an example in such a manner that the opponent would not grasp the purpose and the related fact. He would get his own answer in the form of a question, and the connotation of his question would remain unrevealed. There is no end to the talks on this point. Let us go to that brave rabbit and find out what he did.

chapters.title: Rabbit’s Efforts to Finish off the Lion
chapters.subtitle: Story of the Rabbit’s clever Dealing with the Lion and Finishing him off

paras: Anyway, the rabbit did not speak of his design; and by meeting all pros and cons together, perfected his design. He did not speak of his design to the others, and discussed about it within himself. While going to the lion, he deliberately delayed for an hour and went before the hard-hitting lion. As the rabbit was late on his arrival, the lion was howling in anger and scratching the ground. And said: “I had told them that the agreements of those mean fellows would be weak, bad and incomplete. Their treachery has killed me. How long can the world cheat me?”

sections.heading: False Men of Words are Dangerous
paras: A foolish ruler is very weak, when he fails to see the front and back of his actions with foolishness. The road appears to be very clear, but underneath it are traps. Very well-known people speak of great words that have no meanings. Words and their well-known speakers are like traps. So also, the words of pseudo saints. Their great names and words are like traps for us. Their sweet words are like sand for our life in which their words sink like water for ever and bring forth nothing. Our life is like water and the passing time is like its stream, and hidden misdeeds and misbehaviours are like the sand under the riverbed of our life. That sand which would spring up water is very rare; yet you may search for it. Be informed my son, such a sand is a godly man who is connected with God and disconnected with himself. Sweet water of faith springs out from him and it gives life and nourishment to the seekers.

sections.heading: Seek Wisdom from the Wise
paras: Consider the fellow other than a godly man, as dry sand, which sucks the water of your life every moment. Become a seeker of wisdom from a wise man, so that you may become a man of outer and inner knowledge. Seeker of wisdom becomes a fountain of wisdom and ultimately gets rid of the seeking of exoteric knowledge. The tablet of one who remembers, becomes a protected tablet (Loh-e-mahfooz) of God, which cannot be disturbed by anymore. And his wisdom becomes one from the protected soul (Rooh-e-Mahfooz). Wisdom, which was his guide and teacher in the beginning later becomes his disciple. Wisdom cannot go beyond certain limits: as Gabriel had said to the noble Prophet: “O Ahmed, I cannot go further. This is my limit. If I go beyond this limit, my wings would be burnt. You may leave me back, O king of the world, and proceed further. This is my boundary and limit!”

sections.heading: Many Successes Upon Wise-treading
paras: One out of laziness, without patience and thanksgiving thinks that one’s feet are tied to fate and predestination. One who believes in predestination, makes oneself sick for so long, that this sickness leads one to the grave. The noble Prophet said that the sickness of joking and laughing creates another sickness which ultimately breaks one down and extinguishes like the lamp. What is predestination?

sections.heading: Spiritual Support comes to the Committed
paras: It is nothing but bringing together broken pieces like the broken bones and veins, to console and proceed further. When you have not got your legs broken in this path, there is no need to put plaster on them. The breaking of legs comes about when you walk on the path of struggle, upon which you have to be consoled with the plea of predestination. Nothing of that sort happens when you remain lazy without efforts: neither this nor that. But, if you struggle and proceed and get your legs broken you will be provided with Burraaq to ride upon and go forward, sitting upon which the Prophet had gone forward, during Ascension (Mi‘raaj). [Burraaq signifies the state of absorption of the godly qualities after a hard struggle which gives spiritual strength to go forward —Qazi Sajjad Husain].

In this process, one who carries the religion becomes one who is carried by religion. The status shifts. The accepter of the commands of God becomes the commander. Until now, he was obeying the commands of the King, and now he becomes the commander-in-chief of the King’s troops. Until now, stars were putting their influence, and now he is the leader of the stars. If you have any doubts in this regard, it means that you have doubts on the statement of God: wa anshaffal qamar: and the moon is cleft asunder: (Surah: Qamar :54: 1). [ This is a miracle that happened in Makkah, when the moon cleft asunder in the presence of the Prophet, some of his companions and some unbelievers. The unbelievers saw this but called it transient magic sihrum mustamirrun (surah Qamar: 54:2). History records it without doubt. It is also be taken in the prophetic past tense referring to occur in future, which is explained in (surah Qiyaamat: 75: 8 & 9), referring to the moon getting eclipsed and the sun and moon getting united. It can also be taken metaphorically —A. Yusuf Ali: Translator’s Note].

Refresh your faith within, and not in mere words, just as you have kept fresh your desires inside. So long as the passions are fresh, faith will not be fresh, and passions act as a lock on the door through which godly impressions come. You want to interpret the words of the Quran which are pure and uncorrupted. Try to change and interpret yourself about your capacity to understand, and not the words of the Quran, as it is not touched by the devils. You try to use your immature wisdom to interpret the Quran; do not do this. Leave the Quran as it is and try to change and perfect your wisdom. You interpret the Quran with your lowly desires and as a consequence, bright meanings become dull, because of you.

chapters.title: Petty interpretations of the Mean
chapters.subtitle: Hollow interpretation of a Silly Housefly

paras: Your interpretative capacities are like those of a strange housefly, which thought of itself as of some great worth. It was intoxicated of its own pride and arrogance, without drinking any wine. It had taken to itself as bright in wisdom as the sun is in light. It had heard of the praises of the falcon and said to itself as ‘Anqa of the time: [an ancient bird considered to be very large in size, beautiful and strong, which is now extinct].

It sat on a scrap of grass floating on the urine of a donkey like a boatman and indulged in self-praise. It said: “I had read about the ships on the ocean and been thinking about them for a long time. Now, I have understood them: this is the ocean, this is the ship, and here I am. I am now a shipmaster, one of great art and knowledge”.

So, thinking it was propelling its oars and the donkey’s urine appeared to its small eyes as a vast ocean beyond limits. The donkey’s urine appeared to its eyes as coast-less ocean. It did not possess those eyes which could reveal the reality. Its world was as much as its sight was; so also its ocean.

Those who make false interpretations are like the housefly. Their thoughts are like the donkey’s urine and the scrap of grass on it. If a man of housefly’s capacity stops interpreting like the housefly, he will have the fortune of the bird, Huma, [about which there was a belief that upon whomsoever its shadow fell would become a king. Metaphorically it is considered as a symbol of good fortune]. Such a fellow is not a housefly, as such, he ought to have so much self-respect as not to make silly interpretations. Such a fellow’s soul is lesser than the soul of the rabbit which made an attack on the lion. Certainly, its spirit was not as small as its body was.

chapters.title: Deliberate delay to tease the lion
chapters.subtitle: Lion’s anger upon the Rabbit’s Late Arrival

paras: The lion in anger and fastness was telling: “My enemy has blinded me through the words put into my ears. The treacheries of the predestinarians compelled me to yield by injuring my body with a sword made of wood. From now onwards, I shall not hear their treacherous words. They are nothing but the shoutings of the devils and ghosts. O my heart! Tear them off into pieces and do not stop. Skin them out: they are nothing but the skin only. They do not have any pulp under the skin. What is their skin? It is nothing other than colourful words. They are like the shape of the coat of mail appearing upon water-surface as waves, which do not last long”.

sections.heading: Words of Kings and Words of Prophets
paras: Words are like the skin and their meanings are their pulp. They are like the body and their meanings are the souls. Skins hide the defects of the bad pulp. Good pulp is full of pride and desires to hide itself, and skin puts a covering on its self-pride. When your pen is made of air and your paper is the surface of water, whatever you write gets lost instantly. If you want to expect honesty from the writings on water, you will cut your own hands and come back in shame. Passions in men are the cause of desires and love; and if you give up desires, it amounts to following the command of God. Messages of God are very pleasing, and everlasting.

Commands of the kings and their leadership pass away; as against those of the prophets. This is for the reasons that the commands of the kings are for their domination and grandeur upon the people caused by their desires, but the honour of the prophets is from God. Names of the kings are struck upon the coins and are wiped off, but the name of Prophet Muhammad is inscribed upon the hearts till the doomsday. Muhammad’s name contains the names of all the prophets, as all ninety-nine names before one hundred are included in his name which is final like hundred. There is no end to this talk my son. Let us hear the story of the rabbit and the lion.

chapters.title: A Good Strategy by Rabbit
chapters.subtitle: Rabbit’s Strategy of Delayed Arrival Before the Lion

sections.heading: Greatness of Wisdom
paras: The rabbit took a long time to arrive before the lion established as the first stage of his strategy. He remained lain on the road for a long time so as to say a few secrets in the lion’s ears. To say: Look at the varieties of the world in the expanse and madness of wisdom. Look how large is the ocean of wisdom. Man’s wisdom in particular is an endless ocean, and in order to know it, one has got to be a diver. Our shapes are sailing on this sweet ocean of mental and spiritual faculties like bowls on water. So long as a bowl is empty it floats on water and once it gets filled up, it sinks. As against other things of this world, wisdom is hidden and invisible, but our physique is like the waves of the ocean and its moistness. Inspite of this greatness of wisdom, it entirely relies upon physical appearances of things to understand them. As a result of this, the ocean of all hidden knowledge rejects its propositions. What is required for the knowledge in entirety of all things, is the heart and soul, and not wisdom alone. This internal knowledge of the heart makes one to see not the physical substances but their maker. It makes one see not the arrow alone, but also see the one who shoots the arrow.

sections.heading: Wisdom Alone, Not Sufficient
paras: So long as a person does not recognise and see the soul, he thinks it to be non-existing. This is like a person who, while riding on his fast-running horse, fails to see his horse and considers it to be lost and goes on speaking about the lost horse. He is forlorn, complaining and searching for the horse, and asks everyone to tell as to where his horse has gone. He goes on searching for it everywhere. He asks: “Where is the person who has stolen my horse”. When he is told: “Gentleman, your horse is right under you. It is very much under your hips. What is it that you are sitting upon? Come to your senses, O searcher of the horse!” The rider accepts that it is a horse, yet he questions: “Where is my horse”. The hearer slowly tells him about the qualities of the horse to convince him about his horse.

This is the position of the people who are dependent entirely upon wisdom to know things. They cannot see the soul which is nearest to them and wrongly consider it be non-existing, just as a pot of water though full of water inside, is dry on its mouth. Soul appears to be lost because of its predominance and nearness.

sections.heading: Perfect Knowledge comes with both Wisdom and Soul
paras: In order to recognise the soul, you will have to exert physical pain on the body by austerities, hunger and sleeplessness, when you will be sharp enough to see green, red and yellow colours with your inner eyes, which colours the Sufis call as the bearers of the subtle secrets of the hidden spiritual world. You cannot see these colours until you see the white light before seeing them. But your wisdom is busy in seeing these physical colours through your wisdom and physical eyes, and your senses are lost in apparent colours. Therefore, the spiritual colours are hidden from you. You cannot see colours other than through the apparent light. So also, is the case of the internal colours. You have to develop the internal light.

sections.heading: Nature of Light and Colours
paras: The external light is a product of the sun and bright stars, but the internal light is the reflection of lights of the highest of the highest spiritual domination. The brightness of the eyes is also from the light of the heart, and the light of the heart is from the light of God which is not impacted with the light of senses and wisdom.

You did not see colours in the night as there was no light. The concept of colours comes to our mind out of darkness which is the opposite of light. It is the darkness of night that has taught us about the colours. You did not see colour in the night, as it had no light. Colour is just a blind blue beed. Eyesight first apprehends light and then colours. It is the opposite of darkness that has revealed the light. Opposites reveal opposites just as white Romans reveal the black Abyssinians. First that is visible is light, and then the colour, and as the opposite of light is not only darkness but also colour. All this occurs instantly. Both bright light and colours appear simultaneously physically, but by analogy and analysis, it is first light and then colour in their relationship of first and next, as darkness follows light and light follows darkness. It is a mental process. All colours are black in darkness and they are coloured in bright light. Therefore, colours follow light. Thus, you have understood light from its opposite – darkness. Opposites clarify and expose the opposites.

Translator’s note —[Scholars of the ancient and medieval times (476AD to 1453AD) were completely in the dark about the nature of light. They speculated that it consisted of particles emitted by the glowing objects or perhaps by the eye itself”. (Isaac Asimov’s New Guide to Science, page 341)

In as late of as 1666, “Newton deduced that ordinary light is a mixture of different kinds of light which, separately, affect our eyes so as to produce the sensation of different colours”. Isaac Asimov, page 342 ibid). This is proved by the glass-prism experiment.

Dark objects absorb the entire light and white objects reflect back all light. Coloured objects absorb all colours except the ones as their colours such as that appear green, red etc., by reflecting back the colours.

Read what Rumi has said about light and its reflections here. Rumi is not a scientist, but was well versed with the knowledge on all subjects available in his days — 13th century AD. That was possible then and even up to the days of Isaac Newton (17th century) but not at all now. Knowledge on all sciences was limited till then. But it is not possible now as it has increased by thousands of times: so much so, even a single subject cannot be mastered but only a branch of it.

Many of those books on various sciences of the earlier writers are not available now, but their ideas are incorporated by writers during 17th century and subsequent days, of modern age. [Starting with the end of middle ages (1453) without mentioning their names. Some are certainly available in Arabic in Oriental Libraries and Museums in Europe. Passing references of such scientific points can be seen in the literary religious book as we see in the Math(s)navi. So also  we can see in the literary and religious works of Alghazali, Ibne-Khaldun etc. In the Math(s)navi itself there are references to gravity; evolution of life etc., —Translator’s note]

sections.heading: Opposites Explain Opposites
paras: God has created pain and sorrow to expose and clarify their oppositeness with their opposite, that is: happiness. Thus, hidden things get explained and exposed by the opposites. Pains and sorrows of one cannot be seen by another but can be felt by the facial and physical marks of the sufferer. Pains and sorrows are hidden and can be known through happiness, their opposite. But there is no opposite of God. He is hidden and unexposed. Also, there is no opposite of God’s light. Therefore, it also remains hidden and unexposed. Certainly, our eyes cannot comprehend, but He comprehends us as stated in the Quran: la tudrikuhu al absaaru wa huwa yudrikul absaaru, wa huwa al latifu alkhabir: No vision comprehends Him, but He comprehends all visions. He is the Subtle and Aware: (An‘aam: 6: 103).

Consider this also that H. Musa also wanted to see God and told Him: inni arinii, anzur ilaika: O my Lord! Show yourself to me, that I may look at you. God said: Lan taraanii: By no means, you can see me direct. (Surah A’raaf: 7: 143)

Then God told him to look at the mount upon which he would manifest. If it remains at its place, then he could see Him. But when God manifested Himself upon the mount, it became dust and H. Musa fell down in a swoon. And after some time, when H. Musa recovered his senses, he said: “Glory to you. And I repent for my mistake!”

sections.heading: Thoughts, Words and Speech
paras: Therefore, consider the body and the meaning contained therein as different from each other, and also interconnected, like the lion and its den. And also, words and speech are interconnected. There is no speech without words. Speech and words come out of thoughts, but you do not know where the ocean of thoughts is. But when you find that the waves of thoughts are subtle (highly refined, delicate with fine distinctions of meanings), you consider that the ocean from which they come must also be subtle, noble, and grand. Therefore, when the wave of thought arises from wisdom, it assumes the shape of words and sounds. Speech takes birth in the form of words and then dies just as the wave takes birth in the ocean and dies. One shape comes out of another and returns to it. That is: inna ilaihi raji’uun: to him is our return: (Baqara: 2:156). Thus, every moment you die and return to life. This is what the Prophet said that the world is only of a moment. That is, every moment, a living thing dies and again comes into existence. Our thought is an arrow from God which cannot remain in the air. It returns to God.

sections.heading: Fresh Creation at Every Moment
paras: This world is coming anew every moment, but we are not aware of it and see it as continuingly existing. Like the water in the stream that is continuingly flowing. But every moment there is fresh water in it. Our life also comes anew every moment, which can be seen in the body to be continuous. As this freshness is continuing in a very fast manner, it has a continuing shape just as a flame, upon fast movement appears to be in the form of a shape. If you move a burning wood very fast, its flame appears in the form of long line.

Thus, fastness of creation gives a long-life-giving evidence of the fastness of God’s creative activity. If there is an authority on this subject, it is the noble Husamuddin [the chief disciple and inspirer for the writing of this Math(s)navi] who is like a book of prosperity and excessive generator of ideas. His praiseworthy personage does not require any elaboration. Come forward, narrate the story of the rabbit and lion, as it is getting delayed.

chapters.title: Impressions of Brave Face
chapters.subtitle: Rabbit’s Attendance Before the Lion and its Getting Angry

paras: In a fiery, angry, grumbling mood, the lion saw the rabbit coming towards him from a distance. He was coming running towards him fearlessly, bravely, angrily, in high speed with a bitter face. Going before someone in humility speaks of guilt; and brave appearance rids one of suspicions. When he came nearer to the lion, the lion shouted at him: “You son of an ignoble! I am the one who has torne large cows and frightened male lions. What is the value of this half-grown rabbit for me, who would take my command lightly? Give up your rabbit’s sleep, which you resorted to in the arrogance of fastness when you raced with the tortoise for which you are famous. Like a foolish donkey, hear the roar of the lion.”

chapters.title: Flatter the enemy to fool
chapters.subtitle: Rabbit’s Flattery of the Lion and Offering Excuses for Late Coming

paras: The rabbit said: “Forgive my life, I have an explanation to offer if your masterly dominance permits me. If you permit me, I shall speak. You are the master and king, and I am a slave”.

The lion said: “What is your explanation, O the worst among the fools, to come before the kings in a delayed manner. A cock crowing at the wrong time is slaughtered. It is not proper to hear the excuses of fools. Excuses of the fools are worse than their mistakes. Excuses of the ignorant are a poison for the wise. What is your excuse, you deprived one of thinking? I am not the ear of the donkey to hear your senseless excuses”.

The rabbit said: “O king! Consider the unworthy as worthy for a moment. Do offer your ear to those who are victims of oppression. As a spill over of the grandeur of your great status, put the misguided on the right path. The ocean which provides water to all streams and rivers carries a scrap of grass on its head and face. With such a grace, it does not lose its status. With the offerings of grace an ocean does not lose or gain anything”.
The lion said: “Alright! I shall show my grace at this moment. I cut the fabric according to the size of the wearer!

The rabbit said: “Do hear me! There may not be any more occasion to show your benevolence. I keep my head before the frightening pythons. I came on my way early in the morning along with another companion towards your lordship. Along with me, our community had sent another rabbit for your food. On the way, another lion tried to attack me, rather, both of us. I told him: “I am the slave of the emperor; we both are servants in the presence of our emperor”. He told us: “Who is the emperor you are talking about shamelessly. Do not take the name of any incompetent fellow before me. I shall tear you and also your king if you go away from here along with your friend”. I told him: “Leave me, so that I may look at the face of my king and inform him about you”. He said: “Leave your friend as a hostage with me, as otherwise you are a thing of sacrifice in my religion.”

“I pleaded to him very much, but it was of no use and he kept my friend with him and let me go alone. My friend is a hostage with him. His half-conscious heart started bleeding. My friend was three times my size. He was cleaner and smarter and good in body. After this the way for his release was closed. This was our situation which I explain to you. From now onwards, you may not hope for your daily provision that we have been making. What I am telling you is truth, and truth is always bitter. If you want to get your provision restored, clear the way and finish off that shameless fellow”.

chapters.title: Togetherness of enemies
chapters.subtitle: Lion’s Reply to the Rabbit and Their Going Forward

paras: The lion said: “With God’s name, let me see where that fellow is. Be in front and lead me to him, if you are telling the truth, so that I may punish him and a hundred like him, and punish you, if it is a lie”.

The rabbit came in front and marched first as a leader in front to take the lion to his trap, toward a well, which he had already found and chosen. He had made a deep well as his trap. Both of them went near the well. How great was this rabbit! He has made himself as the water under the grass, which is not visible; and one who steps on it, drowns.

sections.heading: Do not Befriend Enemy
paras: Water from the forest takes a scrap of grass out of the forest. But it was a wonderous situation that water was taking a mountain-like-large lion. The net of his trick was a loop for the lion. Strange that the rabbit had caught hold of the lion. H. Musa had dragged the Pharaoh to the river Nile along with his army and large number of people. A mosquito with half a feather put a hole in the head of Nimrod and went up to his brain. This is what happens to one who hears the words of the enemy. Look at the punishment of the one who became a friend of the enemy. This is what happened to Pharaoh who took the advice of Haamaan; and of Nimrod who praised and worshiped the devil. If your enemy talks to you in a friendly way, take it as a trap, howsoever wise his sayings may be. Consider the sugar he gives as poison and his graces and grants as destroyers.

When fate comes forward, you do not see anything other than the external rind; and you see the enemy as a friend. When such situations arise resort to humility crying before God, recitations of His name and fasting. Cry before Him saying: “O knower of the hidden things! Do not put me under a harmful rock full of treachery. O Generous, Forgiver and Hider of defects! Do not punish us for our sins. Reveal upon our hearts the hidden aspects of all things that are in the world. If we behave like dogs, O Creator of lions, do not impose a lion upon us from its hunting place. Do not make clean water appear as fire; and do not keep the face of water hidden in fire. You intoxicate people with the wine of your wrath and provide the shape of existence to the non-existing. What is intoxication? It is nothing but shutting of the eyes to prevent them from seeing the reality of things, so that stones, gems, wool – may all appear as jasper. What is intoxication? It is nothing but the alterations of the senses when a measuring yardstick appears as sandalwood.

chapters.title: Hoopoe’s Extraordinary abilities
chapters.subtitle: Story of H. Sulaiman and Hoopoe to State that When Fate comes, it Shuts the Eyes

paras: As H. Sulaiman sat in his tent, all birds presented themselves before him. They found him as one of their own tongue and knower of their affairs. They came before him one after another. They all gave up their chirping, and talked to him very fluently, more fluently than your brother with you. Speaking in a common language is closeness and filial relationship; and with people of other tongues, one is like a person in prison.

sections.heading: Commonness of Language and feelings
paras: There are many Hindus (Indians) and Turks who speak the same language having affinity with each other. Yet there are two Turks, who behave like strangers. The language of filial relationship is different, and commonness of feelings is better than commonness of language. Without speaking, writing and even gesturing, thousands of spokesmen are born in the heart.

All the birds were trying one after the other to speak to him of their secrets, their jobs, abilities, and expertise to solicit his appreciation. Not with pride, but with their very presence, as they had found out the way to present themselves before him. When the master comes before the slave to buy him, the slave presents his abilities to him so as to be bought by him. If he feels that his being bought by him is a disgrace, he shows himself as sick, deaf, cripple, and lame.

When the turn of the hoopoe and his profession arrived, there was a narration of his expertise and abilities. He said: “O king! I shall speak to you of my ability which is very ordinary, in a few words as expressing things in few words is always better”. H. Sulaiman asked him to speak as to what that ability was. He said: “When I happen to be at heights, I see certain things with perfect certainty. I see water in the depths of the earth as to where it is, under how much depth and of what colour. It is gushing out from mud or from rocks. O Sulaiman, whenever you have a military camp, you may take me along with you for this ability of mine”.

Then H. Sulaiman told him: “Okay. Be a companion of ours in waterless forests so that you may find out the source of water and be a water provider to our friends in journeys. You may be our friend and a forerunner so as to provide water for us. Be with me for both day and night so that our soldiers may not suffer for want of water”.
Therefore, Hoopoe was with him as it was aware of hidden sources of water.

chapters.title: Objections of the Jealous
chapters.subtitle: Crow’s taunts on the Hoopoe’s Claims

paras: When the crow came to know of this, out of jealousy, spoke to H. Sulaiman: “He has said something wrong and bad. It is not proper to speak before a king, and in particular with self-praise, of false and impossible claims. If he were to have such sight forever, why does he not see the net placed under a handful of mud and get caught therein. Why does he fail to see and get imprisoned in the cage.?”

H. Sulaiman said: ‘O hoopoe, what do you say? In the very first cup of yours this froth has come about. O drunk of the buttermilk why do you pose yourself to be intoxicated. You praise yourself before me and that too with a false claim”.

chapters.title: Fate Plays its Role
chapters.subtitle: Hoopoe’s Reply to H. Sulaiman on the taunt

paras: Hoopoe said: “O king, do not hear the words of an enemy against a naked beggar like me. If my claim is false, you may cut off my head, which I have placed before you. The crow who rejects the fate made by God is an infidel (kafir) even if he has great wisdom. If you have one ‘K’ of the word ‘Kafiraan’ (plural of kafir = kefiraan), it can be considered as another word ‘kafiraan’ which is the split between the two thighs (meaning female genital organ) which means a source of uncleanliness and sexual urge. I do see the net from above in the air, so long as the eyes of wisdom are not shut by fate. When fate comes to play its role, wisdom goes to sleep. Moon becomes black and gets caught in the eclipse. This decoration by fate to misguide is not something unknown. Consider your rejection of fate also as a fate!

chapters.title: Fate shut the eyes as in H. Adam’s case
chapters.subtitle: Narrative of H. Adam and the Shutting of his Eyes by Fate from his Concessions; and Clear Disobedience to Preventive Command, Under Misinterpretation

paras: Abul Bashar Adam, father of all humans is the master of the grant of ‘Allama Adama al asma’a kullahaa’: And He taught Adam the nature of all things: (Surah Baqara :2 :30). He had a hundred thousand informations in everyone of his nerves. The name of everything, as it is, and its ultimate end, was known to him. Whatever name he gave to a thing was not changed. Whomsoever he called as smart was not dulled. Whomsoever he called as fortunate and free, became honourable, happy, and pleasing. Whoever was faithful in the end, was seen by him as such in the beginning itself. So also, of the one who was an infidel in the end. As it is the end of life that decides the status of a person in the other world. One who thinks of the next world is faithful; and the one who only cares for the present day life of the world is infidel.

sections.heading: Name means Inner, Final Qualities
paras: You should know the name (character, property) of everything from the wise and learned. “Taught the nature of all things” points out to this fact and its secret which also you should learn from the wise. The name of everything before us is its appearance, but for the Creator it is its hidden qualities. In H. Musa’s view the name of his wooden piece was staff, but in God’s view its name was python. The name of H. ‘Umar, when he became known to the people was an idol worshipper, but it was written as “faithful” on the day of creation and God’s questioning: (Alastu birabbikum).

What is considered as semen by us, was like you as you are before me now. On the day prior to creation, it was just a human person, which was present before God without anything less or more. Ultimately, our real name before God was as we have it in the end, or as on today. A man’s name is kept as per his final position for ever and not as one kept for a few days.

sections.heading: Attempt to Interpret Clear Command
paras: Adam’s eye which had seen the end of everything, with clear light was fully aware of the name and its inner qualities. When angels found the light of God in him, they fell in prostration before him and ran after to serve him. When they also saw the light of God through him, they all fell in prostration before him. If the praise of Adam whose name I have taken, is done till the doomsday by me, it will not be complete. All of them knew of his great worth, but in the understanding of one negative command of God, he committed a mistake. He was ordered not to go near a tree, lest he may go astray: wala taqraba hizihi alshjrata fatakuna min alzhalimiin: but come not near this tree lest you become one among wrong doers: (Baqara: 2:35).

He started questioning, whether this preventive command was for the tree being forbidden or to put me into interpretation or create suspicions in my mind. When such understanding penetrated into his heart, he thought that the prevention was only momentary and got inclined and ran after the wheat plant. When the gardener got pricked by a thorn, thief got the opportunity, took the materials, and ran away.

sections.heading: Fate Plays its Role
paras: When he got rid of this surprising situation, he came back to his normal sense and found that the thief has taken away his materials from his workshop. He took a long sigh and said: “Our lord! We have wronged ourselves. If you do not forgive us, and have no mercy on us, surely, we are the lost: rabbana zhalamnaa anfusanaa, wa il lam taghfir lanaa wa tarhamnaa lanakunannaa min al khaasiriin (A’araaf: 7:23). That is to say, there was darkness and he lost the way.

That was fate: it is a cloud that hid the sun. It makes rats out of the lions and pythons. The hoopoe continued: “If I do not see the net spread out for me at the fateful time, I do not happen to be the only ignorant from the path of fate”.

sections.heading: Fate Alone Reverses Fate
paras: That man is fortunate and deserves praises who does good acts, forgets his might and resorts to humility. You should know that if your fate becomes dark and wraps you up like the night, it is fate only that later comes to your rescue, holds your hands, and leads you to a good place. If your fate tries to take your life a hundred times, your fate only saves you from danger and treats you in sickness. If fate commits dacoity upon you for a hundred times, it is fate only that makes a tent for you in the sky. Consider it as a grace if fate threatens you, as it does so to place you in a peaceful place. Be well informed and be careful. If it frightens you, as without such fright by fate, you will go astray. This talk has no end and it is getting late. Hear the story of the lion and rabbit now.

chapters.title: Expressing false Fears
chapters.subtitle: Rabbit’s Hesitation to go Forward upon Reaching the Well

paras: The Lion was going with the rabbit in all anger, enmity and vengeance. The rabbit was in front of him. Suddenly the rabbit drew back from the front to the back of the lion. The lion found himself in the nearness of the well, saw the rabbit having gone behind him. He asked the rabbit: ‘Why have you taken your steps backside. Do not do so and come to the front’. The rabbit said: ‘Where are my hands and feet. They are all spent up. My soul is shivering, and my heart is beating so fast that it has changed its place. Do you not see the color of my face having gone pale like gold? It is giving the news of my internal conditions. When God has said that the forehead speaks of the conditions, the sight of the well-aware falls on the forehead to know the person’s mind. You will know them by their forehead: taking Ta’rifuhum bisiimaahum (Baqar 2:275). Color and smell carry the message like the tower bell. Horse’s sound speaks of its presence. Sound of everything speaks of its existence. The sound of the braying of the donkey is different from that of the door. The noble Prophet (SA) has said that a man is hidden in his silent tongue and not in his wrappings. Color of the face is the indicator of the condition of the heart. Have pity on me. Put your love for me in your heart.

“Reddish color of the face speaks of thankfulness and happiness; and paleface speaks of patience and sufferings. Such a thing has entered into my heart which has defeated men, animals, plants and minerals. Such a thing has entered into me which scatters senses and ends the color of the face, its energy and its signs. Such a thing has entered into me which upon entering into anything destroys it; which uproots the trees from the ground.”

sections.heading: Calamities upon Large Things
paras: These are small things, before which bigger things, go yellow in color and foul in smell. The world is sometimes in patience and thankfulness for peace. Sometimes, a garden is full of colorful garments, and sometimes it is stark naked. Sun that comes out in great fire and pageantry at one time, at another time, falls downwards. Shining brightly in the sky are the stars, burning moment by moment. Moon which is brighter and more beautiful than stars suffers from tuberculosis and becomes thin, like the crescent. Earth is peaceful and well settled, but when there is earthquake it trembles and shivers, like a man in fear and chill. So many hills by getting into uncontrollable calamity shatter and get converted into sand dunes. This wind which is connected with the soul, becomes deceased, foul smelling and polluted under the impact of fate. Clean and fresh water that is like the brother of the soul becomes colored, bitter and polluted in a pit.

Fire, which is uncontrollable, fierce and arrogant is overtaken by wind which tells it to die, and it dies. Soil that becomes the wealth of flowers during spring, gets destroyed by the air at a later time. The ocean is in continuous disturbance with waves and tides, indicating that it is losing its contentment and peace continuingly. Sky is in continuous rotation in search of something and its condition is like that of its children — the four elements: fire, air, water and earth; and minerals, plants and animals. It is at the lowest point, middle point and farthest point of the highest heaven at different times, with its armies of influences that bring sometimes prosperity and sometimes calamity. Every star changes its location from its own constellation and goes to the farthest constellation. It moves up and comes down and remains in the centre for some time. It enters into its own constellation feeling happy and enters into another becoming sorrowful. They are all independent of each other and also dependent upon others. You may consider the fate of everything in this fashion. In some respects, it acts independently and in some, with others. [The translator expresses his inability to properly translate this portion because of his lack of knowledge of astrology, astronomy and cosmology prevailing in the 13th century and the exact connotations and definitions of certain words like Hazeez, auj, sa‘rood, farah, waabal, haboot, tarah, charkh etc. and seeks pardon of Rumi and the readers — Translator.]

sections.heading: Simultaneous Freedom and Departure
paras: When the great fundamental things like the elements: fire, air, water and earth are in this situation of freedom and dependence, you may think about the lowly things, that is, things made of their combinations. When the whole suffers pain and sorrow, the part also has to suffer and be palefaced, and in particular those which are the combinations of the opposites like water and earth, fire and air. It would not be strange to see that the goat ran away from the wolf, but it would be otherwise if you see that the goat loved and embraced the wolf. Life is the coming together of opposites and death is in their resorting to fight with each other. It is the peace between opposites that gives life and peace to this world. But fights between them are the everlasting life. Life is the peace between enemies; death is the return to the origin of things. Peace between enemies is temporary; the permanent thing is their return to the levels of fights. As a means of mutual concern, they love and be sincere to each other for some time. Ultimately everything returns to its reality and joins the friendly species. It is God’s grace that the jaguar and the hilly sheep fell in love with each other and ended their enmity. It is God’s grace that the lion and the donkey, inspite of being opponents came together to live together. When the entire world is unhappy and imprisoned there is no wonder that the sufferers are mortal.

chapters.title: Enemy suspects of pretentions
chapters.subtitle: Lion’s questioning About the Rabbit’s Back steps and His Answers Thereon

paras: The rabbit went on making these statements of wisdom to the lion and concluded that he has gone behind him as these facts became obstacles. The lion said: “You are one among the causes of disease: but tell me as to what exactly your reason is in going behind me. Are you playing some silly game to cheat me?”

The rabbit replied: “That lion is settled in this well and is protected from all troubles and this well is like a fort for him. He has separated my rabbit friend from me and taken along with him into the well. He had caught hold of my friend from the right path towards wrong way.

“Wise people have resorted to places of depth like the well, as loneliness provides cleanliness to heart. Darkness of the well is preferable to the darkness of the sins of the people. One who holds the feet of the people to remain in their company cannot protect one’s head. Come close to me as you are capable of injuring and destroying him. You may see that the lion is inside the well. I am burnt with that fiery fellow. Take me within your armpit, as you are a mine of mercy, and with your help and protection, I too may open my eyes and look at him. I can proceed further only with your help and be able to look into the well without a rope”.

chapters.title: Wrath and Jealousy Spoil Wisdom
chapters.subtitle: The Lion’s Looking into the Well and Seeing His Own Reflection and Of the Rabbit

paras: When the lion took the rabbit in his armpit, he started running fast. When they looked at the water in the well, they found their reflection in water. The lion looked at his reflection in extreme anger with a fat rabbit in its armpit whom he found to be his enemy. He left the rabbit from his armpit and jumped into the well.

He fell into his own well of cruelties that he had perpetrated, as his cruelties were left to be put on his own head. The cruelties of the oppressors are a dark well. This is what all learned people have said. The more cruel is a person, the more frightening is his well. This is what the law says: worse for the worse.

sections.heading: Cruelties Come to End, At last
paras: He who digs up a well of cruelties should know that he spreads a net for himself. If you commit atrocities on the weak, know that you are in the extreme depths of the well. Do not enclose yourself in a cocoon like the silkworm. When you want to dig a well for your own purpose dig it up as per your needs. Do not consider the weak to be helpless. Read in the Quran: Izaa Jaa’a nasrullaahi wal fat-hu: When comes the help of God, and victory (Surah Help:110:1). When the Muslims were very much oppressed, this ayat was revealed to tell them that a time will come when they will be in large numbers and help will come to them. If you are mighty like an elephant, and your victim runs away from you, see that the ababil birds come to destroy you, as happened when Abraha the Abyssinian, had invaded Makkah with a large army and elephants before the birth of Prophet Muhammad. Birds came in large flights flinging stones at the army, and destroyed the army like the chewed straw and stubble found in the dung of animals (Quran: The Elephant: 105)

If the weak on the earth seek peace, a disturbance occurs among the soldiers of the heavens and they get ready to go to the help of the oppressed. If you tear anyone with your teeth, toothache will catch you. The lion, who out of his excessive arrogance looked at himself in the well, could not distinguish between himself and the enemy, and considered his own reflection as the enemy and pounced upon it, or upon himself.

sections.heading: Others’ Oppression is also Yours
paras: The oppression that you see as caused by others, many a times, represents your own cruelty. Your own character is found in them full of cruelty, hypocrisy and oppression. That cruel fellow is your own selfcausing injury to yourself, subjecting yourself to condemnation. You do not see these bad qualities within you; as otherwise, you would have been inimical to yourself. Yet by foolishly attacking others, you attack yourself like the lion which attacked himself. If you penetrate deep into the conduct of yourself, you will know that the bad conduct of others is your own. After going deep into the well, the lion came to know that what he pounced upon was his own reflection. One who pulls the teeth of the weak people may be considered as performing the act that the mischievous lion did. One who looks at the black mole with contempt upon the face of his uncle, should consider it as the reflection of his own.

sections.heading: Learn from the noble People
paras: The noble Prophet has said: Almu’minu miranatul mu’minu, a faithful man is a mirror of the faithful. You have put on a black spectacle on your eyes and so everything appears black to you. [This shows that spectacles were in use during Rumi’s days —Translator]. Just as a man betters himself by looking at the mirror, you may look at the face of the mu’min and better yourself. Or if you have the least sense, consider the observed blackness as due to you or as your own, and do not call the world as black. If the faithful observe the faithful people’s conduct and adopt them, they become good. The Prophet has also said: Ittaqu firasatal mu’minu fainnahu yanzhuru bi nurallah: Fear the far and deep sight of the faithful for he sees with the light of God. The faithful recognizes all your acts, howsoever you may hide from him.

As you did not see with the light of God, but with the fire of God, you could not distinguish good from bad. Therefore, you are unfortunate. Therefore, sprinkle water on the fire little by little, so that the fire may become sharp and brighter by losing its ash.

O our Lord! Pray sprinkle pure water, so that the fire of the entire world may become cold. Mountains and oceans are all under Your command; and water and fire are Your properties. If You so desire, fire will become pleasing water, or even water will become fire. Without our asking, You have fulfilled our desires and granted innumerable unsought gifts. And, upon our asking, how can You not give? O Living and the Loving kind, when all the grants of life and kindness are from You alone; where had we demanded anything, when we were in the zone of non-existence and brought out from there? Without our asking You have given us so many wonderful grants. You have given us life, bread, and everlasting life and so many other things we cannot explain about. You have given innumerable and unaccountable grants to all and kept open the door of benevolence for all. This demand we are making, is also a grant from You. Deliverance from oppression is another grant from You. You give hidden treasure even without asking and granted life to the world without any price. Pray, be giving grants until we enter into the paradise with the indulgence of Muhammad, master of the universe.

chapters.title: Victory causes Pleasures
chapters.subtitle: Announcement of the Happy news of the Lion’s falling into the well before the Forest Animals by the Rabbit

paras: After getting the community rid of lion’s atrocities, the rabbit went towards the forest animals. When he found the lion thus caught in the well of his own troubles, he ran fast towards his community. When he found the lion meeting his death, he ran happily on the right path. Upon seeing the lion in pain in the well, his happiness knew no bounds and he was jumping and dancing on his way to the meadow. He was clapping in joy after getting freed from the clutches of death just as twigs and leaves become green in color and clap with each other with the blowing wind.

sections.heading: Expressions of Thanks by Actions
paras: When the twigs and trees got freed from the prison of mud, they raised their heads and became companions of the air. When the leaves tore the twigs, they rose up atop the tree. The seed, which sends forth its blade, expressed its thanks to God by its sprouting. So also, every leaf and flower. Without a tongue to praise in words, every fruit, leaf and twig goes on singing His praises through actions, that the One, full of grants, gave them the root, and made them strong and straight on the tree as stated in the Quran: Kazar’in  akhraja shat’ahu faa’zara, fastaghlaza fastava alaa suuqihi:  Later a seed which sends forth its blade, then makes it strong; it then becomes thick, and it stands on its own stem (Fat-ha, Victory: 48:29).

Souls imprisoned in mud and water get freedom from them with great pleasure. They dance in the air in the love of God and become spotless like the full bright moon. Their bodies dance: and you may not ask about the souls, which too dance in pleasure. So also, about those souls which become bodies in entirety.

sections.heading: Man, similarly, Caught in the Well of Wrongs
paras: The rabbit felled the lion in the prison. It was a matter of great shame for the lion that he was humbled by a puny rabbit. You are caught in such a shame, and yet you think, you should be called as the graceful, wise, pious, Fakhruddin Raazi. You are like the lion caught in the depth of the well of the world. Your vicious self is like the rabbit, which is shedding your blood in a calamitous manner. It is engaged freely like the rabbit grazing in the forest and you are in this pit without raking up any question.

That rabbit, the destroyer of the lion ran towards the animals announcing: “Hear the happy news my people! The announcer has arrived. May you be pleased, O pleasure seekers! That, dog of hell has been sent to hell. Be pleased, the evening of your life is deprived of his sharp teeth by the wrath of God. Be pleased, that the cruel fellow has been put into the well by his fate, by the justice, equity and generosity of the King. The one who crushed many heads with his paw has been broomed like rubbish by the broom of death. The one who had no other work than cruelty has been caught by the cries of the oppressed and beaten up. His neck is broken, and his brain smashed, and our life is released from the prison of hardship caused by him. He has been lost and obliterated by the grace of God and become a lesson for you.

chapters.title: Animals Gather around the Rabbit
chapters.subtitle: Collection of the Animals around the Rabbit and Praising him No pleasures on Enemy’s Death Rabbit’s advice that the enemy’s death must not be celebrated

paras: All the animals assembled with great joy, laughter, pleasure, enthusiasm and excitement. They all surrounded him, and he was in the middle like a lamp, and they all prostrated to him saying: “You are an angel from the sky or a fairy or you are the Izra’iil for lions. Whatever we have is ransomed for you. The domination of your hands and arms is perfect. God has flowed this water in your stream. Honorable are your hands and arms. Tell us about your events that they may be a treatment for our pain, and an ointment for the injuries of our souls. Tell us as to how you designed this method, and how you destroyed that tyrant with your trick. Tell us once again so that we may be pleased, as we have suffered a lot at the hands of that cruel monster, and have received a thousand injuries from him. That narration increases our pleasure and is a food for our souls and enhancement for our life.”

The rabbit replied: “Gentlemen! It was all a support from God, as otherwise what is the worth of a rabbit in this world. He gave me the strength and put the light in my heart. The light of the heart further strengthened my hands and feet.”

He said:” Victories are received from God, and by God alone they are again altered. Know that all successes are His grants and therefore prostrate to Him with all your life and soul. God grants support to the people in turns and circulates it and exhibits to those who have high imaginations and keen observations. Therefore, be not proud and happy of the domination that you got, as your turn came. You are tied with this scheme of arrivals and departures of dominations.

Such of the people whose dominion is above the provisions of this world are the real kings, who are alive for ever with their souls enjoying heavenly bliss. As against them, when you get your domination on the basis of your turn, you have no reason to be proud of. If you give up the links with this domination even for a day or two, you will enjoy the drinks of paradise, as this worldly dominion does not last for more than a day or two. Rather, day or two is also a long period, as this world lasts for a moment. One who gives it up will be in comforts. Know the meaning of “comfort comes upon giving it up”, as is stated by the wise. It means that the comfort is a drink of everlasting life. Leave this world for the dogs by shattering the glass of pride into pieces. The saying goes: world is a dead body, and its seeker is a dog.

chapters.title: Minor and Major Jihaad
chapters.subtitle: Exegesis of: “We return from a minor Jihaad to the Major Jihaad”: Hadith(s)

paras: O elderly persons! We have killed the external enemy, but there is a stronger enemy than this in our inside. Killing of this external enemy is not a matter of wisdom and bravery but the internal enemy is not within the control of the rabbit. The commanding self within is a hell, and hell is such a python, which done not care for the seven oceans. Even if it drinks the water of the seven oceans, its heat-causing-burning-pain does not get reduced. Rocks and the unbelieving-stone-hearted fellows enter into it in shame and disgrace as has been said in the Quran: And if you do it not, and you can never do it, then guard yourselves against the fire prepared for unbelievers, whose fuel is of men and stones: Fattaqu naarallati wa quduhannaasu wa alhiiaartu, u‘iddat lilkafiriin, (Baqara: 2:24)

sections.heading: Hell: never Satisfied
paras: The hell of the commanding self (nafs al ammaara) will not be satisfied with this food at all, until God issues forth an announcement asking whether its belly is filled? It says, “not yet: is there no more fire, burning and pain” as stated in the Quran: On the day We will ask Hell, ‘are you filled to the full? It will say: “are there anymore (to come”)? Youma naqulu lijahannama halimtalati, wa taqulu hal min maziid. (Surah:Qaf : 50:30). It has made a morsel of the world and swallowed it, and inspite of it, its stomach is yelling: Hal min maziid: ‘are there anymore?’

God will step upon it from the world beyond the space, (laa makaan); and then it will remain silent from its job. God will say “Be”, and it becomes, as God has said in the Quran: Verily when He intends a thing, His command is “Be”, and it is: Innama amruhu iza arada shai’an an yaqulu lahu  kun fayakunu (Surah: Yasin:36:82)

sections.heading: Our Vicious self: Part of Hell
paras: As our vicious self is a part of hell and parts always have the character of the whole. Only the step of God can quench and kill its thirst. Arrows of others cannot kill it. And it is only the straight arrows that can shoot from the bow, but the arrows meant for hell are not straight. If you want to crush the vicious self, you should become a straight arrow and be shot straight from the bow.

The rabbit continued: “Now that I have finished my external battle, I turn towards the internal battle as the noble Prophet said after returning victoriously from battle: ‘We return from a minor battle to the major battle’. I seek strength from God who splits the ocean, so that I may dig up a mountain, like the mountain of Qaaf (Cacausus) with my tiny needle. You may see that it is easy to become an army-tearing lion, but this is not lionness. Lionness is in defeating your own inner vicious self, so that with the help of God, one may become a lion of God and get saved from the Pharaoh of the inner vicious self as did Hazrat Musa with him, by splitting the sea.

chapters.title: Roman Ambassador’s visit to H ‘Umar
chapters.subtitle: Arrival of a Roman Ambassador to Meet Hazrat ‘Umar

paras: In connection with this, you may hear an incident so that you may know of a part of the secret of my statement. An ambassador from the Roman emperor, after covering a long distance through forests, came to Madina. He asked the people about the location of their emperor’s palace, so that he could leave his horse and luggage in it. People said: ‘He has no palace. ‘Umar’s palace is his own bright life. Though there is a great talk about his great leadership, but he has a hut where he lives like a beggar. How can you see his palace, my brother, when there is an obstacle in the eyes of your heart? Clear the obstacles of the eyes of your heart and then develop the eyes to see his palace.

sections.heading: Cleanliness of Heart gives Different Sight
paras: Whoever has cleansed his heart of passions, can see the great court and palace of this king. When Hazrat Muhammad was cleansed of fire and smoke, “to whichever side he turned, he saw the presence of God: Ainama tuwallu fasamma wajhu Allah:  whichever side you turn, there is the presence of God: (Baqara:2:115)”. You are a friend of your insinuations, which are your enemies. How can you see the presence of God? Whoever has the door of his heart opened, can see every particle to be as bright as the sun. God is as bright among all as the sun is bright among the stars.

“If you keep the tips of your finger upon your eyes, you cannot see anything of the world. You may think over. Because you cannot see, the world is not annihilated. It exists. Your fingertips are the only unfortunate things that have hidden things from your sight. Take away your fingertips: you can see anything that you want to see. People of the days of Hazrat Noah asked him: “Where is the reward?” He said: “You have covered up your head and face with garments, and thus gone blind inspite of having eyes: As stated in the Quran: Ja’alu asabi’ahum fi aazanihim was astaghshow siyabahum, was asarru, wastakbarustikbran: They have only thrust their fingers into their ears, and covered themselves up with their garments, grown obstinate, and given themselves up to arrogance: (Nuh:71:7).

sections.heading: Real Man is One who Observes
