If you become a flower, children will pluck you out. Hide your grain and become a net. Hide the flower and become green moss on the terrace of the palace. Whoever increases his beauty will have to face so many troubles. Eyes, envies and angers will fall on it like water falling from a goatskin. Enemies out of jealousy will tear it and friends will also spoil its time and freedom. One who has not cared for the benefits of the spring season cannot know the worth of this beauty.

You should run towards the graceful protection of God, who has felled thousands of graces upon the souls. God’s protection is such in which everything becomes your servant. Water and fire will become your soldiers. Do you not know that H. Noah and H. Musa had got the friendship of water which became destroyer of their enemies? Fire had become a fort for H.Ibrahim and protected him and became smoke for the heart of Nimrod. Hills invited H.Yahya (John) for protection and felled rocks on his enemies who had run after him to catch him. The hills had called H.Yahya: run towards us, and come to us, so that we may protect you as sharp swords

chapters.title: Parrot’s Advice
chapters.subtitle: Parrot’s saying Goodbye to the Merchant, Giving Advice; and Flying off

paras: The parrot gave sincere advice to the merchant and thereafter said: “Salutations to you. Be secure and let me depart. I say goodbye to you, my master. You have been kind to me; you granted freedom from prison and darkness. Goodbye my master, I shall go to my country. I pray for you that you may also become free like me, some day”.
The merchant said: “You may depart and go under the protection of God. Thanks to you, you have shown me a new way”.

The parrot turned towards India, its native place. He was very pleased to enjoy comforts after a long trial of difficulties. The merchant said to himself: “This is an advice to me that I should go on the way of the parrot, as that is the right way. My life is no lesser than parrot’s. I need a life that should have right steps to proceed”.

chapters.title: Honour has many Risks
chapters.subtitle: Harms of Getting Honored by People and Popularity

paras: Human body is like a cage and therefore, it is a thorn for the soul, with the treacheries carried on both from inside and outside. One says: ‘I am your secret bearer’; and the other says; ‘No, I am your friend’. One says: ‘There is no one like you in the world in excellence, perfectness, benevolence and generosity’. The other one says: ‘Both the worlds are your property; lives of all of us are a grant from you’. This one says: ‘This a time for pleasure and joys; that other one says: ‘It is time for eating and drinking with friends.

When man sees that all the people are busy in their praises for him, he goes out of control in arrogance. He fails to know that there are thousands like him, and that Satan has thrown him into his stream of satanic water. Pleasures of the world and the food of mischiefs are tasty morsels. Don’t eat them as they are internally full of fire, though appearing fair from outside. Their smoke appears not instantly but later. Do not mistakenly say that you do not go after flattery. This very statement clarifies that you are internally after it; because if the flatterer instead of flattering says something ill of you, you feel hurt for a long time as it pricks you. You will say that he is telling of your ills as he has been deprived of some good deeds from you, which he was expecting from you. It will have an impact on your heart. This is also the case in your being flattered. Both these impacts remain for a very long time and become the capital of arrogance and treacheries. Flattery appears sweet but, ill-speaking appears bitter and therefore considered vicious. The ill-spoken words are like the laxative, which when taken inside cause uneasiness and trouble for the whole day. On the contrary, if you eat some sweet, its taste remains only for a short time. Its impact also is not lasting just as the impact of laxative. Only difference is, one lasts for the whole day and the other for a much shorter time, because the taste of sweet remains within your mouth only. Nobody comes to know of it, but the effects of laxative become known to others also. Find out the impact of one thing by comparing with its opposite. Sweets cause their impacts, invisible to others, but later may form a boil needing a prick of syringe. However, laxatives though troublesome for some time clean your inside of harmful and dirty matters.

The mischievous self of man becomes arrogant like Pharaoh with flattery. Therefore, be one of a humble lowly self; and do not crave for leadership. Become a humble servant and not a king as far as possible. Become a receiver of hittings like the ball and not the hitting bat. When you lose your charm and cease to be graceful, the hearts of friends will be disgusted. Those very people, who spoke of your charm and generosity, will call you as a ghost. When they see you at their door, they will say that a dead body raised its head above the grave and come out. Similarly, those who called a handsome boy as beautiful like angel to trap him in their net treacherously, disgrace him when he attains adulthood. Even the devil feels ashamed of making enquires and speaking about him. Satan who goes to men to spread mischiefs will not come towards you, as you are worse than him. So long as you were mean, Satan was after you, ran along with you, and made you drink wine. But when you attain perfectness in devilishness, know this you unworthy fellow, that the unworthy Satan runs away from you. He was holding on to your lapel and hanging on to it, but he ran away from you after your perfectness.

chapters.title: What God wanted, came about
chapters.subtitle: Exegesis of : What God Desired Became, and What He did not, Become; Ma Shaa’ Allahu Kaanaa Wa Mallam yashaa’u lam yakun

sections.heading: Grants from God
paras: We have said all this; but we are nothing except with the grants of God. Without the grants of God and of His special servants (prophets and saints), records of even angels are black. O God, the all powerful, You cannot be quantified or qualified. You are beyond comprehension on Your own, but You can be understood through Your creations. This high-level palace, the sky is made by You, which is the largest in size of all creations. You are aware of the apparent and hidden conditions of everything to the fullest extent, without any deficiency and efficiency of the qualities and quantities. O God, Your grants meet all needs of all; and thinking of anyone other than You or along with You, has no justification whatsoever. You have given your guidance to such an extent that through that You have hidden all defects. Pray join the drop of wisdom You have given in the beginning, with Your rivers of wisdom. I have a drop of knowledge in my heart which is at the risk of being spoiled by the mud of my body and passions. Protect it well before it is overlapped by them and, well before air dries it up. I ask You for this before drying up, even though You are capable of upsetting the product of dried-up process and recreating that drop after drying up by air. The drop that is dried up by air, or slipped from its place cannot be away from the treasury of Your power. Even if it gets into a single non-existence or a hundred non-existences, it will come to You with all obedience when You call it back.

sections.heading: Non-Existents Come into Existence
paras: There are hundreds of thousands of opposing things that destroy their opponents, but Your grace brings them back to life. Every moment caravans upon caravans of non-existents are coming into existence. Of them all in particular, all thoughts and wisdoms sink into the ocean of sleep and get lost into non-existence. And in the morning, they raise their heads for Your worship as the fishes raise their heads in the oceans. During autumn, look at the hundreds of thousands of branches and leaves of the trees meeting their defeat and enter into the ocean of death. The crow puts on the black mourning dress, and like a professional mourner, mourns at the dried up greenery of the garden. And then comes the command from the Master of the gardens, the Lord of the worlds, to the non-existences to return whatever was eaten by them from the gardens. He tells the black death to return whatever was eaten by it, like plants, flowers, leaves and grass. Then spring comes back.

sections.heading: Impacts of Seasons within man
paras: In view of this, my brother, think over for some time and see that within you also there are seasons of spring and autumn every moment. Get away from yourself for some time and dive into the oceans of light. Your autumn is in your establishing relationship with worldly matters; and your spring is when you devote yourself to understand the hidden meanings of spiritual matters. And then look into the garden of heart blooming and fresh with buds, flowers, cypresses and jasmines. Excessiveness of leaves has brought down the branches of trees, and excessiveness of flowers has engulfed from forests to palaces. These matters come from the absolute wisdom of God and are the fragrances from the gardens of cypresses and sunbul (a fragrant grass). You feel the fragrance of flowers from the places where there were no flowers. You see the intoxication of wine from the place where there is no wine. These fragrances and intoxications are not of the worldly type but of the other-than-worldly-type.

sections.heading: If Not Giver, Be Recipient
paras: Fragrance of the spiritual world guides you like the army-guide to paradise and abundance: Kauth(s)ar [the heavenly fountain of unbound grace and knowledge, mercy and goodness, truth and wisdom, spiritual power and insight, which was granted to the holy Prophet, the man of God, and in some degree or other to all men and women, who are sincere devotees of God –Abdulla Yusuf Ali]. This fragrance is a medicine for the eyes to brighten them, just as the fragrance of H. Yusuf’s shirt had returned the lost sight of the eyes of H. Yakub.

Foul smell blinds the eyes, but the nice fragrance of H. Yusuf helps the eyes to brighten. You are not a H. Yusuf to give such fragrance, and therefore, become a recipient of the fragrance like H. Yakub, and live in pains and cries like him. You cannot become a beauty like Shireen, as that beauty was a special grace of God to her, but you can put efforts to become Farhad, her lover, who resorted to breaking the rocks to make a stream of milk for her. Similarly, if you are not a Laila who was the most beautiful person in Majnun’s view, you may strive to become Majnun.

chapters.title: Coquetry is not for Ugly
chapters.subtitle: Exegesis of the Statement of Philosopher Sanaai (May his Secrets be Cleansed) Story of a hungry Instrument-Player during the days of H. ‘Umar in a Graveyard

sections.heading: “Coquettishness and lovable styles require a rose like beautiful face; and when you do not possess this, do not go nearer to ill-manners. If you cannot please, do not, at least displease. Efforts to cast magic spells of the eyes upon others by a blind person is of no use. So also, it is not proper for one with an ugly face to be coquettish”. — Sanaai
paras: Hear this advice from Sanaai, the Ghaznavid philosopher to bring about some freshness in an old body. Hear this quatrain with all heart and soul, so that you may attain spiritual elevation to get entirely out of the body of mud and water. Hear his advice with full attention and convert your wisdom into spirit, and your spirit into wisdom. That Ghaznavid philosopher and great master has said something great: know it and remember it.

Do not try to be playful and coquettish before Yusuf, but be only a humble and helpless Yaqub, full of sighs and cries. In the story of the Parrot and Merchant that you have heard earlier, the death of the parrot meant total submission and helplessness. So that the blow of H. ‘Isa’s breath may give back life to you, make yourself good and prosperous. In the spring season rocks do not become green with plants. Therefore, become soft mud so that flowers of various colors may come upon you. For years together you had been a heart-scrapping-sharp-stone; at least for a trial, become soft mud for some time. In connection with this, hear this story, so that you may know of the beliefs of the rightful men.

sections.heading: Highly Merited Musician
paras: Have you heard of an instrument-player and singer during the days of H.‘Umar, very grand in stature. Nightingales would go semi-conscious upon hearing his voice. His beautiful tunes would cause hundred semi-consciousnesses out of one semi-consciousness. His melodies organized gatherings and sittings and upset everything as though it was a doomsday. He was like Israfil whose bugle sound would give life to the dead. (Israfil is the name of the angel, who would blow his bugle upon approach of the doomsday, when the organization of the world would be upset, and men would go unconscious. Again, after forty years, he would blow his bugle for the second time when everything would come back to original order).
He had the voice of Israfil which would give wings and feathers to elephants. Israfil would organize his sounds someday and give life to a man having died a hundred years earlier.

sections.heading: Songs by Nonphysical Entities
paras: Saints also have such tunes within them, which give highly valuable life to the seekers. But these tunes cannot be heard by the sensory ears as, being engaged in worldly affairs, they become polluted. Men do not hear the songs of the fairies, as they are unaware of the language and phrases of the fairies. Though the songs of the fairies are also of this tangible world and must be audible in normal circumstances, but the song of the heart is far above these songs. Because both men and fairies are in the prison of this world and therefore, are prisoners of the prison of recklessness. As you are just a beginner, you may read Surah Al-Rahman in the Quran so as to become aware of the secrets of the fairies. Read ayats addressing to the groups of jinns wherein they are told along with men to pass through the zones of the skies, if they can: Ya ma’shara aljinni wa al insi inis tata‘tum an tanfuzu min aqtaari alsamaawati, wa al ardhi fanfizu: laa tanfuzuuna illa bisultaan: O assembly of jinns and men! If it be you can pass beyond the zones of the heavens and the earth, you may pass! You shall not be able to pass without authority! (Rahman: 55:33)

sections.heading: Songs of Aulia Give Life
paras: Songs within the hearts of the aulia, first tell about the parts of the non-existence (‘Adam) and warn them to come out of non-existence and eliminate their thoughts and imaginations of non-existence, and assert their physical existence, and then give up these thoughts and imaginations, that promote yourself. Be warned, your physical existence is a non-existence: come out of it. Remove the thoughts and imaginations, that non-existence is something of the past; and upon your coming into existence (as a body), it has ceased and ended. That is not so. Your soul was not born nor developed. It existed even prior to you. Your physical body is also non-existence. Come out of it and enter into the real life of existence of the spiritual, real existence. You are entirely sunk into this world that came into existence which is destructible. It is not permanent. The permanent thing is your soul which has neither come out into existence, nor does it have a scope to go into non-existence. You can only do this much as to realize this fact about the soul and consider it to exist.

sections.heading: Body: A Grave of the Soul
paras: You do not know anything about these facts. This can be made known to you by the perfect teachers, who only can inform you. Their job is not this much only.  They have many other things to do beyond this. You can know of this if you search for one such teacher and your reality will be brightly shown to you by him. If I tell a little of the contents of their songs, souls will come out of their graves and sepulchers. Take your ears nearer to them when they are nearer to you, because you have to hear their songs which are silent, as they do not sing their songs. Beware: aulia are the Israfil of these times. Just as Israfil’s bugle gives life to the dead bodies, so also the saints give life to dead hearts and give new vigor to their bodies. Life is dead and buried in the graves of the bodies and their songs will make the souls shake within the shrouds and graves of the bodies. The sound of their songs gives life to the dead souls.

sections.heading: God Becomes One with Man
paras: They will say that this sound is different from other sounds, as giving life to the dead is an act of God and this sound is a godly sound. When the souls hear the songs of the aulia, they move in great pleasure on the correct path telling: “We were dead and totally inactive. When God’s voice came, we all got up. God’s voice comes from behind the curtain, but openly gives unexpected things just as He gave baby Jesus (‘Isa) to H. Mary (Maryam). O people! You have been annihilated under your skins. Come out of this non-existence upon the call of the friendly saints. Their call, in reality, is the call of God, even though, it comes out of the mouth of saints or men. God has told them; I am your tongue and eyes. I am your feelings, likes and dislikes. He hears through Me and he sees through Me. You are now, not just the secret bearer but the secret itself. A Qudsi Hadith(s) says, that is God says: ‘When I love a man, I become his ear through which he hears; and I become his hand through which he holds.’

chapters.title: Knowledge Passes on to Generations
chapters.subtitle: Explanation of Hadith(s): God is with Him Who Becomes One with God: Man Kaana Lillaahi, Kaanallahu Lahu

paras: When, out of love for God, you become one for Him, He becomes yours because God is for such persons. He says: “Sometimes I call you as ‘you’ and sometimes I say ‘I’. Whatever I say is the same as I am the bright sun. There will be no difference between Mine and your calling. When I shine from your niche for some time all difficulties of the world get solved. When an unsuitable darkness comes from some side, it becomes bright like the daylight, when Our radiance falls. Darkness that cannot be wiped off by the sun, gets converted into bright day when We blow Our air on it.

sections.heading: Knowledge Passes from Generation to Generation
paras: God taught the names of things to H. Adam and these names were taught by H. Adam to his progeny. Whether you take water from the stream or from the vessel, it is the same as water taken from the stream. Whether you take light from the moon or from the sun, there is no difference, as moon also has received light from the sun. Seek light from the stars, when you find them, as the Prophet has said: ‘My companions are my stars’. (Asshabii unujuum). Seeking guidance from his companions is like getting the same as from the Prophet. Take the light from H. Adam or from God, it is the same. Wine taken from the vessel or from the dry hollowed gourd is the same. This dried gourd is stronger than the vessel, and it does not consume nor is helpless to contain wine like you. When you drink wine, it gets lost, but it remains in the dried gourd intact.

sections.heading: Light is Light from Anyone
paras: The noble Prophet said: It is pleasing information for one who has seen me and also for the one who has seen him who has seen me. That is, the seer of the face of my seer is like my seer. Whoever looked at the lamp that received light from the candle, is like the one who looked at the candle. Similarly, a hundred lamps receive light from one lamp and looking at the last lamp is like looking at the first. In similar manner the knowledge of esoteric matters passed on from ear to ear is the same as spoken into the first ear; and passed on to close disciples by the Aulia. This can be considered as light from the first lamp or from the last. Esoteric light also can be taken from the first or the last knower. It is the same as taking light from the first lamp or from the later lamps. This knowledge is coming from generation to generation till our generation.

chapters.title: Legacy of the prophets Exists
chapters.subtitle: To Explain the Meaning of Hadith(s): There are fragrances of Your Lord in Your Days: Be Careful to Take them. (inna lirabbikum fii ayyaami dahrikum nafahatun, falaa fata‘aridu)

paras: The noble Prophet said that fragrances of God have come forward much in these days. Keep the ears of consciousness open to attract there fragrances. Fragrances came, looked at you, and passed off giving life to anyone who desired it before leaving. Now, another fragrance has come and be careful not to miss it this time. The hellish soul found it to be one that would cool its fire and a dead soul got life from it.

sections.heading: Man Took the Risk
paras: The fire of hell found it to be one that would extinguish fire; and a dead body would get a garment of life from it. It gives the pleasure of freshness and liveliness. It does not create movements as other creatures would cause. If it happens to fall on the earth and sky, they will lose their hardness and flow like water. With the fear of this, the heavens and earth refused to undertake, being afraid thereof. So also, the mountains were terribly afraid of it as stated in Quran: Inna ‘aradhnal amaanata ‘ala alsamaavati, wa alardhi wa aljibaali faabaina an yahmilnaha, wa ashfaqna minha, wa hamalaha al-insaan. We did indeed offer the trust to the heavens and the earth and the mountains; but they refused to undertake it, being afraid thereof; but man undertook it; (Ahzaab: 33:72).

sections.heading: Fragrances Impact Clean Hearts
paras: Earlier these fragrances of radiances were available in strange ways; but when sensory desires dominated, they stopped coming. For a few morsels of earthly gains, even men as wise as Luqman were alleged to be overtaken. (He was accused to have eaten the fruits from the master’s garden, from which he came out as innocent. This has already been narrated earlier. Earthly materials are taken as the means of accusations by the enemies). Give up these desires and regain the wisdom of Luqman. With the desire of these earthly pleasures, you are so anxious that you lose your wisdom. Clean yourself of these desires and make yourself free. But Luqman did not have this greed to get its impacts; but out of your greed, you are not capable of differentiating between all this. Consider the date you see as a thorn and ignore it. If you do not change your mental attitude, you will remain as thankless and greedy.

[Luqman was a sage belonging to Arab traditions. Very little is known of his life. He lived for a long time. He lived in Arabia during the days of ‘Aad people. He was so wise that he is considered as wisdom personified. He belonged to a humble station, being a slave or carpenter, and he refused all worldly possessions. His name is used as a symbol of wisdom]

sections.heading: Choice between Flowers and Thorns
paras: Luqman’s soul (and life) is a garden of God. He can be linked with the fruits and flowers of the garden and not the thorns. Inspirations from God fall upon the soul and wisdom, which are personified as Luqman. The camel is an eater of thorns and thorns are meant for it and not for men. But men of wisdom, like the children of Muhammad Mustafa ride on this camel and command it. That is: soul and wisdom command all baser things including their own bodies. You are behaving like a camel. You carry wisdom and soul as a wreath of flowers on your back like the camel. The flowers in the wreath can give a fragrance as a hundred gardens would give, but you are not interested in this. You are interested only in the thorny acacia trees and deserts. You are so lowly that you cannot pick up flowers from among the thorns. You are trying to run here and there in search of the garden, but not reaching, and always asking as to where the garden is. You are pricked by the thorns in your soles and your eyes have gone blind. How can you run in these conditions? Man, who is so large as not to be occupied by this world is now hidden behind the sharp, narrow point of the thorn.

sections.heading: Human Soul Has No Gender
paras: Muhammad Mustafa as a chosen gnostic came to talk to you and addressed your soul with the title; “Humaira” (red colored) of his dear wife ‘Ayesha and said, “come O Humaira and talk to me.” By Humaira he meant your soul. The gnostic addresses his own soul as “Humaira” and tells it to throw the horseshoe, into fire so that your horseshoe may become a mountain. [This refers to a black magic practice carried on by some magicians who read some omens on a horseshoe blow upon it with the name of person to be affected by blackmagic and throw it in fire to destroy that person). The horseshoe meant here is the human soul, which should be as large as a mountain to crush the human body.

You may know that the word ‘Humaira’ is feminine in Arabic language. It does not matter if soul is addressed as feminine Humaira, as human soul is not different for different genders. It is the same for both. The human soul is above masculine and feminine gender as this is human soul and it does not exist as a product of dry and wet foods unlike animal soul. It is only animal soul which has genders which grows and is connected with bread and food, which behaves differently at different times. Human soul is pleasure-giving with love, gets pleased and is pleasure itself. Pleasure cannot be without pleasure and is always pleasing. But the corrupt gets pleased with corruption and always stretches his hand for corrupt gains. He does not know that there are hundreds of pleasures in the hands kept unstretched and within folds. Sugar is sweet by itself, but it cannot be with you always. With your sincerity and love, you become sugar itself, and you will always be sweet like sugar, as sweetness and sugar cannot be separated. The insincere are pure poison. O my God! Grant us the company of good, sincere creatures.

sections.heading: Wisdom and Love are Different
paras: When one is in love with God, one gets food, soft like a special wine. He enters into a situation of love where wisdom becomes unworthy. One with a little interpretative wisdom understands a little of the existence of God but never of love. He is wise and smart only in knowing, but he cannot love Him. Love becomes known only when one gets annihilated in God. That is so even with the angels. If the angels start applying their wisdom, they become devils as it happened with Iblis. Wisdom is a friend in our talks and actions, but when you enter into a state (Haal), it ceases to exist. It is of no worth if it does not get lost in love with its own pleasure. In its obedience and submission, it gets many achievements, otherwise it is held up in difficulties. Life is perfectness and its callings also are perfectness; and its impacts are pleasing, as the noble Prophet said to his Abyssinian companion, H. Bilal, to please with his voice.

sections.heading: Melodious Voice Caused Deeper Sleep and Unconsciousness
paras: He said to H. Bilal: Raise up your melodious voice, which is blown into your heart by my grace when it is playing. Make it audible to others. Give life to your rose with it, raise up the bulbul so that it may sacrifice its life on the rose.

This is a melodious voice which had made H. Adam semiconscious and made all residents of the sky unconscious. H. Muhammad also had become unconscious with it when his salat could not be performed due to his resting after a long journey on one night. He did not wake up from his prosperous sleep, until the dawn passed, and forenoon came about. His deep sleep, because of that melodious voice was like that of a bride groom, who kisses his bride’s hand, which brings about hitherto unknown pleasures. In similar manner, he was engrossed in the beauty of God forgetting everything, even his salat which he said to be the coolness of his eyes, which he never avoided to perform. The melodious voice of H. Bilal took him into deeper sleep nearby to unconsciousness instead of waking him up.

sections.heading: Domination of Love Upsets Minds
paras: Love and the loved one are both hidden. Do not find fault in my calling the essence of love as “bride”. I was out of control of myself in calling it as such. I had only to keep my mouth shut in this matter. I would have done it, if I had a little free time of consciousness. But the dominance of the state compelled me to express a little of it, which I did not think of as anything other than a bride who was hidden from all but not from the bridegroom. My state told me to speak out and warned me that it was not indecent. Such words come from the compulsions of the hidden situations. One is compelled to say unconsciously in such circumstances. Such words can be indecent in the view of those who see nothing but indecencies; but the spirits from the hidden world of spirits do not see any indecency. It may be indecent if they come from the mouths of the ignorant, but not when they come from the mouths of those nearby to and accepted ones by God.

sections.heading: Infidelity is Wisdom
paras: Infidelity is also a creation full of wisdom when seen from God’s view, but it is vicious when seen from our view. Meanings of the words become different in a relative manner from the positions of good and bad. I have said so much about God. If one out of a hundred statements is defective, do not hold me for it. A piece of straw has the same value and worth as of sugar in a sugar candy.  Both are weighed together in the balance. Similarly, when good and bad are relative to situations and persons, human body may be inferior to the soul from the point of view of the common folk, but elevated persons may consider their bodies to be as clean as their souls. Therefore, great men have not said this just for saying that the bodies of the clean spirited people are as clean as their souls. Their words, actions and remembrances are all undoubtedly clean and spotless. The body of their enemy is just a body and has no worth just as an extra point in one of the dice games, which is extra in name without any impact on the game’s result. He got mixed up with mud and got converted into mud, but one who understood them and reaped spiritual benefits from them became tasty with their salt and clay. That is a salt with which the noble Prophet became tannish which has very appealing impressions, and he had pleasing voice with words simple to hear and understand, which would impress both the learned and the lay. He said: “My brother Yusuf was fair-colored, and I am tannish.” He has also said “I am the most Fasih (one who talks in simple, articulate, pleasing, clear manner), and also I am one from the Quraish”.

sections.heading: Taste-giving-salt of Knowledge to Followers
paras: That taste-giving-salt to holy knowledge has passed from him to his followers as an inheritance and those followers are around you. He has said: “Learned people are the inheritors of prophets”. You may search for them. Some are in front of you, but you are not aware, as you do not have a thinking soul to look at them. If you consider what is before and behind you, it is only about your body and not your soul. What are in front and back, and above and below you, are related to body, but the soul is not confined or related to these dimensions. One who becomes aware of this gets a clear sight and prevents you from seeing only material things. You are busy in joys and sorrows only. You do not know that you will be annihilated even physically; and the annihilated also have no dimensions. If you go out of existence and non-existence you will have an everlasting life.

It is a rainy day. Move about till the night. But this is not a rain of water. It is a rain of the grants and graces of God. Get drenched in it. That apart, know this, apart from this, there is another rain which can be seen by the eyes of the soul only. Open the eyes of your soul and observe keenly, so that you may see the everlasting spiritual greenery.

chapters.title: Different rains from different clouds
chapters.subtitle: H. ‘Ayesha’s Questioning to the Prophet: It Rained but Your Prosperous Garments are not Drenched; and His Answer thereat.

paras: One day the Prophet along with his friends went to the graveyard for the burial of a dead body. His grave was filled with mud like planting a seed which gave him another life in the other world.

sections.heading: What the Trees Say
paras: The trees are like those who have been buried in the graves who have brought out and spread their arms giving a hundred Informations to those who have the ears to hear their words. They are giving a hundred signals and speaking to those who have the ears. Those with sharp ears hear their secrets, and the careless do not even hear the sounds. With their green tongues of leaves and long arms of branches, they are revealing the secrets hidden under the ground. During the rainy season they float and play on water like the geese, become beautiful with flowers like peacocks during spring season and become dark like crows during winter. God imprisoned these crows during winter but made them like peacocks later. Though winter season made the trees dead, he gave them new life in spring season with fresh leaves.

sections.heading: Denials by Philosophers and Atheists
paras: Deniers of God like the atheists and philosophers say that such has been the repetitions right from the beginning. What connections has the so-called generous Lord to do with this? They think that everything has been like this ever since, on its own. This world has been like this in eternity. With such thoughts arising from the brain, they have become blind. But the friends of God, who see things from the heart, find a blooming garden in their hearts. Every flower that has fragrance in it reveals the secrets of everything; but for the deniers, their fragrance is not palatable, even though it goes all around the world. They feel this fragrance nauseating like the insects of the dung, or noisy as frightened men feel. They keep themselves busy in their dialectics and sunk in them, and keep their eyelids sewn to avoid the flashes of lightenings. Rather, they do not have eyes, as eyes are those that search for places of peace both physical and mental.

sections.heading: Different Rain from Different Sky
paras: When the Prophet returned from the graveyard he went to the truthful lady, ‘Ayesha Siddiqa, who was a bearer of his secrets. When her eyes fell on him, she came closer and kept her hand on him, upon his headgear, his hair and face and his clothings, body and arms. The Prophet asked as to what she was searching so curiously.
She said: “There was a heavy rain today. I am trying to find out whether you are drenched. You have come from outside but are not drenched. This is quite strange”.
He asked: “What piece of cloth had you put on your head?”
She said: “I had made a scarf out of your mantle”.

He said: “O good hearted! That is why God has shown your clean eyes, a rain hidden from others. This rain was not from the clouds that you see. That was a different cloud from a different sky. Such a rain falls with a special hidden grace of God.”

With regard to directions given by the symbols hear this statement of Hakim Sanai, so that you may be aware of the treasures of the meanings of words. The statement is: if you open the inner eyes, you will get an eyeblack of your choice’.

chapters.title: Impacts of Different Seasons
chapters.subtitle: Exegesis of the Verse of Hakim Sanai, (May God Bless his Soul): Heavens of the World of Souls act upon the heavens of this World. There are Elevations, Depressions, Mountains and Rivers on the Path of the Soul

paras: The wise sage has indicated a great hint in this statement; rather through this oyster, he has produced a string of pearls. There are entirely different clouds, waters, heavens and suns of the hidden world, which are revealed upon the special bondsmen of God; and all other people are in doubts about them, as per the Quran: Afa-aiyina bil khalqil awwal. Bal hum fi labsin min khalqin jadiid: were we then weary with first creation? That they should be in confused doubt about a new creation: (Qaf: 50:15)

sections.heading: Different Kinds of Seasons
paras: There is a rain for sustenance, and there is rain for damage. Profits of the rains of the spring season are wonderful and the rains of the autumn are a cause of fever for the gardens. Rains of the naisan (spring) season bring pleasure; and after it are the autumn rains that cause sicknesses. The spring rain takes care, flourishes and pleases; but the autumn rain decolors and renders the garden yellowish with sickness. Similarly, you may consider winter, summer and windy seasons as different with different effects, and they are based upon a perfect principle.

In similar manner, there are different things of the hidden world with different impacts, causing profits, losses, sorrows, and slacknesses. The talks of the Abdals (those aulia of elevated level who have crushed and converted the normal human vices into virtues) also cause a season of spring, which brings about greenery in the hearts and souls. Their breaths are the winds for the souls just as the rains and winds are for the trees. They bring about great changes among the common men. A dried-up tree loses it wretched condition with their soul inspiring breaths. Air of the different seasons plays its role and passes off, and all living things find out their qualities and submit themselves to its impacts. The non-living cannot realize and remain effectless. It is a tragedy for those men who could not realize and got benefitted.

chapters.title: Esoteric Meanings of Winds
chapters.subtitle: Meaning of the Hadith(s): Consider the Wind of the Spring Season, as a prize as it Affects your Bodies in a Similar manner as it Affects your Trees; and Protect yourself from the Wind of the Autumn season, for it Affects upon your Body as it Affects on your Trees: Ightanimuu bardaa al rabi‘i innahu ya‘malu bi abdaanikum kamaa ya‘malu bi ashjaarikum, wa ajtanibu barda alkharifi, fainnahu ya‘malu bi abdaanikum kamaa ya‘malu bi ashjaarikum

paras: Hear the statement of the Prophet, my dear and remove your doubts and denials. The Prophet said: Do not cover up your body from the coolness of the spring season as it does the same with your bodies as it does with your trees. Its coolness should be taken as a great prize. It is so, also for the gnostics who search for hidden truths. Remove your coverings in this season and go toward the gardens. But protect yourself from the wind of the autumn season, as it does the same to your body as it does with the gardens and grapes. They get destroyed.

Reporters of this hadith(s) have taken this in its plain exoteric meaning and have remained satisfied with that. They remained unaware of the inner esoteric meaning. They looked at the mountain but not at the mines available beneath it. That wind of the autumn in God’s view is the wind of the commanding-self issuing wrong commands and passions. Wisdom and soul are absolute spring and existence. If you cannot understand this with your immature wisdom go in search of one with perfect wisdom. Then, your immature wisdom will become perfect with his perfect wisdom. Perfect wisdom will become a chain to control the passions and commanding-self.

Thus, the interpretation would be that winds of the pure breath of the good people are like the winds of the spring season which are the life of the leaves and grapes. The soft and harsh words of the aulia should not be avoided as they are the protectors and supporters of your faith. Whether they speak to you softly and harshly, their words must be taken with pleasure so as to get protected from heat, cold and hell. Their speaking softly or harshly is a fresh spring for life and the wealth of truth, confidence and servitude, as the garden of life remains fresh with their winds. The ocean of the heart is filled with their gems. Even if a piece of grass is lost from their gardens, sorrows surround the hearts of the wise.

chapters.title: Vices also are needed for the world
chapters.subtitle: H. Ayesha’s Asking the Prophet as to What was the Secret of the Rain of That Day

paras: Then, the truthful ‘Ayesha Siddiqa put a very sincere question in all humanity, discipline and love: “O Explainer of life and the essence of existence!  What is the wisdom behind today’s rain? Is this a rain of grace, or a warning of God’s justice? Is it a rain felling the benevolences of God as in the rain of spring season, or a rain full of troubles like the one of autumn?”

sections.heading: World cannot go with Good alone
paras: He said: “It is for giving solace to a sorrowful heart, which is cast upon the progeny of H. Adam by various troubles. If men were to remain in the heat of these troubles, there would have been great calamities and deficiencies. This world would have been ruined resulting in the vanishing of greed from people’s hearts. This world rests upon the pillars of recklessness on the part of men. Wisdom and care are a calamity for this world, as this world cannot go along without foolish and reckless people. Care and wisdom are required for that other world, and if they dominate here, this world will become lowly and worthless (without progress). Wisdom is like the sun and greed is like ice; and heat of the sun melts ice into water, and this world which is full of rubbish is swept and rendered clean by this water. From that world, it falls in small quantities from time to time, so that this world may not be totally devoid of greed and jealousy. If it falls in large quantities, there will be no merit and defect in the world; everything will become the same and this cannot go on. There is no end to this explanation. Take us to the story of that musician.

chapters.title: Pleasures of the outer world
chapters.subtitle: Left over narrative of the Old Musician and His Escape

paras: That musician had kept the world in great elation. His voice used to create strange thoughts in the minds of the audiences. The birds of heart used to fly with his melodies; and his tunes used to scatter the consciousness of the soul. When time passed and he became old, the falcon of his life became a catcher of mosquitoes. Mosquito is not an ordinary creature. Falcon is nothing before it. It can make even an elephant weak and helpless.

sections.heading: Impacts of Old Age
paras: The musician’s waist bent like the curvature of a water pot and his eyebrows gave appearance of tails. His soft-life-inspiring voice became bad, unpalatable and ear piercing. That sound that made Venus, (considered as the dancing girl of the heavens), go euphorie became like the braying of an old donkey. The world makes bad of good things. There is none who did not become sorrowful after a time of pleasure, and every roof at some time or other comes down under the feet.

The only exceptions to these changes are the voices of the beloveds of God, who have their sounds kept in their breasts. Even the bugle of soor that Israfiil blows for the second time to bring the dead to life, is an echo of their sounds. Their inner qualities make others also receive their impacts. Even after their death, they keep us alive. Their sounds drag the worries of the world towards them and provide the pleasures of the inspirations from God and of the secret knowledge.

As this musician had become very old and weak, he was deprived of his earnings and craved for bread to eat. He said to God: “O God, You have given me a long life and your grants to this mean fellow. I have sinned for seventy years, but you did not deprive me of my food even for a day. Now I have no earnings and I am your guest today. But I shall play my instrument for your sake as I am your slave”.

sections.heading: Large Expanse of that world
paras: So, saying, he lifted his instrument and went in search of God towards the graveyard of Madina with long deep sighs. He said to himself: “I shall play the instrument and seek a prize as God accepts even counterfeit coins wholeheartedly”. He played the instrument for a long time and cried much, made a pillow of his instrument and felled himself on a grave. He went into sleep and the bird of his soul got released from the cage, leaving the instrument and its player at their place. It got freed from the body and the pains of the world on reaching the world of simplicity in the abode of human souls. His soul started singing, saying: “How good it would be if it is allowed to live there itself. I get extremely pleased in the springful garden of this hidden place of pleasures. I can roam about here without feet and feathers and eat sweets without lips and teeth. Getting rid of all anxieties and sorrows, it can engage me here in total engagement of the thoughts and remembrance of God along with other happy-going residents of the heavens. I can shut my eyes and see the entire world and collect roses and fragrant grass without touching them.

“Water birds have sunk into the river of honey. There is the fountain of blessed water about which God had given direction to H. Ayub (Job) to bathe himself and drink to get cured of his sickness, as a result of which, from his head to foot, he got rid of all troubles, as clean as the light of the dawn. That world is so wide and large that if the sky of this world would become more than ten times its size, it would be shorter and narrower in size. Even if this Math(s)navi were to become as large as the size of the sky, it would not contain even half of the affairs of that world. The expanse of the land and sky of that world have shortened my heart so much that it is shattered into pieces. That world, that is visible to me in my sleep is so large that it has untied all my feathers and wings. If anyone were to see the road towards that world, one would not remain in this world even for a moment. But a command came to me: Do not be greedy. When the thorn is removed from sole, get up and walk away.”
But his soul was telling him to stay there only in the environment of benevolence and mercy.

chapters.title: Commands from God in a dream
chapters.subtitle: Hidden voice telling to H. ‘Umar to give money to the Fellow, sleeping in the Graveyard

paras: At this time, H. ‘Umar was overtaken by sleep so much that he could not control himself. He was surprised as it was not a time for sleep. This had come from the hidden world and it was not without a purpose. He kept his head down and went into sleep, saw a dream, in which he heard a voice from God, which was heard by his soul: a sound that is the source of all sounds and callings. This sound alone is the real sound and all other sounds in the world are its echoes. Turks, Kurds, Persians and Arabs recognize this sound without its coming from the lips and being heard by ears. It is not dependent upon mouths and ears and heard by the Turks, Tajiks and Negroes: all understand this. Not only they, even the stones and wood recognize and understand it. Every moment the sound of: Alastu birabbikum; (Am I not your lord) comes to them. As it had happened immediately after the creation of everything, and all had responded: Yes! We do testify (Qaaluu Balaa).

All original creations of God, (substances), and those dependent upon them for creation (accidents) get intoxicated at this calling. Though they do not verbally say ‘yes’ at every occasion but their coming into existence form non-existence itself is a practical response to confirm ‘yes’. On what I have said about the understanding of commands and questions of God, hear this narrative right now. I have spoken of the understanding of stones and wood. There is narrative in this connection. Think deeply over it.

chapters.title: Acts of the non-living as of Hannana
chapters.subtitle: Crying of the Log of Wood “Hannana” due to its separation from the Prophet, as a large Number of People told him: We Do not see your Face when you sit upon it. The Prophet got made a Pulpit; And Hannana cried Loudly, and the Prophet talked to it.

paras: The log of wood cried like men of senses, when it was separated from the Prophet. It cried in the gathering of the people while he was giving his sermons, in such loud manner that all young and old heard it. His companions felt it strange that it is crying so loud as to be heard by nearby and far-off people. The Prophet asked it as to what it wanted. It replied: “My soul is injured upon your separation. When my soul is burnt due to your separation, how can I remain without crying for losing the companionship of the soul of the world (Prophet). I had been your place upon which you sat; and now you have discarded me, and the pulpit is now a place for you to sit upon”.

Then the prophet said: ‘O fortunate piece of wood! You have received the fortune of your inside. If you want, I shall make you a tree of dates and people from east and west will collect fruits from you. Or God may make you a cypress in the other world, so that you may remain fresh and everlasting”.

sections.heading: Materials also Speak
paras: Hannana replied: “I desire to last forever”.

Therefore, my dear reader, do not be lesser than a log of wood. The log was buried under the ground, which will be raised like humans on the day of resurrection, so that you may know that whomsoever God calls back, becomes useless for all jobs of the world. Whoever has work with God, attends to His work and becomes incapable of the works of the world. One, who is not granted the knowledge of secrets, cannot approve of the cries of the non-living things. To be with others, he will say by word of mouth that he believes in this, so that people may not call him a hypocrite, but not by his heart. If there had not been some people aware of the meaning of the word Kun (Be), this matter would not have been accepted in the world at all. Hundreds of thousands of blind followers would have got their semi-belief converted into total disbelief. Their followership and interpretations are based upon conjectures and they proceed only upon them.

That mean devil creates suspicions in their minds and these blind followers bow down their heads. The feet of the interpreters are made of wood and these are very weak. But the authorities on esoteric sciences and deep observers of hidden matters are so strong in their beliefs that large mountains feel surprised at their firmness.

sections.heading: People of Insight as Guides
paras: Sticks of the blind are their feet which they use to protect themselves from falling down. That horse rider who provides victory to the army is a king who provides far-sight to the faithful. If the blind find out their way with the help of their sticks, they come into the protection of the people of normal good eyes. If there are no people of normal sight, all the blind fellows will die. The blind cannot sow and reap in the farms, nor can they do any construction and business and make a living.

Similarly, if there are no people of deep insight with their mercies and graces, the wooden feet of the suspicious will not break. Their stick is nothing but speculations and arguments, but the stick of the godly gives them eyesight. Such a person gives you a stick to proceed forward, but you get angry and hit upon him with it. That is: God has given them wisdom and capacity to interpret to understand the prophets but you use it to counter their actions. When this stick of arguments goes against them to cause confusion, better that you break it into pieces. Do not keep yourself in the circle of the blind, and go into the circle of a man with deep inner-sight. Hold on to the lapel of the one who has given you the stick and think over as to what H. Adam got by disobedience. The Quran says: Adam disobeyed his Lord and allowed himself to be reduced: Fa‘asa Adamu rabbahu fagghawa (Taha 20:121) Think of the staff of H. Musa, which became a python and the miracle of H. Muhammad when the log of wood spoke out. With these miracles, the religion of H Mohammad beats the drum of victory five times a day.

sections.heading: Miracles Also, a Reason
paras: If these pleasures were not those that could be enjoyed rationally, there would have been no need for miracles. Whatever is understandable by your reasoning is accepted by you; and it does not need any miracle to prove it. Look at this strange thing unacceptable to wisdom, yet this remains in the hearts of all who accept it, because it comes from the inner sight of those devoted to God. With the fear of these men, devils and beasts’ resort to far off places like islands, out of their jealousy. Even the deniers hide their heads under grass out of the fear of prophets.

There are also some people who to keep up their honor as Muslims, resort to treacheries to prevent you from knowing their reality. Just as the makers of counterfeit coins imprint the name of the king on the coins, they openly talk of the words of the unity of God and of the shar‘, but they mix up poison in the bread, but in their heart of hearts they have no belief. The rationalist philosopher dares not speak out boldly as he fears that the true faith would out-beat him. He says that matter has no life and therefore it cannot be obedient to anybody. He does not see that his hands and feet give evidence against him though they too are matter, yet they are obedient to his soul. They say so with their mouths, but their limbs stand against them.

chapters.title: Pebbles spoke out as Miracle
chapters.subtitle: Showing of a Miracle by the Prophet, when Pebbles In the fist of Abu Jehl gave evidence of his prophethood

paras: Abu Jehl was holding some pebbles in his fist and asked the Prophet to tell fast as to what he was holding. “Tell me, what I have hidden in my fist as you claim that you are aware of the secrets of heavens.” The Prophet asked him: “Do you want me to say what is in your fist or those things themselves should say about me that I am on the truth”. Abu Jehl said: “The second option is rather strange”. Then the Prophet said: “God is all powerful and can do more than that”. Then the Prophet said: “There are six pebbles. You may hear their recitations clearly.” Immediately thereat, every pebble started reciting the article of faith: There is no God but Allah and Muhammad is a strung gem”.

When Abu Jehl heard this from the pebbles, he got angry, threw them on the ground. He said: “There cannot be another magician like you. You are the leader and king of magicians”. He felt highly jealous of this miracle and in anger went toward his house, away from the Prophet. That unfortunate lowly fellow fell into the well of darkness.

He saw a miracle but became stronger in his misfortune and ran fast towards infidelity and rejection. Dust fell on his head as he was mean and blind. His eyes were proved to be devilish and capable of seeing only dust. There is no end for this discussion, tell us about the story of the musician as we are anxious to hear and the musician also is disgusted of waiting for so long.

chapters.title: Unlearnt Lessons
chapters.subtitle: Left over story of the Old Musician and Passing on of the Message to him

paras: An announcement came to H. ‘Umar: “Meet the needs of a bondsman of Ours! There is a special and honourable servant of ours. Go towards the graveyard. Take seven hundred dinars from the treasury and go before our servant and tell him: ‘O great person: take this much for the present. This is a prize for your instrument playing. After this money is spent out, you may come here again”.

Hearing this announcement, H. ‘Umar was taken aback and got up and prepared himself to obey the command. He took the amount in a purse and went fast towards the graveyard. He roamed around the graveyard very much but found no one except that old man. He was not convinced of that old man being the required person and moved again and again and found no one else. He got tired. He thought: “God has said that the person is a special servant of His, clean, well cultured and prosperous. How can an old musician be so? What a great hidden affair is this?” He again went around the graveyard just as a lion moves around in the forest in search of prey. When he was convinced there was none other than this old man, he said to himself: “Many bright-hearted people live in darkness”.

He went near him and sat beside him with due respect. He had a sneeze and upon this sound, the old man woke up and sat. He looked at H. ‘Umar and got surprised, panicked and decided to go away. He spoke to himself: “O God! I have a grievance, that an investigating officer and controller of crimes has come to this musician”. When H. ‘Umar looked at his pale and worried face, he told him: “Do not fear. Do not think of running away from me, as I have brought a happy message from God. God has praised so much about your conduct, that ‘Umar has fallen in love of your face. Sit before me and do not go away, so that I may speak of the secret of your acceptability in your ear. God has offered his salutation to you and enquired about you and your innumerable sorrows and pains. This is a little reward for your musical talent. Spend this money for your good and come thereafter to this place”.

sections.heading: Repentance in extreme sorrow
paras: Upon hearing this the old man got terribly out of control. He bit his fingers and lost his balance. He cried out: “O unmatchable God! This old helpless man feels highly ashamed”. He cried very much and got uncontrollable pain. He dashed his Instrument on the ground and smashed it into pieces. And he said: “You only had kept me away from God, O instrument. You only were a dacoit on my way to my destination. You have drunk my blood for seventy years; and because of you, my face has turned black before the men of perfection. O my God! You are the only Graceful and Grantor. Have pity on this life which was spent in cruelty.

“The price of every day of life that God gives cannot be known to anyone in the world. I have wasted every moment of my life in the high pitch and low pitch of the musical instrument. In order to set the tunes and adjustment on the melody of pardah Iraq, I forgot the bitter time of death. With wetness of the zair-e-afgand-e-khurd of the lowly pitch, the farmland of my heart dried up and died. What a tragedy, the sounds of all the twenty-four tunes remained, but the caravan left, and days lost their times. O God! I seek your justice upon my grievances. I do not seek anything from anyone else in this matter as I have not done justice to myself in this world in these seventy years of life which I have wasted. I cannot seek any justice from anybody except from Him who is closer to me than myself; as stated in the Quran: Nahnu aqrabu ilaihi min habli al waridi: We are nearer to Him than his jugular vein. (Qaf: 50:16).

“This is because, my existence gets annihilated every moment and instantly gets replaced every moment by God. Though this is continuingly happening; one existence of mine is annihilated, yet I am looking at it as living. This is like a situation, when a person is counting coins to give you, you look at him only and not at yourself”.
As against this, a man counting his sins looks at himself and not others. In this manner he was loudly crying and talking and counting the sins he committed during his long period of life”.

chapters.title: Sinking in thoughts of God
chapters.subtitle: H. ‘Umar’s Bringing Him from a Situation of Sorrow towards a situation of sinking in Unity with God.

paras: H. Umar said to him: “These cries of yours are an indication of your wisdom and consciousness”. Then he took him away from the sorrowful mood and made him enter into the depths of God’s unity through the paths of his repentance and cries.

sections.heading: Thinking of Past and Future is also Shirk

Consciousness comes about by remembering the past, but both past and future of yours are a curtain between you and God. Set fire to both these. How long do you want to be with these two knots like the joints of the reed? Burn these joints of the reed to make it a companion of your lips and breaths, as flute. Till you burn the joints of the reed, you cannot make a flute. So also, if you keep engaged with the knots of your past and future, you cannot be free of yourself. When you circumambulate the Ka’aba while keeping your attention upon yourself, you circumambulate yourself and not the Ka’aba; and make yourself riverter from faith; because even upon entering into the house of God, you think of yourself and not of God. One who is engaged in one’s own thoughts remains unconcerned with the giver of thoughts, who is none but God. You are repenting upon your past commitments keeping yourself in view and not the accepter of repentance. In doing so, you have given importance to yourself and your sins, and kept yourself engaged with them. You have not kept God in view. Thus, you have participated yourself and your sins with God. By doing so, you have committed a greater sin of participation of others with God. Think over and realise about the fresh mistake and repent for the sin of earlier repentance. You were earlier engaged in the mistake of singing and instrument-playing; and now you engage yourself in crying and weeping.
paras: The path of the one who is annihilated in God is different. Consciousness of the self and its commitment is another sin for him. You have repented for your past commitments. Now, you may tell me as to when you will repent for your present commitment. Once you made your soft-low-tunes as your object or qibla or Ka’aba of your life and now you make your kisses on your cries, taking them as your qibla and object of life”.

sections.heading: Greed of new and newer informations
paras: H. Umar’s face was a mirror of the lights of God and reflections of the secrets. The soul of the old musician woke up and got a new life. The old man freed himself from the feelings of joys and sorrows and became pure like the soul. His earlier life passed off and was replaced with a new life. A strangeness took birth in his inside, which took him away from the earth and heavens. His curiosity and search were of such nature that cannot be explained. It was not professed and thought of, but of an absorbing nature.

That is: it was spontaneous. A curiosity which was devoid of words and state. He was sunk in the beauty of God, full of Majesty, Bounty and Honour (Zul Jalaali wa al ikraam). His sinking into the river of uniqueness of God was not such from which he could be relieved. No one could know it, except the river of godhood. Speaking with the part wisdom of man is not possible, about the wisdom in entirety (Aql-e- kull) of God, how much ever you may try. Efforts upon efforts have been put upon this. This much only could be said about God: as a wave of the river of wisdom in entirety, which came up to the place of putting the old man in amazement.

When the affairs of the old man reached this stage, the old man and his soul sank into the river. The old man stopped talking. Half of what he intended came out and the other half remained within his mouth. There is as stage to reach which is so comfort-giving and pleasing that anything and the life itself can be sacrificed a hundred thousand times. Pounce like a falcon to catch the prey in the bushes of the soul, become like a sun that continuingly spills its light and energy for the benefit of others. It sacrifices its life and energy every moment and becomes deficient; and every moment it is rewarded more and more light and energy from the hidden world. Similarly, life and soul flow into man like the water in the river which flows from one place to another, vacates that place which is instantly filled by fresh water. This is the situation with the Sufis with new and fresh inspirations in their human soul from the hidden world which tells them constantly to go out of the material world. The perfect guide is like the sun receiving benefits from the hidden world invisible to the physical eyes, and passing them on to this world. Therefore, become a spiritual sun and scatter benefits to all. Convert the old world into a new world.

chapters.title: Daily announcements by angels
chapters.subtitle: Exegesis of the Prayer of two Angels who announce Daily in the Bazaars: O God, give a good reward to the Expenders and Destruction to the misers. And to Explain that the Expender is a Mujahid on the Path of God and not in the meeting of Desires

paras: The Prophet has said: “In order to provide advice to the people, two angels announce: O God, do not give to the misers other than loss upon loss. O God, give a good reward to the expenders; and O God, destroy, the misers.”

sections.heading: Expending and Holding for God’s Sake
paras: Both expenders and misers who expend or do not expend, as per the demands of circumstances are good. Their acts are effective according to situations. On many occasions, not expending is better than expending. Provisions provided by God should not be spent other than upon the command of God, so that uncountable wealth may be available to you; so that, you may not be counted among the rejectors, as there were rejectors, who sacrificed camels so that their swords might dominate over the Prophet.

Provisions made by God must be expended as per commands. Every heart cannot understand the commands of God. Therefore, find them out from a person who knows. As it would result in the acts of a rebellious slave who spent the king’s money upon the rebels thinking strangely that, he was generous by proving profit to the people. He thinks that he is doing a just act, that he is spending the king’s money upon the poor people. This justice and generosity and granting will not increase before the king anything other than the king’s wrath for him and blackening of his face. There is a warning to the reckless in the Quran; as such, wasteful expenditure is a cause of dejection.

chapters.title: Sacrifice of Camels
chapters.subtitle: Arab Leaders sacrificed Camels expecting Acceptance

paras: Makkan leaders in their fight against the Prophet sacrificed camels in the hope of the acceptance of the sacrifice. This kind of thinking is very frightening. That is why the faithful say in their prayers to God: Show us the straight path: Ihdina Alsiraatal Mustaqiim (Fatiha: 1:6).

Expending money is worthy for a rich generous man; and sacrifice of the life is the generosity of those in love of God. If you give bread to others, bread will be provided to you; and if you give your life to God, you will be given an everlasting life. When the Chunnar Tree loses its leaves, God will provide fresh leaves. If you lose all your wealth through your generosity, God’s benevolence will not keep you empty handed. One who sows the seeds, loses a lot of grains in sowing, but he gets a very rewarding crop of grains. And the one who stocks the grains in a miserly way, may see accidents occur upon that lot, and rats also eat away. This world is a nullity; therefore, search for it in positivity. Your body is a zero: try to see the object not in the body, but in the meaning of life. Your life is saltish and bitter. Present it before a sword to be killed, and buy against it, a river of sweet water. If you cannot understand the meaning of this statement, hear this narrative from me.

chapters.title: Great Generosity of a ruler
chapters.subtitle: Narrative of the Calif who was far above Hatim Taayi in Generosity

paras: In earlier days there was a calif who was so generous in giving his wealth that Hatim Taayi (the legendary generous person, the match of him did not ever exist) stood before him as a beggar. He had raised his flag of generosity fluttering so high that poverty and need vanished from the world. Oceans and mines had become empty of the pearls and gems and also gold from this end of the Qaaf mountain to its other end. (Qaaf is a mountain supposed to surround the world in legends). In the world full of mud, clouds and water, he was known as the model of the generous God. There was great impact of his generosity in the oceans and mines and great caravans of men were moving towards his generosity. His windows and doors were the centres of the fulfilment of needs and he was known all over the world for generosity. People of the East, Romans, Turks and Arabs were all in surprise at his generosity. The water of his generosity flowed the river of the life-giving-water (Aabe-Haiwan), drinking upon which one was supposed to live for ever, as per legends). Both the Arabs and the Easterners had got into life due to him. To know as to what happened during the life time of the king of generosity, hear this story with pleasure.

chapters.title: Beduins Narrative in Extreme Poverty
chapters.subtitle: Story of the Beduin Darvish and the Quarrels of his wife

paras: One night, the wife of a beduin talked to her husband; and their discussion went beyond the limits. She said: “We are in poverty and undergo so many troubles when the entire world is in pleasures. We are the only suffering two. We do not have the bread and the curry, for our bread is nothing but pain and envy. We do not have a tumbler and the water in it is only our tears. Our clothing is nothing but sunshine during the day; and during the night, our bed and blanket are the moonlight. We consider the tablet of the moon as our bread and raise our hands towards the sky as if to seek this bread. Our deprivation is so much that it has become a shame for beggars and our days and nights are spent in the worries of livelihood. Our relatives and others run away from us just as the people used to run away from Samiri (the fellow who had taught Bani Isra’iil to worship the calf during the absence of H. Musa (Moses) upon which H. Musa cursed him that he should not touch anybody; and upon his being touched one would get feverish. People used to run away from him out of fear). If I ask for a handful of lentils from anyone, he tells me to keep quiet, eat your sorrows and die. The Arabs are proud and desirous of fighting and generosity, but we, inspite of being Arab are like the wrong word to be wiped off. Where is the battle? We are dead with hunger, or, we are dead in the worries caused by the sword of non-existence. What wrong have we done? Without any wrong from our side, we are burning in fire. There is no medicine of any kind for our sickness: we are being crushed under the feet of pain and sorrows. What can we give to others; we are ourselves ready to beg. We are trying to prick the housefly in the air to extract a little fat. We are such that not even a guest comes to us and if he comes. I shall be compelled to take away his blanket when he is in sleep”.

In this manner, she narrated about her troubles to her husband, which were highly exaggerated and further added: “We have become disgraced for our poverty and hardship. We are burnt out in anxiety and tensions. How long are we to live this disgraceful life? We are sunk in the depth of the ocean of fire. If a guest happens to come to us someday, all our shameful condition will become known to him. But we are sure, if a guest comes to us without knowing our plight, we shall sell his footwear and get something out of its price”.

chapters.title: Misguidance by Imposters
chapters.subtitle: Falling into deceit of the Disciples at the Hands of the Imposters Projecting themselves as great Teachers: and their not finding the Truthful from Frauds

paras: Very wise persons have said that one should be a guest of the graceful people. But you are a disciple and guest of a fellow who collects your earnings with his mean nature. He does not have anything that he can give you. He will not give you any light; rather he will darken you. When he does not have any light within himself, how can anybody get light from him? How can a man with watery eyes who cannot see things clearly, remove a hair fallen into another’s eyes?

sections.heading: Misguidance by False Teachers
paras: He collects treacherously from us when with poverty and hard work, our condition is such that no guest of ours can be deceived by us. If you have not seen a continuous famine for ten years, then you may open your eyes and look at us. Our appearance is like the inside of our enemy. Our false teacher has darkness in his heart, but his tongue is very fast and slippery. There is no fragrance of God in him and he cannot impress upon anybody, but his callings are greater than those of H. Adam, the father of all humans, and of his direct descendent son, H. Shaith(s), the prophet. He is so devilish that even the devil has hesitated to show his face to him. But he calls himself as greater than Abdal Sufis who do not have any vice in them. He has stolen some words of the great saintly men and speaks of them to make the people think that he is also something. In his talks, he comments upon H. Bayazid Bistami, a saint of very high status, but his inside is so vicious that even Yazid son of Muawiah, the killer of H. Hussain would feel ashamed. One who considers him as Bayazid will rise up on the day of resurrection along with Yazid. He is deprived of the bread and dishes of heavens; and God has not thrown even a bone before him. Not only in respect of material food, he is deprived of spiritual gifts from God. But he says:” I have spread the dinner sheet with dishes from God, I am a vicegerent and assistant of God. This is an open invitation for you, O fools! Come along and have the dinner of my delicious food. (Which in fact is nothing but the most unworthy.)”

For years together, on the promise of tomorrow people have been moving around the door, but that tomorrow is never to come. It requires a long time for the secret, deficiency and efficiency of a man to be revealed. Hidden under the walls of the body or within the heart of man, are treasures of the gnosis (knowledge) of God. But they are covered by anthills and snake pits. By the time, the disciple comes to know of the truth of that imposter, his entire life is spent out. What is the good of knowing the truth after that long a time?

chapters.title: Disciples of Imposters become Good
chapters.subtitle: It is very Rare That a Disciple of an imposter with his Sincere Belief would reach a state, which the imposter has not seen even in his Dream. Water and Fire would not harm the Disciple but Harm the Teacher. Yet strange things are certainly Rare

paras: But sometimes it happens that the disciple of an imposter with the sincerity of his craze for the light of knowledge, finds even the falsities given by the imposter as beneficial to him. Because of his sincerity of intentions, he reaches a high state, even though the one whom he had taken as a great soul (imposter) proved to be only a physical body. He happens to see some certain spiritual states at some time which his unworthy teacher has not seen in years. This is like a sincere man in the darkness of the night, does not clearly find the direction of qibla to perform his salat and resorts to a particular direction by guessing, which happens to be not the true qibla. Yet his salat becomes acceptable, though technically wrong.

Though the inside of the false claimant as teacher is facing a spiritual famine, but there is a famine of food only on our outside. Yet we try to hide our poverty from others just as the false claimant hides his inner conditions. We should not sacrifice our life for false honour, as some people boast of their discipleship of a false teacher by talking high of him.

chapters.title: Husband and Wife should go Together
chapters.subtitle: The Bedouin’s persuasion to his wife to maintain Patience, and the excellence of Patience

paras: The Bedouin told his wife:” How long do you keep yourself engaged in caring and reaping of crops. A larger part of our life has passed and a very little of it remains. Wise people do not keep their eyes on profits and losses, as both of these pass off like flowing water. Whether it is clean or polluted, water flows in the stream. Do not talk of that which does not remain and passes off. There are thousands of animals in the world, who are living in comfort without any thoughts of profit and loss. Dove is thankful to God, though she has not kept anything on the tree for the night. Bulbul is in praise of God saying: “You are the accepter of my praises. I entirely depend upon you for my food”. In this manner from the mosquito up to the elephant, all belong to the family of God and He is the best of the providers to the family.

sections.heading: Sorrows: Messengers of death
paras: “All these sorrows that are in our breasts are from the dust, wind and storms of our life. These uprooting sorrows are like sickles for our life. It happened like this, it happened like that, are our insinuations. Consider every sorrow as part of death. There is no escape from death and so also from this part. When you cannot run away from a part of death, think that its whole is certain to fall on you. If you consider the part of the whole as sweet, understand that God will make the whole also sweet. Pains come as the messengers of death. You should not be foolish to hide your face from the messenger. One who lives a comfortable life feels death to be bitter. How much ever one may protect one’s body from troubles, one cannot protect it from death. Sheep are caught from the forest and brought to the towns. Fattest is the first to be slaughtered.

sections.heading: One of a Pair makes the Other Useless
paras: “O my dear moonlike wife, the night passed off and morning arrived. How long do you like to repeat this narration? When you were young, you had greater patience. Now, you are in need of gold. Earlier, you were gold yourself. You were a grapevine full of grapes; and why have you gone dry now? You rotted at the time when the fruits are about to ripen. Your fruit should have been sweeter now, and not like the rope that is being untwined and losing all it’s worth and strength. We are a couple; you are my counterpart, and the counterparts must be similar, so that they may perform the jobs together. Look at the counterparts of the shoes and sandals. If one of them is small in size gripping one foot, both of them become useless. You do not see the lion and the wolf as a couple. Pair of bags on either side of the back of a camel cannot remain, if one is full of materials and the other is not. With full courage I am going towards contentment, but you go toward a bad end”.
The contented man with sincerity and good heart spoke to his wife thus for the whole night.

chapters.title: Do not Speak of What you do not Do
chapters.subtitle: The wife’s Advice to Husband not to go Beyond limits in Talking, as God has said: Why do you say that which you do not do: Lima taquuluna maalataf ‘luun (Saff:61:2). Though what you say is right, but you do not have that state of reliance upon God. Saying this is above your Sate; and your affairs put you in loss, and come under: wa kabura maqtan indallahi an taquulau maalaa taf ‘aluna: it is most hateful in the sight of Allah that you say that you do not do (Saff:61:3)

paras: The wife shouted at him: “O lover of honour! I shall not come into the grip of your cheating anymore. Do not bring forth your blabberings of invitations to great claims! Stop these words of arrogance and false pride. How long do you talk of the greatness of life? Look at your own condition and state and be ashamed.
