You may know your friends will dig a grave for you and take you fast and dump you in it. And when your friends put you there, they will make you the food of ants and snakes. Your friend who has been often ransoming his life for your sake will close his nose to protect himself from your foul smell. Your speaking, seeing, hearing are all the impacts of the soul; just as the boiling of water in the vessel is due to the impact of fire. Just as there is an impact of the soul on the body, the impact of the abdals is on the soul. When the life of this soul takes its steps backwards from its soul, you may know that soul also becomes lifeless like the body. That is to say: the soul also has an impact of another soul.

sections.heading: “It is for this reason that I keep my face upon the earth so that it may be a witness for my acts on the doomsday. On the doomsday, when the earth is shaken to her utmost convulsion: iza zulzilatil ardhu zilzaalaha: (Zilzal:99:1). She will be a witness to my acts, as she will openly speak out of her news; and the earth along will all the thorns and twigs upon it will say: On that day she will declare her tidings: yawmaizin tuhaddith(s)u akhbaraha. (zilzal: 99:4).”
Special Senses of the prophets
paras: The philosopher speaks out of inferior reasonings. His wisdom remains out of the door, by remaining always in thinking and speculations. Tell him to go out and smash his head. Speaking of water, mud and slush is the sensation of the people with sensibilities. The philosopher who rejects the cries of the log of wood (Hannana), standing upon which the Prophet recited sermons, is uninformed of the senses of the prophets. He says that all these are the effects of psychic conditions of men, which create many untenable thoughts in men. It is rather the reflections of his rejections and mischiefs of mind that impose such ideas in his mind. He also rejects the existence of Satan, but in reality, he is obedient to Satan who is invisible. If he has not seen the Satan, he can look at himself. Madness is also not visible to the eye like the Satan, but there are indications from which madness can be found out. (All his opinions are also products of his mental conditions). “A philosopher” does not mean that he alone is one among a group called philosophers. Anyone having deficient knowledge and suspicions is a hidden philosopher.

sections.heading: Even Faithful’s suspect At Times
paras: Sometimes, the faithfuls also express such deficient knowledge in faith, and that makes them black-faced. Be careful, O faithfuls! Those unfounded thoughts are there in your minds too. There is no limit to such thoughts. All the seventy-two schisms are hidden in you also; and they will come out of you at times. One who has a strong tree of faith in his heart must not allow such leaves of suspicions to come about. You laugh at the devils and Iblis, only because you consider yourself to be pious. When the feelings of suspicions in you come out, some faithful people will protect you against them. Every seller of Gold is very happy in his shop as the touchstone to test its purity has been lost.

sections.heading: Time is the exposer of Truth
paras: O God! The Hider of our defects, do not lift the curtain from us and be a protector for us in this trial. Counterfeit gold competes with pure gold in the darkness of night, but pure gold waits for sunrise so that the true and false may be tested. Pure gold tells with the tongue of its purity to the counterfeit gold to wait till the morning. For hundreds of thousands of years, the accursed Iblis was leader of the abdals and the faithfuls before getting the curse. But because of his arrogance he came in the open to contest against Adam and got disgraced and polluted in such a way as dung becomes fouler and filthier in the heat of the afternoon sun. Therefore, O lustful fellow, do not contest against the men of God. Know that the horse cannot run ahead of the king.

chapters.title: Evil Doers to be Punished
chapters.subtitle: Supplication of Bal‘am Bevoor to cause Retreat of H. Musa and his Followers from the City surrounded by them, and its Acceptance by God

paras: [Bal‘am Bevoor was a pious man from Kannan or Jabbarin. He prayed to God at the request of the people for the retreat of H. Musa and his followers who had surrounded the city, which was accepted. Because of this he lost his faith, but nothing happened to H. Musa. Then he introduced the mischief of fornication among the people causing plague in the community which killed thousands of people – Qazi Sajjad Hussain]

People fell in love with Bal’am Bevoor just as with Jesus Christ during his days. They never obeyed anyone else other than him. His breaths rendered the sick healthy. As a result of his high-level attainments, he became so arrogant as to fight with H. Musa; and what happened to him for this is known to you; that his tongue hanged out of his mouth as of the dog.

sections.heading: Punishment of Evil doers as Warnings for Others
paras: Hundreds of thousands of people have been in the world like him and Iblis, who are well known and unknown. But God has made these two well known, so that these two may be witness upon other people. Just as: robbers are killed in the forests, but the dead bodies of one or two are dragged into the nearby villages, so that the people may look at them and learn lessons from their fate. People look at their acts as preventive measures for them.

God has hanged these two criminals on high scaffolds, even though there are a large number of such criminals in the world. These two are taken as flag poles in the city, even though those killed with the wrath of God are beyond counting. You are also very weak before God and therefore remain within limits. For God’s sake, do not take your steps beyond limits. And if you attack those weaker than you, God will push you into the depths of the seventh earth. What for do you think, the narration of the people of ‘Aad and Th(s)amud has been made in the Quran? This is to make you know that the prophets are reliant upon God. The events of splitting of earth as in the case of Qarun, pelting of rocks on the people of Luut, and of thunder on the Th(s)amud, are for the honour of the speaking souls of the prophets.

sections.heading: Animals are Ransom for Man
paras: All animals can be killed for the sake of man. Similarly, all rebellious men can be killed for the sake of the well-informed ones like the prophets. What do you think of the meaning of the “informed ones”? What is full information? It is total wisdom. Partial wisdom can also be considered as information, but it is defective. All the wild animals that are away from man are lesser in status than the tamed domestic animals. These domestic animals can be sacrificed for the sake of man because, as against man, they are also wild, and man possesses majestic wisdom. They can be sacrificed as they have no relationship with man. Wild animals lose their grade as they are opposed to man. How can you foolish be of any honour, when you are like an ass: as you are like affrighted asses: ka annahum humrun mustan firantun (Muddathth(s)ir: 74:50).

A donkey being a domestic animal is not sacrificed because of its usefulness, but a wild donkey is permitted to be sacrificed. The donkey does not have the sense of discrimination to differentiate between good and bad, yet God has kindness for it. It is the wildness of the animal that entitles its killing. Thus, when men become like wild animals with no regard for the words of the prophets, they cease to be those of wisdom and higher grade. Inevitability they become entitled to be killed, as wild animals with arrows and spears. They have no wisdom and consequently they lack honour and higher grade. Their wives and children also become like them with no wisdom, honour and high grade. And, that wisdom of man that runs away from the total wisdom of the prophets gets degraded and becomes like the wild animals. Hear a story in this connection with due care and attention.

chapters.title: Motions of Winds, Water and Other States
chapters.subtitle: Confidence of Harut and Marut upon their Fidelity. Their Seeking of leadership and Falling into Trial

paras: The well known Harut and Marut, because of their arrogance were hit by poisoned arrows. They had too much of confidence upon their piety forgetting that a buffalo cannot remain contented with the lion. So also man, with the decisions of God. The buffalo may make a hundred means to protect itself from the lion, but the lion will tear off its every part into pieces. It may, like the porcupine have hundreds of quills strong like the horns, yet, the lion will tear it off.

sections.heading: Causes and Effects of Events
paras: Strong wind uproots many large trees, but it shows pity to the small thin grass. The weak grass remains protected from the strong wind. Therefore, do not be haughty on your strength. The axe is not afraid of the thickness of the branches of the trees. It cuts them to pieces. But it has pity for the leaves, and does not strike them. It uses its sharp blade only on thick wood. Fire is not afraid of the huge quantity of wood. So also, the butcher is not afraid of the flocks of sheep. It is the meanings and inner designs that create the images and models. They have no care for the models. They can create any model that they choose. The sky is concave and bent within itself to keep the products of its designs within its fold. Consider the pully that is fixed upon the well and its circular motion. It is a product of human wisdom. The movement of the human body from low to high, and high to low levels is also like a circular motion, which is due to soul hidden within it. The movements of the winds are due to the impacts of hidden meanings (commands) of God, like the pully that moves in a circular fashion due to the falling of water from the streams. Up and down motions of the breaths, their entering into and going out of the body (respiration) are all products of the soul greedy of living within the body. The same soul converts the air into different letters and their combinations as words making the causes of peace sometimes, and of fights at other times. It takes the body sometimes on the right and at other times on the left making it sometimes pleasant gardens and sometimes as thorny bushes.

sections.heading: Same things Becomes Good or Bad
paras: In similar manner, God made water as a frightening means of death upon Pharaoh. He converted the winds into a fierce python upon the people of ‘Aad. Later the same wind was made peaceful, concerned and soft for the faithfuls. Shaikh of the faith, Muhyiuddin Ibnal Arabi has explained the meaning of “huwallaah” (He is God). Meanings or the interior of the words are as much as God. And Rabbul Alaamiin (Lord of the worlds) is an ocean of meanings. All the spheres and plates of the earth and the heavens one above the other are like scraps floating on this ocean. The movements and dances of the scrap on water are caused by the waves, tides and disturbances of water. When He decides to provide rest to the scrap, He causes it to be thrown on the coast. And again, He brings it from the coastline towards the waves, which do with the scraps what fire does with the grass; that is, the tides again throw it up and bring it down and make it dance, just as the flames of fire dance from low level to high level. There is no end to this discussion; and let us go towards the narrative of Harut and Marut.

chapters.title: God Protects from Sins
chapters.subtitle: Leftover Story of Harut and Marut and their Punishment and torture

paras: Whenever they looked at the sins and vicious acts of the people, they used to get angry with them and bite their fingers at that. But they would not see their own defects.

sections.heading: Looking at the Faults of Others
paras: An ugly person looked at himself in the mirror, he turned aside the mirror in anger at that. But a proud man considering himself to be sinless, looks at others as committing sins. The fire of hell penetrates into him. He considers his own pride as a protection of faith and religion without looking at his own self, faith- lacking self. Signs of the protection of faith are entirely different which cause greenery and freshness to the world.

sections.heading: Self-Introspection
paras: God told Harut and Marut not to look at the sinful with contempt considering yourself to be made of clean light. “Be thankful, O soldiers and servants, if you are saved from the sins of lust and animal passions. If I place before you the meanings of lust, you will be found to be so much involved in its types and varieties, that you will feel so ashamed as to be not worthy of remaining under the sky. If you have any fidelity in your mind and body, it is due to My protection and the reflection of fidelity itself. Consider this fidelity to be entirely as one granted by Me and be thankful to Me so that the devil may not dominate upon you”.

The matter of fidelity has very intricate, subtle penetration into your body and mind, as susceptible to the devil’s misguidance as had happened in the case of the writer of revelation of the Prophet, that he considered the light of wisdom and its interpretations as his own, instead of as a spill over of the Prophet’s. He considered himself as among the voices of the holy birds of God, even though it was like an echo.

You may speak the language of the birds. It is only a mimicry. It does not mean what the birds really mean by those sounds. You can never know of the bird’s intentions. You may mimic the bulbul, but you cannot know what she tells the flower. You may speculate and assess the meaning of those sounds. There is every possibility that what you assess is the opposite of what the birds mean. This will be merely speculation as that of a deaf person who assesses the mind of the speaker on the basis of the movements of the lips.

chapters.title: Words Opposite to Intentions—Deaf man’s case
chapters.subtitle: A Deaf Man’s visit to a Sick Neighbour and Displeasing him

paras: A respectable person told a deaf person that his neighbour was sick. The deaf man thought: what I can hear from him with my deaf ears; and particularly when he is sick and with frail voice. But I must go. There is no escape from it. I can look at him to understand him through the movements of his lips. I can properly guess. If I ask him: “how do you feel my friend in your sickness”; he will say “I am quite well or I am happy”. Then I will say: “Thank God”; and then ask him as to what food he took. He will say: “Soup of black gram”: Then I shall tell him: “Very good. It is a very good food”. Then I shall ask him: “Who is your physician;” and he will tell someone’s name”; and then I shall tell him: “Very good”. He has healthy, prosperous hands. When he is treating you, you will be alright soon. I have made enquiries about him. He meets all the needs of those to whom he goes”.

He set right these speculated answers and went to the sick person. The sick man was not happy at the deaf man’s visit. But could not express it. The deaf man sat near the sick man and spread his hand on his head with affection. He asked him: “How are you”? With disgustion, he said: “I am as though dead”. The deaf said: “Thank God”.

sections.heading: Displeasing Mistaken Notions
paras: The sick man felt very upset and displeased thinking as to what was there to be thankful. He is as though my enemy”. What the deaf man had guessed went wrong. Then the deaf asked him: “What food did you eat. The sick man out of disgustion said: “Poison”. He said: “Very good. It is a very helpful diet”. The sick man got all the more angry. Then he asked him: “Who among the physicians is attending for your treatment?” The sick man replied: Izrail! (the angel of death). You may go away from here! The deaf man said: “His steps are very prosperous. Be happy. I came to you after a visit to him and asked him to take care of you”.
The deaf man returned from the sick man happily saying to himself: “I thank God. I have attended to my moral duty”.

Because of his deafness, what all he guessed was opposite of what the sick man thought and spoke. This had caused great loss to him, but he thought it was highly profitable. With the blindness of his heart, the deaf was thinking within his heart that he has performed the moral duty of visiting a sick neighbour, thanking God for that. But the sick man thought otherwise that he was an enemy of his life: “I had never thought that he is a mine of cruelties. He was thinking of many bad things for him and sending the message of his sorrows.

When a man drinks a bad soup, he feels nauseating and thinks of vomiting it. But in respect of anger, there is no spitting out, but swallowing it, and speaking good in return. But the sick man had no patience and was feeling very upset: as to where was that accursed dog, a blabberer of nonsense might be, so that I might pounce upon him. I kept quiet then because the lion in me was sleeping. Visiting a sick man is for his consolation. But this fellow has shown utmost enmity.

sections.heading: Good Acts, only to show
paras: He desired to see his enemy in wretched conditions to get peace for himself. Many people perform prayers to please God, expecting rewards from Him. But their prayer is not for God. It has the hidden sin of seeking self-gratification and reward. There are many pools of dirty water, but you consider them as clean, like that deaf person who was sure that he was doing good for the neighbour, which, in fact, was bad. He was very pleased and sat down happily that he has fulfilled the duty of a neighbour. But, in fact, he had set himself on fire and also the sick neighbour. Protect yourself from the fire that you enflame and in this way add to your sinfulness: fear the fire whose fuel is men and stones: Fattaqu alnara allat’i wa quduhannasu wal hijaratu  (Baqara: 2:24)

The Prophet told an ostentatious, showy person: “O young man! Reperform your salat, as you have not done it properly”. It is out of the fear of such risks, we are asked to say: Ihdina (guide us) in every salat. That is to say: “O God, do not mingle this prayer with that of the unguided and ostentatious.”

For the wrong that was done by that deaf, a friendship of ten years was lost. People think they are doing acts of worship, being ignorant of the fact that they are putting themselves in loss due to sinfulness. Therefore, go and stop guessing as your guesses will make your wounds old and incurable. In particular, those guesses that are based upon your external senses, which you are liable to be guessed as revelations, as revelation is something that is faraway from your capacities. Even if you feel that your ear is capable of all sounds, know this; that the ear to hear the spiritual sounds is deaf.

chapters.title: Improper Speculations due to Arrogance
chapters.subtitle: To Explain: The First-Ever who Speculated against the clear Commands was Iblis

paras: The first-ever who made a senseless speculation against the light of God was Satan. He Said: “Certainly fire is better than clay. I am made of fire and Adam of dark clay. We speculate about the part on the basis of the whole. He is made of darkness and I of bright light”. God said “No. It has already been decided by Me that spiritual light is not on the basis of birth, but on piety, non-inclination towards worldly gains and excellence of conduct.”

This is not an inheritance of this material world that you can claim from parents. It is a spiritual attainment. Rather, it is an inheritance from the prophets; and the inheritors are the spiritually pious.

sections.heading: Clear Commands Need No Speculations
paras: Abu Jehl’s son Ikrama became a Muslim [and rendered great service to Islam and ultimately got martyred in the battle of Yarmuk]. And Noah’s son is among the misguided. Adam (created out of clay) became bright like the moon, but you inspite of being a creature of fire became dark-faced. These speculations are like the permitted alternative directions during the darkness due to cloudy weather or at night, when the direction of Ka’aba cannot be seen to face toward it for performance of salat. But during the day and in front of Ka’aba they are not permissible. Do not pose yourself as one who has not seen the Ka’aba. Do not turn your face from it and know that Allah knows best.

When you hear the announcement form the prophets, the birds of truth, you take them for their apparent meanings and learn them by heart, and then engage yourself in speculations and take them as truths. Abdals have their own jargons, the meanings of which cannot be understood by those who go after words.

You have learnt the language of the birds and made hundreds of speculations and developed desires on their basis like that sick person who was heart-broken by hearing from the deaf certain things, which he did not mean. So also, the deaf spoke of something which he did not mean, but of which he was proud and satisfied. The writer of revelations (Abdullah bin Sa’ad bin Abi Sarah) heard the voice of the holy Quran from the holy messenger and speculated that the voice was also for him. The holy bird struck its feather on him and made him blind; and sent him down to death in the pit of torture. Be careful! You should also not become a victim of the reflection of knowledge and speculations and fall down from higher heavenly state. You may be as learned and pious as Harut and Marut and even above them at the terrace of heavens, as the angels said: and we are verily ranged in ranks (for service): wa inna lanahnu alsaaffuuna: (Saffat: 37:165)

sections.heading: Insinuations: Products of Arrogance
paras: Do not arrogate greatness to yourself. Have pity on the vicious acts of the vicious and do not be egotistic. Take care: God’s watchful discontent may not come out of its zone and push you upside down in the deep pit of the earth. Both Harut and Marut said: “O God, all commands are from You. Where is any security other that through You?” They were telling this, but their hearts were highly disturbed and they asked: “How could any vice come about from us we being Your best of the bondsmen; how excellent is our service: ni’mal ‘abdu(Sad:38:30). Inspite of the excellence in service of these two angels, insinuation caught them, but only after they sowed the seed of arrogance within themselves. They used to say: “O those, made up of the four fundamental elements: earth, water, air and fire, you are not aware of the holy spiritual creatures. We were erecting the tents of worship on the heavens; we shall come down on the earth and beat the drums of our achievements”.

Both of them used to say: we are not worried about worldly material things as we are not made of them. We shall do justice and perform worship during the day; and at night, and fly away toward the heavens. So much so, we shall be the wonders of the times as we establish peace on earth and in heavens”.
Speculating about affairs of the heavens (and of the saints) on the basis of the conditions of the earth will not be alright. There is a great difference between them.

chapters.title: Hide the State of Intoxication
chapters.subtitle: To explain that One’s state and intoxication should be Kept Hidden

paras: Hear the words of the Hakim Sanai, philosopher of secrets: “Keep your head in that place only where you drank the wine of godliness. Once intoxicated, when you got away from the wine-house you became a funny toy for children. He fell down in slush here and there. On every path he passed through, every fool laughed at him. He is in this condition, and children are after him, being unaware of the taste of his wine and intoxication”.

sections.heading: Men with Immature wisdom are like Children
paras: Excepting those who are intoxicated with godliness, all other men are like children; and there is no matured person other than the one who has controlled his sensual desires. God has said: what is the life of this world but amusement and play: wa ma hazihil hayatudduniya illa lahuwan wa la’ib (‘Ankabut: 29:64). And you are children. This is correctly said by God. You have not got out of play and amusement; and as such you are a child. You cannot become clean without the cleansing of the soul. Consider your lust as a copulation of the children, (which is only imitative and gives no pleasure) which is like a game for you. What can a child’s copulation be other than play in comparison with that of a strong well-built soldier. The fights of the people are like the fights of children without any pith and substance, and are worthless. Their fight is with wooden swords; their intentions and objects are not suitable for the object of victory and real fight. Children keep bamboo sticks between then legs and run with them calling them as Burraq sitting upon which the Prophet ascended to heavens or as duldul, the mule that was presented to the Prophet by the ruler of Alexandria. They carry these sticks and think in their ignorance as their horses and run on the way. You should wait until the day when those carried by truth run their horses and pass along the nine heavens; making the angels and souls go up swinging.

The children also hold the lapels of their shirts and consider them as the reins of horses and run, as though riding on horses. God has said: conjecture avails nothing against truth: Inna alazhanna la yughni minal haqqi shai’an: (Najm: 53:28). The conjectural horse cannot be made to run on the heavens. Therefore, rejection of the truths of the hidden world merely on conjectures is not right. When there are two speculations, the dominant speculation can be preferred, but in the presence of the bright sun, there is no need for speculation. The sun’s brightness is the proof of its presence and there is no need to dispute on this. When the sun of truths comes upon your head, it shines equally bright on the guided and the unguided on the doomsday. Then, they will see their vehicles clearly that they are made up of their own legs as horses. Your suspicious sensations, thoughts and speculations may all be considered as the bamboo sticks of the children.

sections.heading: Knowledge for Knowledge’s sake and for Worldly Gains
paras: Sciences of the men of hearts are their carriers; and sciences of the physical world are carriers of the worldly men. When knowledge strikes the heart, it is a friend; but when it strikes the body, it is a burden. God has said their case is: that of a donkey which carries books (but understands them not): Kamath(s)alil himaari yahmilu asfaaran: (Jum‘a :62:5). They carry this burden, as the knowledge which is not from God is a burden. The light of knowledge that does not come on its own without any teaching from others after much has been already learnt with efforts is not lasting. It is like the make-up of colours put on the bride by the make-up woman. This worldly knowledge obtained by efforts is not useless if it is in search of God’s truth. The burden of its acquision will be reduced and you will be rewarded by spontaneous knowledge from God. Therefore, be careful to carry this burden for God’s sake and reap the lots of knowledge within yourself. Do not acquire this for the sake of your worldly gain (status, pride, superiority, money, honour, etc), so that you may ride upon the horse of knowledge. When you come riding upon this horse of knowledge, its burden will be reduced from your shoulders.

You cannot get rid of your desires without falling in love with God. But it should not be limited to the love of His names, but it should go up to His essence. His names and attributes bring about only thoughts, but they are the means of meeting Him, and not the ends in themselves. They are only the paths towards destination. People think that there are misguiding ghosts on the roads. This may be true. But this certainly speaks of the existence of roads, and there cannot be false guides if there are no roads. Similarly, there cannot be any object or thing without a name or sound even if it is only in the mind. If you pick up flowers and be pleased with them, it is because they have a name — ‘Flower’ made up of several letters. When you have come to know of the name, you have now to search for the thing with that name. Consider the moon to be the one that is shining on your head and not the reflection that you see in water.

sections.heading: Polish Heart to See God’s Essence
paras: If you want to go beyond the name and the letters that make it, you have to go beyond yourself and remove all your connections with worldly matters. You can reach the essence of God through His names, only through this method. A mirror is made to reflect by polishing the flat surface of dark iron. That is: the darkness of iron is removed by polishing it. Iron gets rid of its darkness. You will also have to get rid of your darkness like iron through the polishing of yourself by means of constant worship and patient meditation. Keep yourself cleansed of all your physical qualities and attributes and look into your essence so that you may see the essence of God beyond attributes. If you clean yourself of your attributes, you will see the knowledge of prophets which they got without reading books and being taught by teachers.

sections.heading: The Prophets —Seen through Love
paras: The noble Prophet has said that there is one among my followers, who will participate in my qualities and capacities. (According to another report, he will receive inspiration from God). His soul will be with that light with which I see him. He will see me without the Ahadith(s) mentioned in the true collections of Ahadith(s) (like Bukhari and Muslim) and other narratives about me. Rather, he will drink life-giving-water along with me through his love for me. Know the secret of the statement: “I was a Kurd in the evening and by the following morning I was an Arab,” as stated by H Abul Wafa, who was a Kurd and unaware of the Arabic language. But during the night he became aware of Arabic sciences; and in the morning, he gave the sermons very fluently in Arabic language. If you understand the secret of this statement: “our evening and morning”, it also will take you toward the path of God. If you want to know by an example of the “Knowledge from God’s own Self”, know the story of the Roman and Chinese painters.

chapters.title: Wisdom Superior to Craftsmanship
chapters.subtitle: Narrative of the Competition Between the Roman and Chinese Painters in the matter of Painting and Sculpturing

paras: The Chinese said: We are great painters and the Romans said: We are grand and great. The king said: I shall conduct a test to find out as to who has a better claim.

When the Chinese and the Romans came in his presence, he found the Romans as greater experts in sciences. The Chinese said: ‘We shall show our practical abilities’. The Romans said: ‘We shall show our wisdom and knowledge’. The Chinese said: ‘You may take one house for you. And the other will be taken by us.’

The two houses were opposite to each other. Each of them was taken by them. The Chinese demanded a hundred types of paints, and the prosperous king issued orders to meet their demands. Every morning the paints demanded by them and even more in quantity of their demand were given to them. The Romans did not ask for any paint. They did not use paints or brushes excepting things for cleaning and polishing. They closed the doors and went on polishing and the walls and doors became clean and clear like the sky.

sections.heading: Cleansed Heart Reflects all Colours
paras: There is a single way in colourlessness as against two hundred colours. Colour is like the cloud and colourlessness is like the moon. Whatever brightness and light you see in the cloud is due to the stars, moon and sun.

The Chinese finished their work. They beat the drums of joy. The king came and saw the paintings, which were putting wisdom and intelligence in amazement. Then he came toward the Romans and they lifted the curtains up. Reflections of all their paintings and colours fell on polished and cleansed walls. What all the king saw here was better than what he saw there, and the sceneries were brightly shining with grace.

sections.heading: Knowledge Direct from God, and Man’s Wisdom
paras: My dear sir! The Romans were like sufi’s who, without arguments, books and artistry dominate the scene. They (sufi’s) have cleansed and polished their hearts, and removed all feelings of greed, excessiveness, miserliness and meanness. The cleanliness of their hearts is like the clean polished mirror, which is capable of accepting innumerable images within itself. The face without a form, defects and bounds, had shone from His lapel upon the mirror of the heart of H. Musa. Because, this was the face that cannot be confined within the sky, roof’s floors, oceans and fishes, which are limited in size, countable and measurable. But think that there are no limits of any kind for the mirror of the heart. Pure wisdom either remains silent or misguides for the reason that perfect wisdom is with connections with the heart or rather heart itself. This is because, the knowledge directly coming from God (ladunni) can remain in the heart alone, but can be expressed to some extent through wisdom. What H. Musa had received was this direct knowledge from God Himself, which he expressed through various arguments and demonstrations. The arguments, that Pharaoh and his nobles had never heard of. The demonstration of the miracle of his staff turning into a python and swallowing the ropes and sticks presented by the magicians upon whose skill Pharaoh relied, had closed all chapters of arguments. What he said and did appeared as products of worldly knowledge, but were in fact, from the knowledge of ‘God’s own presence’ (ilmi ladunni). This knowledge (of the heart) appears to be mingled with the other great quality of man— wisdom, which remains flabbergasted and silent; or otherwise, it tries to maintain itself by rejecting the knowledge of the heart. This rejection is a case of its misguidance.

sections.heading: Heart: Receiver of all Reflections
paras: The reflection of every object falls upon the heart alone, whether it is tangible or intangible, countable or otherwise. Every new object that falls upon the heart remains upon it for ever and becomes visible to it, within itself, without any obstructions. Those who have cleansed the heart are not dependent upon colours and fragrances (visible or invisible, material or immaterial etc). They see the qualities of substances (material or otherwise) instantly, without obstacles and confusions. They ignore the visible marks and external aspects and raise the flag of the total and absolute confidence of matters. [Confidence is of three types. 1. Ilmal yaqin: knowing of a thing’s truth and qualities without actually seeing it but on the basis of information gathered through knowledge like believing that poison causes death without someone actually dying or seeing someone dying. 2. ‘Ainal yaqin: A knowledge improved upon the former by seeing someone actually dying. 3. Haqq al yaqin: Confidence going to such an extent as if he has entered into the matter himself and actually experienced himself and completely getting absorbed in it like a man taking poison and experienceing the pangs of death —Qazi Sajjad Husain]

sections.heading: They Directly Observe God
paras: They have developed the taste, thinking and illumination of the heart as if they have swum into the ocean and gone beyond it. They laugh at and make fun of death of which all others are frightened. Nobody can have control upon their hearts just as any injury can be caused to the oyster only and not to the pearl within. They have never bothered about grammar in talks and rejected the law and jurisprudence but have become carriers of discordance of everything and possessors of nothingness. Eversince the marks of eight paradises reflected, the tablets of their hearts have received their impressions. [Eight paradises are: Jannatil Khuld, Darus Salaam, Darul Qarar, Jannatul ‘Adinin, Jannatul Mawa, Jannattan Na‘iim, Illiyin and Firdos – Lughat-e-Kishwari] They are far above the ‘Arsh (the highest, farthest place one can imagine), the throne and space and holders of the assembly of truth in the presence of the Sovereign Omnipotent: Fi maq’adi sidqin inda Maliikin Muqtadir: (Qamar :54:55). They are annihilated in entirety but left hundreds of marks to see. What to speak of marks? They are the exact observers of God.

chapters.title: Future course decided within Foetus
chapters.subtitle: Prophet Muhammad’s asking H. Zaid: ‘How are you today? How have you arrived at the morning and got up from the bed?’ And his Telling: ‘O Prophet of God: I got up as a Mumin’

paras: [Many details are not available about Zaid b. Harith(s)a except that he is called as Zaidul khair. This talk between him and the Prophet is referred to by H. Awf b. Malik —Qazi Sajjad Hussain]

The noble Prophet asked H. Zaid: “In what condition were you this morning”, and he said: “I was a mumin bondsman of God”. Then the Prophet again asked him: “If the garden of faith has opened, tell me about its marks”? He said: “I was thirsty during the day due to fasting and I did not sleep in the night because of the burning love in my heart for God. In this manner I passed my days and nights just as the point of the spear passes through the shields. But my connections were not with time and time-related things, but with God, who is not bound by time. In His presence, all communities are one. Hundreds of thousands of years and one hour are the same for Him. Both the beginning and the end are one in that place. Because of getting lost in it, there was no role for wisdom to play”.

sections.heading: Souls Distinguished in the Foetus
paras: The Prophet asked him: “Where is the gift that you brought from that place. Place it before the people of the countries of the world according to the understanding capacity and wisdom of those people”.

H. Zaid said: “When the people are looking at the sky, I look at the Arsh and those living in it. Eight paradises and seven hells are clearly visible before me, just like the idols are before the idol worshipper. I can understand the people by separating them from each other just as I see wheat and millet distinctly in the grinding mill. I can understand who a man of paradise is and who is otherwise. They are distinct before me just as the fishes and snakes are”.

Here itself, people become distinctly bright as stated: On the day when some faces will be (lit up with) white, and some faces will be (in the gloom) of black: yawma tabyaddu wujuhun and taswaddu wujuhun: (Imran: 3: 106). Well before the doomsday itself, the souls were filled up with defects, just like the babies in the foetus of mothers, but hidden from the people. What H. Zaid saw was not in his case alone. Other friends of God also see similarly as to who is good and who is bad. The wretched are wretched, from the foetus of the mother itself and their marks indicate their conditions. Bodies are pregnant with the souls just like women with the babies; and everyone’s death is painful like the labour pain and the disturbances of the body are like the shattering of the earthquakes. Souls of the earlier times wait upon to see how a self-loving baby is to take birth.

sections.heading: Affinity on the Basis of Colour
paras: The blacks say to themselves that the child is one among them and the whites say that he is white like them, according to the colour of the child. But the soul upon coming into the world has no distinction between the black and the white. The blacks take with them a black child and the whites take the white child. So long as the child is not born, there are great difficulties for the worldly people. Very few are capable of understanding a not-yet-born-child. But the one who sees things with the light of God finds out his way to the pulp through the rind.

The basic colour of the semen of all is white and pleasing, but the reflection of the soul (genes) causes the black and white colour. It gives colour to the one created in the best of the moulds; and some of them to the lowest of the low as stated in the Quran: We have indeed created man in the best of the mould. Then do We abase to be the lowest of the low: laqad khalqna al insaana fi ahsani taqwiiim. Th(s)umma radadnahu asfala saafiliina (Tiiin: 95:4-5). The day on which the faces go black and white, white Turks and black Hindus will become well-known. It will be clear whether you are a mountain or a scrap of grass, or black or white for all those assembled there to see”. In the mother’s foetus, Hindu and Turk are not clear, but upon birth all big and small can be seen. There is no end to this talk. Let us stop it and move forward so that we may not be at the end of the caravan.

chapters.title: God’s well-established Decisions
chapters.subtitle: H. Zaid b. Harith(s)a’s, Answers to the Prophet that the states of the people are not hidden and unknown to Me

paras: Then, H. Zaid continued: “I look at all the people very clearly, whether they are men or women. Please tell me whether I should tell all that I have seen, or I should not”. The Prophet kept his finger on his lips to say: “enough, no more”. Then he said: “O Prophet of God! If I speak of the happenings of the doomsday, I can bring up a turmoil of its happenings in this world on this day itself. Please permit me to tear up the curtains so that my worth may shine like the sun. So that, a solar eclipse may also occur because of me; so that, I may show what a fruit-bearing date palm is and what a fruitless rattan is. I may show the doomsday in all clarity and exhibit the pure and the impure.

sections.heading: “I can show the people on the left side with their hands cut off, and also show the black and red colours. So that I may show what those seven sins are, which result in hypocrisy, in the light of the uneclipsed and unwaning moon. So that, I may show the dress of the sinful made of jute, and beat the drum of the victory of the prophets. So that, I may put into the sight of the infidels, as to what are hell, heaven and the barrier between them. So that, I may show the fountain of Kauth(s)ar in full activity, which may sprinkle its water on their faces and put its sounds into their ears. So that, I may show each one of the infidels with his identity, who is running around it individually and with others, all of them, in extreme thirst around it. They are so close to me as to rub their shoulders with mine and their shouts are entering into my ears.

“Right in front of me, there are the men of paradise who are embracing each other with all pleasure. They are kissing each other’s hands and enjoying the pleasures of those kisses with their lips. The cries, sighs and wailings of the wretched men of hell are deafening my ears. What I have said so far are only hints. I can say about many other indepth matters, but I am afraid of the unhappiness of the Prophet”.
paras: In this manner, H. Zaid was telling in all intoxication and semi-unconsciousness, when the Prophet pulled him with his garment’s lapel and said: “Keep quiet! Your horse is very excited. The shade of God’s saying: wallahu la yastahi min alhaqqi: God is not ashamed (to tell you) the truth (Ahzaab: 33:53) has fallen upon you; and you want to speak of unspeakable things.

sections.heading: “Your mirror has come out of its covering. Mirrors and balances never show anything other than the reality. Mirrors and balances never remain quiet and are not concerned with anybody’s disgrace and loss. They simply tell of what a thing is exactly as it is. Mirrors and balances are the real tests of things. They will not tell a lie to favour you even if you serve them for two hundred years and ask them to hide your defects; or show them in excess or as deficient. They will tell you: ‘Do not make a fool of yourself. Mirror and balance and cheating and falsifying are absolutely unconnected. God has elevated us with the purpose of the exposure of truth through us.’ My Dear young man, had this not been the fact, how could we become the exposers of the virtues of the virtuous. But hide your mirror in your armpit as it is through it, that mount Sinai got illuminated, when H. Musa put his hand in it and dragged it out.
paras: H. Zaid said: “Have the sun of truth, and the beginner of the world ever been held up in the armpit? It tears up the armpit as well as treachery. Neither madness stands up before it nor wisdom”.

sections.heading: Minute Things Hide Large Things
paras: The Prophet said: “If you keep one finger on your eyes, you will see that the world has no sun. One fingertip becomes a curtain for the moon. This is an example of the act of hiding of God, the King of hiders. That He hides the world with a small blind spot (cataract) in the pupil of the eye. With a small piece of cloud, the sun disappears. Maintain silence and look at the depth of the sea. God has made it obedient to man, and man uses it in whatever manner he pleases. When you have control on the sea, you should have control on your mouth also, and not reveal all that has been revealed on your heart. So also, the fountains of Zanjabiii (the water of refreshment) and salsabiil (the water that helps you seek the way of newer things after refreshments with zanjabiil) are under the command of the Majestic Master of paradise.

sections.heading: Things under Man’s Commands: Powers of the Heart
paras: The four streams of paradise— the streams of water, milk, honey, and wine are under our command. They are under our command not because of our strength but because of God’s command. We make them flow in the direction of our choice, and they are under our control, just as magical power is under the wish of the magician; or just as our two eyes work under the command of the heart and soul.  If the heart wants, they look toward the poison-like-sins, or they go to search for learning lessons from the events around them. If the heart wants, they see the observable material things or look toward the hidden inner qualities. They may go toward the generalities of matter or get engaged in the study of specific intricacies.

Similarly, the five senses (hearing, seeing, touching, tasting and smelling) are like the pipes attached to the soul, and they act according to its wishes. In whatever direction it points out, with all obedience and enthusiasm they move. Hands and legs are also bound by the commands of the heart, just as the staff of H. Musa was in his hand. If the heart wants, legs will start meaningless dancing or go toward jobs that result in loss or gain. If the heart wants, hands will engage in work with the fingers to write a book. The hand is under the control of inner hidden hand, which is controlled by the heart, which is deep inside, which has kept the body outside itself.

If the heart wishes, hand becomes an enemy like the snake, or becomes a friend for its friend. If it wants, it becomes a spoon with which to eat, or becomes a tenmaund heavy mace. It is not known as to what the heart tells them that at times, they appear to be related to it, and hidden at times. Perhaps the heart has obtained the finger-ring of H. Sulaiman (with which he ruled over men and jinns), that is, it has in its control the reins of the five external senses: hearing, seeing, tasting, touching and smelling. So also, the five internal senses: thought, imagination, memory, ratiocination and their combinations. Apart from these ten senses, it has control on the seven external parts of the body: head, chest, back, both hands and both legs; and the seven internal parts: brain, lungs, physical heart, liver, kidneys, bile and pancreas. You can count the other parts that I have not mentioned. When you are so brave a leader like H. Sulaiman, you can have command over the devils and fairies and their functions as you have command over your own already mentioned parts with the help of the finger-ring of H. Sulaiman, that you possess. If you remain protected within your realm without falling into any treacheries, that Sidyu (the jinn who had stolen H. Sulaiman’s finger-ring), will not be able to snatch it from you. Therefore, the world will recognise and remember you; and both the hidden and apparent worlds will be at your command just as the external and internal parts of your body are.

sections.heading: Heart’s Power, Conditional
paras: And if the jinn snatches your finger-ring, your rule will come to end, and you will be lost. Then you fall into the situations as stated by God: Ah! Alas for my servants! There comes not an apostle to them, but they mock at him: ya hasratan ala al‘ibaad: ma yatiihim min rasuulin illa kaanu bihi yastahziuna. (Yasin: 36: 30). And then till the doomsday, is a seal as stated: Inni akhaafu ‘alaikum yawma altanaadi: I fear for you a day when there will be mutual calling (and wailing): (Mumin: 40:32).

If you reject the existence of that devil of your vicious self here, you will see him in the open on the doomsday. If you do not believe in the existence of your own treacheries, you cannot protect yourself from the truth that the mirror of the record of your actions shows; and of the balance of the justice established by God there. There is no end to this discussion; and therefore, I shall engage myself in the narration of the affairs of Luqman.

chapters.title: Luqman’s wisdom to expose Truth
chapters.subtitle: Making Accusations by the Slaves and Friends against Luqman that he ate the Good Fruits that they had Brought

sections.heading: [Luqman was a man of great_morals_and intelligent_aptitudes. Some people consider him as a prophet]
paras: Luqman was a slave, who was considered to be of lowlier rank by his master among his other slaves. He used to send other slaves to his garden to bring fresh fruits in sufficient quantities for him. But among the slaves, Luqman was an uncared and uncalled for one. He was of great wisdom, but with a black face. The other slaves out of greed, ate the fruits to their full satisfaction and reported to the master that the fruits were eaten by Luqman, upon which the master got very angry and rebuked him. Luqman kept quiet, but when asked for the reason, he opened his mouth to meet the master’s disapproval and said: “O master, a misappropriating slave is not approved by God. Please take a test. In order to know the truth, make every one of us, drink a laxative syrup and make all of us drink hot water to the full of our stomachs and make us run on our feet in the plain land, and yourself riding on the horse. Then you can see the mischief-makers exposed by the Opener of secrets (God).

sections.heading: Cure for Physical, Moral Diseases
paras: The master made them all drink hot water, and they all drank out of fear; and set them free to run on high and low places. Due to fatigue, they started vomiting. Water from their stomach removed the fruits outside, but in the case of H. Luqman, only water came out. When H. Luqman’s wisdom can show this much of wonders, imagine what all can be shown by the wisdom of the Lord of existences on the day when all things will be tested: yawma tubla alssaraairu (Tariq: 86:9). All the things that you want to hide will be exposed.

When they were made to drink hot water, their tricks were torne to pieces and also all the curtains against their acts, and they were put to disgrace, as stated in the Quran: To drink boiling water so that it cuts up their bowels (to pieces): wa suquu maa’an hamiiman faqata‘a am‘aahum (Muhammed: 47:15).

sections.heading: Good for Good, Bad for Bad
paras: Fire has been made as a means of punishment for rejecters for the reason that rocks can be broken with fire. We have given advice to the stone-hearted fellows many a time. But they have not accepted. A poisoned wound can be cured by another poison (antiseptic) only; the donkeys can be controlled only through the teeth of the dogs. That is what the Quran says: women impure are for men impure, and men impure are for women impure: al khabith(s)aatu lilkhabith(s)iina, wal khabith(s)uuna lilkhabith(s)aati: (Nur:24:26). It is in this only, that wisdom lies. A bad one has to be coupled with a bad one. So, you may couple yourself with anyone of your choice and get sunk and accept the spouse’s qualities. You may go on any path of your choice and get yourself lost in the companion and become one like him.

In a Hadith(s), it is said: “A man goes on the conduct of a friend; and therefore, be careful to see whom you befriend”. If you want light, prepare yourself for light; and if you want to go away from it, become contemptuous and arrogant, and go far away from it. If you want to get released from this ruinous dungeon, do not turn your head from your friend (God) and: Nay, heed him not: but bow down in adoration, and bring yourself closer (to God): kallaa! Laa tuti‘hu wa asjud wa aqtarib (Alaq:96:19).

You may see the arrogant deniers in continuing misery. Bow down your head: God alone knows the entire truth. This matter cannot be put an end to. Therefore, O Zaid, get up and tie up the burraaq of your speech.

chapters.title: Hope and Despair
chapters.subtitle: Left over Narrative of H. Zaid, in response to the Prophet’s Answer

sections.heading: Fear and Hope to be Together
paras: Speech tears up the curtains and exposes the defects and causes of disgrace. As hiding is something desired by God; chase the drum-beater out and close the way. Do not run fast, pull the reins, as it is better that the secret remains as a secret; as it is better that everyone should be happy according to his thinking. God desires that nobody should give up good hopes on Him and give up the few obediences he is showing, even though many are based upon unfounded beliefs. This is also one among the secrets that are sought to be hidden. In whatever manner people are engaged in worshipping Him in good faith, are in fact engaged in Him. They also have good hope on Him as they are also with Him in their own way. Mercy desires that it should fall on everyone whether good or bad, because mercy is for all. God desires that every ruler and the subject should be in hopelessness as well as in hope and be disciplined in the appropriate way. Hope and despair can be possible only when they are hidden, so that, they may come about and develop behind the curtain. When you have torne the curtain, there is no scope for hope and despair as the might of the world of secrets gets exposed.

chapters.title: A Narrative relating to H. Sulaiman’s days

paras: A young man on the bank of the river thought that H. Sulaiman was a fisherman like him. If he is the same person, why is he hidden from us, inspite his face being very bright. He was thinking like this, when H. Sulaiman became the king once again. [H. Sulaiman ruled over men, beasts, birds and even devils and jinn’s through the power of his finger-ring, which was stolen by a devil and thrown into the river. As such, H. Sulaiman lost control on all and hid himself in a fisherman’s house and started fishing along with him. On one occasion, he caught a fish upon tearing which he got back his ring which the fish had swallowed. This gave back his might and control. The young man thought as above when he saw H. Sulaiman fishing —Translator].

With these thoughts the young man was in two hearts of hope and despair, when H. Sulaiman became the ruler once again. The devil ran away from the control of the throne and country and the sword of H. Sulaiman’s might put an end to his life. H. Sulaiman put the ring in his finger and the armies of devils and fairies assembled. People came over to look at him, and among them was this suspicious young man. When he looked at the ring in his finger, all his suspicions vanished.

sections.heading: Things Deliberately Kept Hidden
paras: Suspicions remain until the matters are hidden and arise in respect of unseen things. These will be there so long as the matters remain hidden; and once they become visible, suspicions vanish. So long as the bright sky does not fell rain, the dark earth remains without generating. That is why, God has said that He needs the faithful who believe in the unseen: yuminuuna bil ghaibi (Baqara: 2:3); and for them He has shut the visible holes of this world to prevent them from looking at it.

Though explaining and showing clearly are acts of perfectness so as to relieve the souls of doubts, yet one out of a hundred only gets belief in the unseen. Therefore, be sure of this fact, and give up confusion and suspicion. God Says: If I had split the heavens to make you see everything clearly, I would not have said to you: Turn your vision again; do you see any flaw: farji‘ il basra, hal taraa min futuur: (Mulk: 67:3). I have done this, so that, you may only be engaged in speculations in this darkness. Every man is looking at a different side and angle, so that for a long time, his jobs remain in perversion. And the thief is hanged on the gallows by the police officer; so that even a great powerful king may be a slave of the slave of My Makings.

sections.heading: Service in the Absence of Master
paras: Worship and obedience go well in ignorance and secrecy. Hiding your prayers makes your prayers better and more granting. The one who praises the king right before him on his face cannot be a match for the one who praises him behind his back, in privacy. The guard of the fort far away from the capital and the king, who does not yield to the temptations of large payments of bribe by the enemy to surrender the fort, and protects it from him as if his king is right before him, inspite the king remaining hidden, is certainly held in greater honour by the king as against those who are sacrificing themselves in the court. Rendering of even a little service in the absence of the master is better than a hundred-thousand-worth-service in presence.

sections.heading: Do not Expose Your Good Acts by Words
paras: Similarly, in respect of worship and faith, what is more appreciable is what is done in unseen situations during lifetime. The question of these situations is not appreciable after death, as everything is visible then. When, what is hidden, the act of hiding, and doing of good acts unseen, are better, it is better that the mouth is also kept shut to avoid any knowledge about them. Therefore, my brother, keep yourself silent when questions arise to speak up, as God Himself will provide knowledge from His own self to whomsoever He wishes. The face of the sun itself is a proof of its existence needing no one to plead for this. The greatest witness to all this is God Himself as stated: Allah (Himself) is witness that there is no God save Him. And that angels and the men of learning too are witnesses: shahidallahu annahu ta ilaaha illa Allahu wa al mala’ikatahu wa uulil al‘ilmi qa’iman bil qist (Al Imran: 3:18)

sections.heading: When God is Witness, Why Angels and Men?
paras: But inspite of God Himself being a witness, as this is stated in the ayat— why, angels and scholars are included among the witnesses? He declares, and so also the angels and the scholars, that there is no Lord other than the one who lasts for ever. When God Himself is the witness, of what worth are the angels to join him. Yet, why they are also included? This is because, those with weak eyesight and vicious hearts do not have the strength to see things even in the presence of the sun and its light. The bat which cannot bear the brightness of sun, loses all hopes. So that, the angels and the scholars may not similarly lose hopes, God has included them also along with Him. Thus, you may consider the angels as those moons which reflect the sun’s light to give the evidence of the sun in the sky. They say: we have taken this light from the sun so as to make the weak like us also gain some light from it.

sections.heading: Different Grades of Angels and Men
paras: Just like the first night moon (crescent), the moon of the third night or the moon of fourteenth night, angels also have different grades of light and state. As the angels have three or four grades or feathers of light, every angel has proportional light as per its grade, just as the feathers of the wisdom of men, among whom there are different grades of the wise. Thus, the angel of a particular grade of light will be a companion of a man of a particular grade of wisdom, which suits him very well. As a man with weak eyesight cannot look at the sun and its brightness, a star becomes the lamp for him which enables him to find the way.

chapters.title: Knowledge revealed in Piecemeal
chapters.subtitle: The Prophet’s Telling to H. Zaid not to elucidate more of the secrets and keep regard for Obedience

paras: The Prophet said: “My companions are stars who are lamps for the wayfarers and maces for the devils”. He has also said: “You may follow any of my companions, you will find the way”.

sections.heading: Light of Guidance: Different for Different men
paras: If everyone were to have those eyes and powers to receive light from the sun, everyone would have received it, and there would have been no need for stars. Everyone who cannot get guidance from the sun has to remain satisfied with the light of stars. (Those journeying during night are dependent upon stars for finding their way). One who can get light from the sun itself does not need the moon and stars. The noble Prophet, like the bright moon, says to the clouds, mud and shadows and all the people: “say: I am but a man like yourselves, (but) the inspiration has come to me”: Qul innama ana basharun mith(s)lukum, yuha ilayya: (Kahaf :18:110).

In fact, I was also without light like you, but the sun of inspiration provided me with the light (of Quran and prophethood). Inspite of these inspirations of light, I am in the dark, as the light that I have is just sufficient to meet and eliminate the darkness of men. I am weak in my light, so that you may bear with me, as you are not strong enough to bear with greater light. I have become a compound of vinegar and honey to cure the sickness of the liver. (I have mixed up the inspired knowledge and the acquired knowledge as honey and vinegar respectively to treat the men’s moral sicknesses).

sections.heading: Search for Direct Light from God
paras: “And when you get rid of your sickness, you many give up the vinegar of acquired knowledge and go on tasting the honey of knowledge from God Himself, little by little. When the throne of the heart gets rid of human passions and gets filled up with the light of God, you become one like “the most gracious firmly established on the throne of authority: alrahmanu ‘ala al’arshi istawa (Taha:20:5).

“After this, the command upon the heart directly comes from God, as there is a direct connection between Him and the heart. There is no end to this discussion. Where is Zaid? So that I may prevent him from saying more about these matters and seek disgrace for himself. There is no wisdom in speaking of all these things. The doomsday is coming to reveal everything (leave all that to it).”

chapters.title: Inner and Outer Enemies of Man
chapters.subtitle: Return to the Narrative of H.Zaid, May God be Consonant with him

paras: You will not find out Zaid now, as he has left; left from the last line of the gathering and has gone away very fast. What about your finding him out? Even Zaid cannot find himself like the star upon which the light of the sun spreads itself causing disappearance. You will not find even the marks of that star, nor can you find a scrap on the path of the milky way, as the sun has risen. He has reached the state of annihilation.

sections.heading: Activities caused by Darkness and light
paras: Our innumerable senses and the powers of speech have all been lost within the wisdom of our Great Emperor (God) just as Zaid was lost into Him. The senses and wisdom of all of us, will be brought before us, as said in the Quran: when lo! They will all be brought before us: faa-izahum jamii‘ul ladaina muhdharuna (Yaisn: 36:53). Such a situation had already occurred once, earlier. When night arrived, the time of work started for the stars: and all hidden stars appeared engaging themselves in their work. Similarly, when the night of unconsciousness (sleep) arrives on men, they get into temporary death and their souls enter into the world of spirits under the control of angels.

Similarly, when the stupor of death comes, all creatures become unconscious and go into death dragging their mantles on their faces. And, when the morning starts taking its breaths and the sun holds its flag aloft, every young man rises from the bed. God grants back the consciousness to the unconscious, and groups upon groups, engage themselves in obedience. So also, after death they get up and beat their feet and raise their hands with all pleasure and self-confidence saying: Our Lord, You have given us life. Their skins and bones that had shattered to pieces re-join and raise dust just like the horse-riders do. From the world of nonexistence, they march towards existence on the doomsday. Both the grateful and the mischievous will march.

Why do you turn your head from all this and reject it? Had you not come earlier from non-existence (‘adam) into existence. You had folded your legs in the world of non-existence claiming that none can uproot you from your seat. Do you not see God’s actions? He catches hold of the hair on your forehead and drags you. He did so then and put you into such circumstances, which you had not even dreamed of. The world of non-existence has always been obedient to Him. O devil, engage yourself in work, as H. Sulaiman is alive. Devils are making huge water basins as large as reservoirs. They have no courage to disobey or offer excuses. Look at your own self as to how you are shivering out of fear. Consider the ‘adam also to be shivering at God’s commands.

sections.heading: Fear: Cause for Seeking Elevation
paras: Consider this fact: If you try for a high position in life, it is out of the fear attached to low position. You struggle so much for it. Everything other than the love of benevolent God is full of loss. Even the eating of sugar is like facing the pangs of death. Pangs of death are a prelude to move towards death, and not reaching of the life-giving water (Aabe-Hayat) to your hand. People ‘s eyes are cast toward the dust of death, which they feel to be certain, as against the life-giving water about which they have suspicions. Try to reduce your suspicions from hundred to ninety. Try to spend your night to go on the journey toward the knowledge of realities. If you do not think during night, its coolness and thought-provoking quality will be lost. Search for the clear day in the darkness of the night. Make a guide of the wisdom, so that you may eliminate darkness of ignorance.

sections.heading: Darkness can Give a Different Light
paras: There are many virtues hidden in the dark night. The life-giving water (Aab-e- hayat) is well known to be available after passing through many darknesses. You may search for virtues in the darkness of the night. But you cannot rise your head from sleep after sowing a hundred seeds of recklessness. You have resorted to a sleep like that of a dead man and taken illegitimately earned food. You get into a sleep with carelessness and the thieves carry away your materials. You do not know as to who your enemies are. Devils made of fire, the creatures of hell are the enemies of all the men who are made of clay. Fire is an enemy of water and its progeny, just as water is the enemy of fire. Water destroys fire because it is opposed to and inimical to water’s progeny. (all plants and animals are progeny of water; and fire has the capacity to destroy them all).

sections.heading: Fire of Passions and Lust
paras: Apart from this, there is another fire: that is the fire of passions and lust, which is the root of all sins and disobediences. The external physical fire can be put out by water, but the fire of passions is so strong that it will drag its victim into the fire of hell. The fire of passions cannot be extinguished by water, as it has the characteristic of the torturing capacity of the fire of hell, which cannot be extinguished by any means. The only remedy for the fire of passions is through the means of faith and religion, just as your light can extinguish the fire of infidels. The only thing that can extinguish this fire is the light of God. Therefore, make the light of H. Ibrahim as your guide so that the fire of the breaths of the fire of Nimrod may act as a protector of your wood-like body.

sections.heading: Fire of Passions to be Reduced by Crushing
paras: Passion is a fire which cannot be extinguished by satisfying it, but it can be reduced by preventing its domination. You cannot supply fuel to it to put it out. It can never be extinguished by satisfying its requirement but only by crushing it. If you keep the fuel away, it gets extinguished, of its own. Your piety acts as water for it. A beautiful face cannot be blackened by fire, as it has put upon itself the paint of piety of the heart. Fire cannot cause loss to the clean people just as scraps of grass and leaves forming a surface on the river cannot pollute its water. Do not call the one who has eaten the antidote of God, as dead, even if he has eaten poison.

If the physician tells you in your sickness and weakness to follow the regimen and avoid honey and be careful about it; and if you out of ignorance tell him and say: you are asking me to avoid honey, while you are taking it, the benevolent physician will tell in his heart: you have presumed wrongly like an ill witted fellow. He will further say: look at the water of the fountain, which is overflowing with water, but nothing happens to it. But look at the water pot. Its water is exhausted, and it has fallen upside down. Food makes a sick man more sick but it makes a healthy man stronger. Food will increase your sickness like fire. Be careful, not to give fuel to fire. These two fires will destroy your house. A living person will meet death. If there is fire in me it is like light. The fire of health increases the pleasures of the body. When the fire of health increases in the body, instead of causing loss to it, it causes hundred times of goodness.

chapters.title: Everybody shows and gives charity
chapters.subtitle: Fire in a city during the days of H. ‘Umar

sections.heading: Generosity and work for God, and for one’s own self
paras: During the days of H. ‘Umar there was fire in a city which was burning the stones like dry wood. Huge constructions and houses were on fire; and even the feathers and nests of the birds burnt. Half of the city was caught by the fire, and water which could put it out was frightened and amazed at its ferocity. The careful people of the city were pouring water and vinegar from their goatskins to extinguish the fire. But the fire was very inimical and went on increasing its flames at every attempt to put it out, as though it was getting the support of the Lord of making. It was spreading with great vigour and receiving support from nature itself.

People rushed to H. ‘Umar saying that the fire was not getting extinguished by water. H. ‘Umar said: “Fire is one of the marks of calamity from God. It is a product of the flame of your miserliness. Give up pouring water on it; start distributing food to the poor and repent form miserliness if you have to take my word”.
People said: “We have kept our doors open for this purpose. We have always been generous and have concern for the people”.

sections.heading: Everyone does Something for his People: Not you Alone
paras: H. ‘Umar said: “You give to the people as an act of your habit and practice; but not for the sake of God. You do this to feel proud of it and to show yourself as generous and grand, but not out of the fear of God, piety and thanksgiving for what He has provided to you”.

Your wealth is like a seed. Do not sow it in an infertile land and do not give sword in the hand of a dacoit. Find out the difference between the pious friends and enemies. Search for those who are friendly with God and be in their company. Every person does some act of sacrifice for his community. Do not think that you alone do a great act.

chapters.title: Anger for self and for God
chapters.subtitle: Narrative of the spitting of an Enemy on the Face of H. ‘Ali and H. ‘Ali’s throwing away his Sword from his Hand

paras: Learn the lessons of action from H. ‘Ali and consider the lion of God as cleansed of all vices. In a battlefield H. ‘Ali caught hold of a brave soldier of the enemy, stretched out his sword to attack him, when he spat on the face of H. ‘Ali, the face which is a cause of honour for every prophet and saint. He spat on the face before which the moon prostrates considering it as an object of prostration. The cause of honour of all saints, the clean-hearted H. ‘Ali, cooled the fire of his anger, threw his sword and lost the enthusiasm to fight. His enemy fell into amazement at this untimely pardon and affection.

He said: “You had raised up the sword for me, but all of a sudden, you threw it off and let me free. What did you see which is better than fighting with me to such an extent that you showed no interest in this hunt? What did you see that chased your anger for me, in such a way that the lightning flashed and flopped? What did you see the reflection of which appeared on my heart and soul as a flame? What was it that you saw as better than the world and other existences, and more lovely than life, that you restored back my life? You are a lion for your bravery, and no one can measure of the quality of your morals. You are like the cloud of H. Musa for your generosity in the forest of Tia, where he was roaming about with Bani Israel, because of which the trays of unmatchable foods came over from God for his people”.

sections.heading: Foods of Various Kinds
paras: Clouds provide wheat which has to be cooked as bread after many preliminary acts and then eaten as sweet honey. But H. Musa’s cloud opened its feathers of benevolence and provided well cooked, sweet food without any efforts. God’s mercy raised its flag of generosity for those who ate ready food. This grant of food came to them in the form of Mann and salwa for forty years without pause or deficiency even for a day. Yet his people rose up, out of their meanness demanding vegetables, leaves and spices. With their greed, they asked H. Musa for vegetables, cucumbers, grams, garlic and onion. Because of their beggary, greed and craze, the arrival of mann and salwa from the sky stopped.

But in the case of the community of Muhammad, that soft-light food from the heavens continues to come till the doomsday; as has been stated by Muhammad: “I spend my night with the Lord who provides food and drinks to me”: Abitu ‘inda rabbi yut‘imuni wa yusiqiini (Hadith(s)).  Believe in this without any interpretation so that it may pass through your gullet like honey and milk. Because, resorting to interpretation in respect of God’s grants leads to misunderstanding of truth as falsity. Misunderstanding is due to the weakness of wisdom, as wisdom in entirety (of God) is the pulp; and partial wisdom (of yours) is the rind. Try to interpret your own self and not the ahadith(s). Consider your mind as bad and not the garden.

The enemy continued: “O ‘Ali, you are personified wisdom and deep sight. Tell me of something that you have seen. Not your sword, but your grace and greatness have taken away my life. The water of your knowledge has cleaned the dirt of our clay. Please tell me! I feel what you saw is among the secrets of God, as taking away life without the sword is God’s job alone. He is the One, Who is the grantor of precious gifts made by Him without tools and hands. He provides hundreds of thousands of spirits to senses and consciousness in such a way that both the eyes and ears do not come to know of them. He provides hundreds of thousands of wines to the soul to drink, in such a way that the mouth does not come to know of them. Please tell me, O falcon of the ‘arsh and best of the hunters! What did you see at this time from God? Your eyes have learnt the lesson of cognising the secrets of the hidden world while the eyes of the others in the world are stitched.

sections.heading: Three Types of Meditators
paras: There is one, who sees the moon in clarity, and there is another who sees the entire world as dark. There is one who sees three moon-like ones, sitting together in one place deep in high thinking in all seriousness. [There are three types of observers; one: who is absorbed whole and soul in God called jama’; two: one who gets absorbed in the observation of the creatures, called Farq; and three: one who is absorbed in the observation of both God and creatures, called Jam’ul l Jama‘ – Qazi Sajjad Hussain. That is: mystics, scientists are both in one together — Translator]

“The eyes of all the three are open and their ears are sharp. All the three have cast their attention on you, but they do not care for me. This is a magic of the hidden world, and it has strange hidden pleasures. It appears as a mark of the wolf for you, but for me it is a symbol of H. Yusuf. There are eighteen thousand worlds or even more, and all these eighteen thousand worlds do not come under the purview of everyone.

sections.heading: Silent and Spoken Guidance
paras: “Open up the secret, O ‘Ali, the chosen one! O the one who has become a fortune (for me) after a misfortune (from nearness of my death) to liberty. Rather, you may tell me all that your wisdom has understood; or I shall tell as to what clarification has occurred to me. The reflection of light that has fallen on you has fallen on me too. Why do you hide this fact? You are the one, who like the moon speak out without words, from your bright face itself. However, the moon’s speaking out is also necessary, as when it tells, wayfarers can cover the way faster. They will remain protected from wrongs and miscalculations, which may occur due to the misguidance caused by devil. Moon’s voice will dominate over devil’s voice. The moon is a guide without speaking, with its light itself. And if it speaks out also, it will be light upon light.

sections.heading: Knowledge of God through Guide
paras: “You are the gate of the city of knowledge as stated by the Prophet: “I am the city of knowledge and ‘Ali is its gate”. Apart from that you are also the ray of the sun of gracefulness. O gate, be open for the searcher of the gate, so that because of you, rinds of fruits may attain the level of pulp. Be open till the doomsday, O gate of mercy and grace! Take us to the court of the One, who has no equal: kufu-an ahad: there is none like unto Him: (Ikhlaas : 112:4). This is inspite of the fact that every blow of air and every particle is a window to see him. And where there is a door, there is no scope for it to be closed for ever. It has to open anyway. But, so long as the gate-keeper does not open the door, this remains only as a thought without actually seeing. But when the door opens, he gets flabbergasted, and the birds of hope and greed become more greedy and flutter their wings more vigorously. This is possible only when one sees all this through the help of a true guide and master.

“Otherwise, when an ignorant man suddenly finds a treasure in a ruin, he will start running in every ruin for searching. This is the case of a searcher of God.
