So long as you do not get the pearl (of knowledge and inner sight) from a perfect guide, you will be in search of a guide. And once you get one, you do not go in search of another. Otherwise, you will run with the feet of your thoughts for years together, here and there. Yet, you cannot get fragrance beyond the nostrils of your nose. So long as you do not feel the fragrance through your nose, you will see only the physical organ of the nose”.

chapters.title: Mercy instead of Harm
chapters.subtitle: The enemy’s asking H. ‘Ali the Reason for leaving him Free, and throwing his Sword, when he was Already About to Kill him

paras: Then, that neo-Muslim (who had been Islamised by the reflection of ‘Ali’s light upon his heart), who had become friendly with him said to him in a state of inebriation and pleasure: “Please tell me, O leader of the faithful, so that my soul may go into ecstasy within my body like a baby in the foetus.

sections.heading: Impacts of the Stars and Sun
paras: Seven stars for a long time serve a baby in the foetus, one after another. When the time of the soul’s entering into him arrives, the sun becomes his helper. When the time of the baby’s birth arrives, the baby comes towards the sun giving up its protection from the stars. He comes into motion with the impacts of the sun, as the sun instantly provides soul to him. The baby has not received anything other than a shape from the stars and the sun puts its light upon him. From what direction a connection came to him with the sun, when he was still in the foetus? It is through a secret way, which is beyond our comprehension. There are many ways for the sun from the sky to many places. There is a way through which gold attains its power, and a way through which a stone becomes a ruby. A way through which ruby gets red colour and a way through which horseshoe gets the sparks of light like lightnings. There is a way to ripen the fruits, and a way through which an anxious frightened man becomes bold and brave. Tell me my falcon with spread-out-wings, trained to sit on the wrist of the king! Tell me, O falcon, the hunter of Anqa (an imaginary bird of extraordinary strength); and the single soldier who can defeat an entire army alone! You are one, but like a whole community, and one among the hundreds of thousands! You have hunted me as a prey. Tell me why you have shown mercy in a situation where you should have shown your wrath. No body leaves a python free, but you have let your python-like enemy go free”.

chapters.title: Enemy becomes Friend
chapters.subtitle: H. ‘Ali’s Reply as to Why the Sword was Thrown away

paras: H. ‘Ali said: “I use the sword for Gods’ sake. I am a slave of God, and not a slave of my body. I am a Lion of God and not of my vicious desires. My acts will stand as witnesses in my favour. When the Prophet threw a handful of dust in the battle against the enemy, God said: “When you threw a handful of dust, it was not your act but God’s : Maa ramaita iz ramaita walaikinnallah ramaa ( Anfal : 8:17).

sections.heading: Sword of God
paras: “I am like the sword, the one playing with it, is God. I have put aside my luggage from the path and I consider everything other than God as non-existing. I am a shadow; and I am not away from the sun. I am the chief attendant of the court and I am always in attendance to the king. The swords of the kings are decorated with gems, but my sword is decorated with the Ever-Present-God to make everyone meet Him. I give life in the battle and do not cause death. The object of my fight is not killing but to show the path of truth to the enemies to give them everlasting life. My sword cannot be overcome with blood and hidden in blood. The cloud of my grace cannot be flown away by winds. I am not a scrap of grass but a mountain of patience, self-control, and justice. Fast winds cannot upset the mountain.

sections.heading: Different Kinds of Winds
paras: “One who gets displaced by winds is a scrap of grass, and there are many unsuitable winds. The winds of anger, passion and greed shake up a person who has no faith. The winds of greed, ill will, and lust flew him off from his place who had no commitment and obedience. The winds of arrogance, superiority and inferiority complex flew away the fellow who had no true knowledge of matters. I am a mountain and my existence is its foundation. And if I become a scrap for the sake of God, the counter wind will come to my side from Him to blow the earlier wind away. Without the wind from Him, I cannot bend down. There is none to lead me other than the love of God. The inclinations of mind too do not move without the wind from Him.

sections.heading: All Acts, for God
paras: “Kings rule upon the people and anger rules upon the kings and I rule upon anger. I have put my reins and saddle upon anger. The sword of my self-control has cut off the neck of anger; and God’s anger has become a personified mercy for me. I am sunk into the light, even though my body is completely ruined. I have become a garden, even though I was called ‘Abu Turaab’ (one smeared with mud: father of mud) by the noble Prophet. When a particular mood dominated me in the battlefield, I thought it better to put the sword in the scabbard so that I may be called as one who loved God alone( Ahabba lillah), so that my anger may be for God alone (abghadha lillah). So that I may give only for God (ata’a lillah), so that my existence may be as a holder for God. (Amsaka lillah). My miserliness is for God and my generosity is for God. I am for God in entirety, and I am a slave of noneelse”.

“Whatever I do is not out of imitation of others. It is only for Him with all my certainty of seeing and not on the basis of imagination and thinking. I am free of interpretation and research; and my sleeves are entangled with the lapel of God. With my closeness with God, when I fly, I see the place where flying has to be done and its purpose. And when I move around, I see the orbit around which to go. When I carry a burden, I know how much I have to bear. I have the moon and the sun before me to lead.

sections.heading: Be Lowly with the Lowly
paras: “Saying anything more than this to the people is not proper, as there is no scope for an ocean in a stream. I say lowly things by remaining low as per the wisdom of the people; but it is not a defect. It was a practice of the noble Prophet. I am free from any selfish motive. Hear the evidence of a free man: as the evidence by a slave is not acceptable in law. It has no legal value, as evidence of the slave at the time of filing of the case, as well as while leading evidence. Even if there are a thousand slaves to give evidence for you, Law (shariat) does not take it as of the worth of a scrap of grass.

sections.heading: “The slave of passions and lust is worse before God than one who is bound into the slavery of man. Because the latter gets out of the bond of slavery by the master’s saying a single statement: “You are free”. But the slave of pleasures lives in slavery till death, which is also very hard for him. The slave of passions and lust cannot get emancipation, except with the grace, as special gift of God. He has fallen into a bottomless well. He has invited the troubles for himself by himself and not by imposition from others under compulsion and cruelty. He has dropped himself into a well. For bringing him back from it, I do not have a rope long enough to meet its depth. What can I do, my dear, if he has committed this sin, of his own? How can I pull him back from the well? I would stop at this. If I speak any more, what to say of the liver, even hard stone would convert into blood. But it will certainly convert into blood on the day in which its conversion will be of no use as it is doomsday; and it will not be accepted.
paras: “When the evidence of the slave of man is not acceptable, that of the slave of the devil will not be considered for evidence even more, and justice by a slave of the devil is no justice. God called the Prophet as a witness saying: we have truly sent you as a witness as a bringer of glad tidings and as a warner: inna arsalnaaka shaahidan wa mubashshiran wa naziran: (Fatah: 48:8), as he was a freeman, son of a freeman. So long as I am free, anger cannot imprison me. Now am a carrier of God’s attributes and character. Come over to me.

sections.heading: God’s Graces in Evil Acts Too

“Come inside! God’s benevolence has made you free as His mercy dominates over His wrath as it is said in a Qudsi Hadith(s): inna rahmati sabaqat ghadhabi. Come inside, as by now you have attained deliverance from dangers. You were a stone. Now you are converted into a gem. You got delivered from infidelity and thorny bushes, and now you have bloomed like a flower in His garden. O honourable! I am you, and you are me. You were ‘Ali then. How could I kill ‘Ali?
paras: “You have committed an evil act which is better than any kind of obedience. In a moment, you have measured the sky. You had come to the battlefield to kill the Muslims of whom I am one. In your case your evil act became a cause of your becoming a Muslim”.

sections.heading: Examples of Evil Becoming Obedience
paras: Thus, that evil act of that man was a cause of prosperity. It is like the buds and petals of the rose coming out in the assembly of thorns. Had not H. ‘Umar made an intention to give trouble to the Prophet? His evil intention had dragged him to the court of acceptance into Islam of the noble Prophet. The noble Prophet invited H. ‘Umar to his noble court through his evil intention. Had not Pharaoh called the magicians for their expertise in magic, upon which they were blessed with the nobility of H. Musa. Had not their magic and evil intention been with them, Pharaoh would not have called them to help him in his enmity for H. Musa. They would not have seen H. Musa’s staff and miracles. O disobedient people! Evil became obedience here.

God has smashed the heads of despair, by making sins and disobediences as obedience. When God converts the sins into absolute virtues, there is no need for complaints, and the weak-minded to fear. Their complaints and weaknesses also get converted into good things. This results in the hitting of stones upon the already stone-hit Satan, who out of jealousy gets torne into two pieces. He tries to make us commit sins and drop us into a deep well through them. But when he sees that the sins have become obedient acts in God’s view, it becomes an inauspicious time for him.

“Come unto me! I have opened the doors for you. You spat on me and I rewarded you with a gift. This is the way: I give gifts to the cruel fellows. When I do like this with enemies, imagine what all I do with friends by bowing myself before their feet. Through this, you may realise, what all I can give to the faithful, like treasures and the countries that last for ever. I grant them an everlasting kingdom and other things about which they cannot even imagine. I am such a man, that even upon my killer, the sting of the honey of my mercy does not cause any harm”.

chapters.title: H. ‘Ali’s death foretold by the Prophet
chapters.subtitle: The Prophet’s whispering to a servant of H. ‘Ali that Ali’s death will be caused by you. I clearly tell this to you

sections.heading: Every act is Predestined
paras: H. ‘Ail continued: “One day the noble Prophet whispered into the ear of my servant that he would cut off my head from my neck. The Prophet informed him of this event through the inspiration from God that my killing would, at last, be by his hand. I told him: “When my death is destined to be at your hand, what efforts can I make against God’s decision”. He fell down on my feet and said: “O my master, for God’s sake, cut me off into two pieces, so that, that may not be my bad end, so that, I may not burn within myself”.

I told him: “Go off. The pen of God has dried up after writing down the fate: The Prophet has said: “After writing down of what would be done by you, the pen dried up: Jaff al Qalamu bima anta laaqin: (Hadith(s)). This pen has brought down many large flags. I do not have any ill will for you, as I do not consider this to happen by your hand. You are only an instrument of God and the actual doer is He alone. How can I attack the instrument with bad comments and spear?”

sections.heading: Why Punishment for Predestined Acts
paras: Then the servant asked me: “Then, why there a provision for retaliation in the case of murder”? I told him: “This provision is also from God and the reasoning behind this is a hidden secret. [A killer cannot be killed in anticipation of killing, but only upon the occurrence of murder. The killer has been an instrument of God in the act of killing; and therefore, He can destroy His instrument Himself, or give the authority to retaliate to others.] However, if God finds something objectionable or against good policy, He withdraws the command and in its place, brings forward something better. He has every right to find objections to His own decisions, as He is unmatchable in showing benevolence as well as wrath. He alone is the Ruler of this world full of incidents and accidents. He alone is the manager of all activities in all the countries. If He breaks His own instrument, he resets it and makes it better. Therefore, learn the wisdom from this ayat: None of our revelations do we abrogate or cause to be forgotten, but we substitute something better or similar: ma nansakh min aayaatin aw nunsihaanaatin bikhairin minha aw mith(s)lihaa (Baqara 2:106)

sections.heading: Abrogation of One to Bring another Better
paras: Every law that God has abrogated is like removing the grass and bringing roses in its place. Night abrogates the light of the day. In its darkness wisdom loses its capacities and becomes inanimate, upon man’s going into sleep. Then the light of the day abrogates the night, when the inanimate wisdom becomes lively and its stony situation ceases. Though darkness is the cause of the peace of night and sleep, it does not appear to be reasonable to be with the abrogation of the light of the day. But it is through this darkness only that living beings get the life-giving-water (Aabe-Hayaat), which makes all their organs regain strength and freshness. Darkness of the night refreshes wisdom. Man is silent and inactive during the night, but with regained vigour and wisdom, he becomes more efficient on the next day. This silence on repeated occasions becomes a capital of his name and fame, because opposites came about from opposites. Polluted blood flowing into the heart gets purified and causes life, and through it comes wisdom, which is a light in actuality. The battles fought by the Prophet became the cause of peace. The peace prevailing in his later periods is due to these battles. He cut off the heads of many in order to provide peace to the peoples of the world. The gardener cuts off green branches of the trees so that they may give more fruits. A wise man pulls out the grass from the wasteland in order to create a garden to get fresh fruits. A dentist pulls out a tooth to give relief from pain to the patient. Thus, there are profits hidden in losses, and the life of the martyrs is in their getting killed.

sections.heading: Martyrs Get New Throats to Eat

When the throat of a martyre is cut off, he gets entry among those: with their Lord they have provision. They are also jubilant: ‘inda rabbihim yurzaquuna farihiina: (Al Imran: 3:169,170). When the throat of an animal is cut in equity, it enters into man through his throat and gets more honoured by becoming a part of man’s body. Through this, you may imagine, what all efficiencies man gets when his throat is cut off. God will create a third throat for him and he will take care of it through the syrup of truth and His lights. This cut off throat drinks syrups, and the throat that got freed from the perishable things of the world which have negative values, gets lost into the lordship of God in entirety.
How to Eliminate Deficiencies
paras: You are deficient of courage with short hands. Put an end to this. How long do you want to keep yourself alive physically with the help of food? You are fruitless like rattan. Because of this reason only, you have disgraced yourself by living for eating. If the soul of your senses cannot remain satisfied without reducing your food, on your own, and continues to go to material sensations only, hold on to the hand of a learned guide. He will make your copper as worthy as gold. A person who wants to get his clothes washed, should go to the quarters of the washermen. Your learned guide will act as a washerman and cleanse you of your sensory dirt. If, your worldly connections have broken your fast, you should go in search of one who can restore your courage and willpower. When his hand is capable of resetting the broken bones, and if he breaks your bone, know this, he can still reset your bones. But instead of this, if you try to break your own bones, he will prevent you from doing this because of your inability to reset. Breaking is alright for a person who is capable of resetting. These are examples of the actions of a true guide. He will get you rid of dominant, dear habits of yours, in order to give you many good habits.

sections.heading: Good Flows out of Bad
paras: One who knows stitching also knows cutting. A good seller is also a good buyer. He buys good things to sell them as good things. A competent person demolishes an old house and builds in its place a high grand house. He upsets the house with efforts and rebuilds a new house fast, as repairing the old house involves a long process of repair work. If he cuts off someone’s head, he becomes the cause of protecting hundreds of thousands of heads. If God were not to permit retaliation as good, he would not have said: And there is life for you in retaliation: wa lakum filqisaas hayatin (Baqara: 2: 179). Who would be bold enough, on his own, to lift the sword without being under the command of God? Everyone knows that one who opened eyes to see things was under the command of God. When there is a command that the son’s life should be taken away by the father, the father dare not disobey. He hits at him, and his fatherly affection does not come in the way. Be warned, and fear yourself and fear God, and do not pass remarks on others. Consider yourself to be totally helpless before the net of the commands of God. Bow down your head in all humility before God and do not make fun of others and do not pass remarks against them.

chapters.title: No contempt for Bad People
chapters.subtitle: H. Adam’s Expressing Surprise on the Misguidance of Iblis; and Iblis’s Feeling Proud of himself

paras: One day, H. Adam looked at Iblis, the unfortunate one, with contempt, out of his own lack of proper mental quality. He looked upon himself with pride and self-love and contemptuously laughed at the act of the accursed Iblis. The honour of God called upon him and said: “O chosen one, you are not aware of the hidden secrets. If I turn up the ins and outs of things, mountains will be uprooted from their bases. I can tear up instantly the hidden secrets of hundreds of men and turn a hundred devils into neo-Muslims”.

sections.heading: H. Adam’s Repentance: No Contempt for Others
paras: H. Adam said: ‘I repent for the eyes that I cast on him. I shall not even think of such a wrong again. O my God! Forgive your bondsman for his mistake. I repent for it. Do not hold me in your grip. O hearer of the grievances of the aggrieved, hear this grievance and guide us. Wealth and learning are not matters of pride. Do not put the heart guided by you, into misguidance. And turn aside that misfortune that has already been written down. Set aside the misfortune from our life; and do not keep us away from the clean-hearted people. Nothing is more bitter than the separation from You and everything is in extreme confusion without Your support. Our materials are themselves our enemies; our body itself is a cause of loss for our soul. Our hands come in the way of our legs by keeping us away from You, because of their own over-engagements. Nobody can get peace without Your giving peace. Even if the soul saves itself from these calamites, still it comes into possession of hopelessness and fear. This is because; so long as the soul does not meet its beloved, it remains blind and lightless till the doomsday. It is only upon Your showing the way that the soul has the scope to protect itself. The soul that lives without You requires to be considered as dead. It is entirely Your authority to make remarks upon Your bondsmen if You so wish.

sections.heading: “If You say that the sun and moon are not apparent, if You say the cypress tree is not upright but bent down, if You call the sky and the ‘arsh (Empyrean) as worthless, if You consider the mine and the ocean as beggars: all that is right in view of Your perfectness. Giving perfectness and destroying anything is Your prerogative as You are completely away from non-existence and nullity. You alone are the one to bring out things from non-existence and to destroy them.
paras: One who causes growth knows also of setting fire. One who knows tearing also knows of stitching. He sets the garden on fire during autumn and thereafter brings about colourful flowers saying: O the burnt-out-one, come out of fire and become fresh, become more beautiful again and well known. You brightened again the blind eye of the narcissus, tore the throat of the reed and made it sing. As we are made-out and not makers, we have nothing to choose other than remaining contented with whatever we have. We are all engaged in the indulgences of our own individualities and selfishness. It is Your grace that we are only this much, otherwise we would all become devils. We got freedom from the devil only because, You saved our souls from blindness. You are the holder of the protective staff of the one who is living. What else can a blind be if he does not have a stick and stick bearer. Everything other than You, whether good or bad, is a causer of fire for man and fire in entirety. The one for whom fire became a protector and supporter became a fire-worshipper and priest of fire worshipper. Whatever is there other than God, is untrue; and God’s grace is a rain causing cloud.

chapters.title: Death is Pleasurable
chapters.subtitle: Return to the Narrative of H. ‘Ali and his Forgiveness of his killer and Servant

paras: Turn again to the narrative of H. ‘Ali and his killer and H. ‘Ali’s showing greater regard to his killer. He said: “I look at my enemy with my eyes, day and night, yet, I do not have any anger for him, because death appears to me as lovely as life.

sections.heading: Where Death is Lovable
paras: “My death is very tightly held in my grip. Dying before death is permissible for us. Wealth without materials is a great gift for us. When wealth without materials becomes your wealth, you get a deathless life and death ceases to exist. The noble Prophet has said: “Die before the coming of death”: Muutu qabla an tamuutu: (Hadith(s)). Whatever is a cause of fear for others becomes a cause of peace for you just as a duck is stronger in water and a domestic bird is tired. It is death only in appearance, but deep inside, it is life. On the outer side, it is destruction but on the inner side, it is everlasting. Coming out of the baby from the foetus is the starting of journey for him and his blooming into the world. As I have love and infatuation for death, the negative command of: And make not your hands contribute to your destruction: wala tulqu bi aidiyakum ila altahlukati: (Baqara: 2:195), has come for me. Only one for whom death is destruction comes under this command. He cannot do anything other than protecting his life and avoid putting it into destruction. For the one for whom death is the opening of the gate of victory, the command is: be quick in the race: Saari‘uu (Al Imran 3:133)

“A negative command can come in respect of a sweet grain. There is no need to issue negative command in respect of a bitter seed. The bitterness of the rind and pulp of the seed is hateable and itself acts as a preventor from eating. The seed of death has become sweet for me. The statement: Nay, they are living Bal ahyaa’un (Baqara :2 :154) has come for me. Kill me, my secret bearer, by condemning me, as in my killing there is an everlasting life. There is life for me in my death, my dear. How long am I to remain away from the place of origin. Had there been no separation from God in my staying in the world, God would not have said: to him is our return: inna ilaihi raaji‘uuna: (Baqara:2 :156). One who returns is the one who is away from his place and then returns to it and gets mingled with his originator, God, after a time of separation.”
There is no end to this. When my servant heard all this, he bowed down his head in shame.”

chapters.title: Fate cannot be altered
chapters.subtitle: The Repeated Entreatment to H. ‘Ali of his Servant to kill him to Relieve him of the Fate caused by God

paras: “My servant came and fell down before me keeping his head upon my feet, again and again saying: “O ‘Ali, kill me soon, so that I may not see that bad time. Flow down my blood. I forgive you for my killing so that my eyes may not see that bitter doomsday-like-incident (of killing you)”.

sections.heading: Rulership only to Give a Model Code
paras: H. ‘Ali said: “Even if every particle becomes your killer with dagger in its hand, it cannot even cut a hair from your body, when the pen has already written down for you. But be not grieved! I shall be a pleader for your pardon. I am a master of the soul and not a slave of the body. This body has no worth before me, and without it, I am a brave person, son of a brave person. Daggers and swords are like fragrant grasses for me; the death of my body is a garden and pleasure-home for me. One who defeats the body in this way will have no desire and greed for leadership and rulership. Though, apparently, he will attempt for rulership and high status, he does so only to be a model for other rulers to teach them the rules of rulership. To make a proper code for every government so that everyone be able to write the laws of governance to the rulers. To put a fresh soul into governance and to provide fruits to the tree of governance. You will see their leadership in this world, but in the other world, all their hidden secrets will appear clearly. Do not have evil suspicions, O wiseman. Come to your senses and know that God knows best.

chapters.title: Why the Prophet conquered Makkah
chapters.subtitle: To Narrate that the Prophet’s Victory of Makkah and Other places was Not due to the Love of Rulership of the World as he has said this himself: “World is a dead body and dogs are its seekers”. His Desire for victory was with God’s Command

paras: “How can the attempts of the Prophet to conquer Makkah be alleged to be for the love of the world? The one who shut his eyes from the treasures of the seven heavens on the occasion of ascension (Mi‘raaj) could not go for this world. Houries and souls had assembled around the horizons of all the seven heavens. Holy angels had fallen on the dust of his feet. Hundreds of enthusiasts like H. Yusuf had fallen into his well. Everyone had beautified himself for his sake; but he had no concern for anybody other than his friend, God. He was so full with the majesty of God that the other prophets had no scope for entry into it. There was no scope for any prophet, angel, and spirit in it. You may know this much, from what he said: “There is a time for me when none other than my Lord can be found within me”.

sections.heading: One Absorbed in God has no care for World
paras: “He said: “We are like those whose eyes did not turn aside, not like crows, but under the impact of what God said: His eyesight never swerved, nor did it go wrong: Maazagh al basaru wa ma taghaa: (Najm :53:17). We are there to make the garden more colourful and not to enjoy its  already existing colours, since it is said: We take our colour from God, and who is better than God in colouring: sibghatallahi wa man ahsanu minallahi sibghatan (Baqara :2:138).

“When the treasures and wisdom of the heavens were just like a scrap of grass in the Prophet’s view, what are Makkah, Syria and Iraq that he would show his interest to conquer them. Such a thinking can be only of a hypocrite as he thinks of everyone upon the basis of his own ignorance and greed. When you keep a lens of yellow colour before your eyes, you will see the entire light of the sun as yellow alone. Break this blind and yellow lens so that you may see the difference in man and the dust around him. Dust has surrounded the horse-rider and you consider horse alone as the man infact.

sections.heading: Lion of the World, Lion of God
paras: “When Iblis looked at the dust of Adam, he said: “It is a kind of dust. How can it go above the forehead of my fire?” So long as you also consider the honoured friends of God as only ordinary men, think that your eyesight is an inheritance from Iblis, saying: you are only men like ourselves: Ma antum illa basharum mith(s)luna: (Yasin: 36:15). If you, as an enemy of truth, are not of the progeny of Iblis, then, how did you inherit the property of that dog. I am not a dog, but a lion of God and worshipper of truth. Lion of God is one who does not go after apparent faces. The lion of the world searches for a beast and wealth; the lion of God searches for freedom and death, because he sees a thousand lives in death; as such he burns himself in fire like the moth.

sections.heading: Only Faithful Desire Death
paras: “Desire for death is the yoke of the truthful as the Jews were put to test with this. God has stated in the Quran addressing them that death is victory and profit for the truthful. Just as there is a desire for profit, so also a desire for death is better. They were told: “O Jews, to maintain your honour among the people, bring this desire for death on your mouths”. Not a single Jew had the courage to say this, when H. Muhammad raised the flag of this challenge. The noble Prophet also said: “If the Jews were to say this from their mouths, not a single one would be alive in the world.”

“But instead of saying this, the Jews brought materials and money as jizya before the noble Prophet and said: “O lamp of guidance! Do not disgrace us”. They were prepared to offer Jizya happily and were satisfied in this manner. God knows their affairs better.

“There is no end to this discussion. Give your hand to me so that your eyes may see the Friend. Come into the garden from the dust bin when you have seen the light in darkness. Move your feet fast without any hesitation towards this bottomless well of paradise.”
H ‘Ali’s opponent said: “For the sake of God please explain to me the details about these matters and take me under your discipleship”.

chapters.title: Fighting: not for Personal cause
chapters.subtitle: H. ‘Ali’s saying: “when you spat at my face, my anger enflamed for you and the sincerity of my act (of fighting) was no more; and this came in the way of your killing”. And the enemy’s converting to Islam Conclusion

paras: H. ‘Ali said to that young man: “O brave man, in the battlefield, when you spat on my face, my vicious self got wild and my wrath suddenly increased, and my conduct was spoiled. Half of my mind remained devoted to jihad and the other half to satisfy my personal self. Such a partnership is not proper in the acts of God. You are made by God. You are the slave of God and not mine. Makings of God have to be unmade by the commands of God. Hit a stone of the friend upon the glass of the friend”.

When the fire-worshipper heard this, a light appeared before him so bright that he instantly tore down his zunnar (sacred thread) from his neck and threw it off. He said: “I sowed the seed of cruelty and had considered you to be of a different nature. You are a weighing balance of godly nature, of the One God. Rather, you are the pointing needle of all balances. You are like my own root and family. You are the light of the candle of my religion. I am now the slave of the lamp which spreads light in all directions from which your lamp has received light. I am now the slave of that wave of the sea of light, which brings forth such precious pearls like you. Please give me the article of your faith as I find your mentor to be the most highly elevated person in the world”.

About fifty persons from among his relatives and friends, turned toward the faith in high enthusiasm. H ‘Ali with the sword of his self-control saved so many throats from the metallic sword. The sword of self-control is sharper than the sword of iron; rather the one to be more victorious than hundreds of armies.

What a tragedy! Two or four morsels were eaten, and see, that the enthusiasm for thinking became cold. People have engaged themselves in the stories and narratives referred to (in Math(s)navi) without taking the advice and instructions in them. A grain of wheat became an eclipse for the sun of Adam, just as a point entering into Zanab eclipses the light of moon. [Orbits of the sun and moon crossing each other create two points. One is called Zanab and the other as Ra-us. When the sun reaches the point of Ra-us, and the moon the point of Zanab, earth comes in between them, and lunar eclipse occurs– Qazi Sajjad Husain. This is an astronomical understanding of the Rumi’s time. How far it matches or disagrees with the present astronomical understanding requires to be clarified by astronomers – Translator].

The delicacy of the heart is very strange that with a handful of dust, its moon spreads out like the Pleiades (perveen or suriyya, a collection of seven stars). So long as the bread of meanings and instructions in the narratives was taken, it was a good food. But, as it became a body of letters, it became something of no worth, and worthy of rejection. It is like the green thorns which the camel eats, which give hundreds of profits and pleasures to it. When their greenery goes and they become dry, it is better for the camel to discard them and graze in the forest. Instead of this, if it continues to eat dry thorns, they will tear its lips. The compound of honey and rose petals turns into a sword. So long as the meanings were taken as food they were like the green thorns, but when meanings assumed the shape of bodies and formalities, they became dry, harmful, hard thorns.

Earlier, you were taking meanings and instructions from the narratives. They were useful to you. But now, that you have entered into the old habit of listening for entertainment, you have become one of a soft body without any vigour. But still you continue to eat this bread with the attraction of its smell, after the meanings have been lost in dust. What was mixed up with dust and mud has dried up and the dry body remains like flesh which is being cut like dry thorns for the camel. Therefore, O camel, protect yourself from this. Good words now come out along with hard dry clay. When water of the well is polluted, its mouth should be closed until God brings out fresh and clean water in it. One who has polluted it can as well clean it himself. Patience, not haste, fulfils the desire. Have patience and know that God knows best.

sections.heading: “You need not read this book from the beginning. Open any page and read any sentence. It has its own independent meaning, wisdom, advice and poetical beauty. Because it is a literal verse by verse translation in prose. Each verse is a treasure of knowledge and information. However, if you read all sentences together, you swim into a coast less ocean of knowledge of many sciences and acts, and come back to the coast as a great master.”
